# Chapter 406: Feng Jiu Ge

Atop a white rock beside the water, Feng Jin Huang sat with eyes closed.

"How dare he do that to me! Ahhh!" Unable to bear it, Feng Jin Huang opened her phoenix eyes, stood abruptly, and screamed.

"Despicable bastard, stepping on my face! I will tear you to pieces!" Feng Jin Huang roared furiously.

In just a few breaths, Feng Jin Huang completely decimated the valley. Even ten Fang Yuans combined could not match such terrifying battle strength.

"Oh, my little Feng Er..." Inside the cottage, a dignified, elegant beauty in white silk and a green belt watched, closely resembling Feng Jin Huang.

She was Feng Jin Huang's mother, Fairy Bai Qing, a rank six Gu Immortal!

"Stop worrying. The jade sea tide tea I brewed is getting cold; come sit and drink," Feng Jiu Ge said helplessly.

"Sigh! Feng Er has always been competitive. With her talent, no one in the sect was her match, yet she suddenly stumbled. Hu Immortal Inheritance is the first and most critical failure of her life. As her father, you're still in the mood for tea?"

Feng Jiu Ge embraced her gently: "Don't cry, Qing Er. In truth, this setback is not without benefits."

"Oh? What benefits?" Bai Qing looked at him doubtfully.

"Feng Er is our pride, but I worry too. She is too competitive, always needing first place. Her talent and comprehension exceed mine, but does that surpass all heroes under heaven? No matter how great her talent is, can it compare to Desolate Ancient Moon?"

"Qing Er, you are rank six and I am rank seven, but even rank nine Immortal or Demon Venerables live long, not forever. We can protect Feng Er now, but eventually she will have to rely on herself. Experiencing failure now will help her mature."

She sighed: "She must be tempered, but that Immortal Crane Sect lad bullied her! As her father, will you do nothing?"

Feng Jiu Ge snorted, eyes narrowing coldly: "Immortal Crane Sect went too far, despite promising compensation to the other nine sects. But Feng Er is my daughter—how could I allow her to be bullied? I have sent them a letter. If He Feng Yang does not know what is good for him, I will visit their sect to settle the score!"

Bai Qing's heart eased seeing her husband had already acted, but she soon turned anxious: "Husband, do not be rash or make a huge commotion. When you attacked the ten sects back then, Immortal Crane Sect was among them. They know your strength, but don't repeat such things."

Feng Jiu Ge comforted his wife, thinking coldly: "Among Central Continent's ten great sects, none are worthy of facing me."

Meanwhile, a heavy, grim atmosphere filled Shang Qing pavilion atop the mountain.

"Feng Jiu Ge has gone too far!" Supreme first elder glared furiously, clutching a thin letter with trembling hands.

"At rank six, Feng Jiu Ge threw the ten sects into unprecedented turmoil. Now he is rank seven, backed by Spirit Affinity House, one of the ten sects. He carries the bearing of a heavenly immortal; though his demands are overbearing, we can agree." Supreme second elder took the letter and said calmly.

"He Feng Yang, how could you make such a blunder? Fang Yuan is not our disciple—what motive do you have for shielding him?" A thunderous voice shook the windows of Shang Qing pavilion.

The speaker was Lei Tan, a rank six Gu Immortal at loggerheads with He Feng Yang.

He Feng Yang looked around calmly, chuckling: "Fang Yuan is indeed not our disciple, but his brother Fang Zheng is, leading our current generation of elite disciples."

Lei Tan sneered: "Is an elite disciple's brother worth our entire sect backing him, given the heavy compensation owed to the nine sects?"

He Feng Yang retorted disdainfully: "Even tripled, that compensation cannot compare to Hu Immortal blessed land and Fixed Immortal Travel Gu."

"He Feng Yang! What are you getting at?" Lei Tan frowned impatiently.

# Chapter 407: Immortal Crane Sect’s objective

Supreme third elder chuckled: "I see Elder Feng Yang's intent. If we didn't shield Fang Yuan, Hu Immortal blessed land would still be contested by all ten sects. By claiming Fang Yuan as our own, we eliminated the other nine sects, leaving only Immortal Crane Sect to seize the blessed land."

He Feng Yang cupped his fists: "Third elder is wise! Who could expect a mortal to use Fixed Immortal Travel Gu to claim the blessed land?"

"Hu Immortal inheritance rests on Tian Ti mountain. As you know, Tian Ti mountain was the stairway to Heavenly Court. Though destroyed and abandoned, it still represents Heavenly Court's majesty. Attacking Hu Immortal blessed land means attacking Tian Ti mountain, which equates to attacking Heavenly Court."

"Even if we attacked, the land spirit would require at least three rank six Gu Immortals working together, and success would still not be guaranteed. Moreover, the core area is guarded by Dang Hun mountain. Without five or six Gu Immortals cooperating fully, who could scale to the peak? Lei Tan, could you?"

Lei Tan snorted: "There is a fatal flaw in this plan! Hu Immortal blessed land is on Tian Ti mountain and firmly shut. Without attacking to create an opening, how do we enter?"

He Feng Yang chuckled knowingly: "How could I lack a plan? Blessed lands face tribulations; Hu Immortal herself perished during the fifth earthly calamity. By my calculations, the sixth earthly calamity strikes in one year and three months. Fang Yuan is a mere mortal; how could he know how to withstand it? Even with the land spirit, lacking sect support, the blessed land will suffer severe damage, opening a loophole."

Lei Tan scoffed: "Even with a loophole, do you dare attack? Didn't you just say it sits on Tian Ti mountain?"

He Feng Yang answered: "Forcefully attacking is a terrible move, used only as a last resort. Fang Yuan is merely a mortal; once a loophole opens, with our schemes, why worry about failing to capture him? After the earthly calamity passes, he will surely worry and thirst for external aid. I plan to use Fang Zheng and familial ties to persuade him into trade. With repeated transactions, his guard will naturally lower, allowing us to reason with him and bring him into Immortal Crane Sect!"

"If he remains stubborn, Slavery Gu is an option. Securing Fixed Immortal Travel Gu through him would be the ideal outcome."

Supreme third elder muttered: "Aside from exceptions like Dream Wings Gu activated by soul power, most Immortal Gu require immortal essence, and Fixed Immortal Travel Gu is no exception. With Fixed Immortal Travel Gu and the land spirit providing immortal essence, Fang Yuan can escape at any time. We must handle him with great care. Moreover, for a mere mortal to possess an Immortal Gu, he must have a formidable background."

He Feng Yang nodded: "I considered this point. When I claimed Fang Yuan as our disciple, I observed the other nine sects; none of Central Continent's sects are behind him. As one of Central Continent's ten great sects, Immortal Crane Sect holds overwhelming advantage against them."

Third elder's brow smoothed: "One doubt remains. Activating Fixed Immortal Travel Gu requires a vivid memory and clear understanding of the destination's terrain. As a mortal from distant Southern Border, how did Fang Yuan know Hu Immortal blessed land's landscape and time his arrival so precisely? Did Hu Immortal leave an inheritance in Southern Border? Or is this a trick by Tian Ti mountain's demonic Gu Immortals?"

He Feng Yang bowed: "I am also unclear. It is strange; originally we only had clues regarding the Blood Sea inheritance when a defector fled to Southern Border."

Supreme Grand Elder spoke: "Elder He Feng Yang, you shall oversee this plan and be rewarded handsomely upon success."

"Junior understands!" He Feng Yang accepted the order with a smile.

Supreme Grand Elder added: "You must hand over your One's Own Way Gu to settle Feng Jiu Ge's demand."

He Feng Yang could only accept with a bitter smile.

# Chapter 408: Fang Yuan regains consciousness

Fang Yuan slowly opened his eyes.

This was Hu Immortal's Dang Hun Palace.

"A gentle home," Fang Yuan remarked lightly, getting out of bed.

His body shook uncontrollably, as his brain was still dizzy.

Fang Yuan did not find it strange, knowing he had pushed himself too hard on San Cha mountain.

"How long did I sleep..." Fang Yuan shook his head, feeling utterly exhausted as weakness radiated from his soul.

"My soul foundation was too weak and suffered damage. Fortunately, this is Dang Hun mountain..." Fang Yuan turned solemn and called: "Where is the land spirit?"

Swoosh, Hu Immortal land spirit appeared before him.

"Master, you are finally awake." Hu Immortal bowed her head with a blush, gazing meekly at her feet.

She looked like a cute five-to-six-year-old girl in a colorful dress, a snow-white fox tail swaying behind her in unease.

"Master, while you slept, I healed your left arm, though I found no clothes to fit you."

Fang Yuan frowned: "Clothes are unimportant. How long did I sleep? Did strong enemies attack the blessed land?"

Hu Immortal's bright eyes blinked: "Master, nobody attacked during the seven days you slept."

"Oh?" Fang Yuan's eyes shone.

The blessed land was young, possessing a land spirit, ample immortal essence, and Dang Hun mountain as its core defense.

These three elements made Hu Immortal blessed land an impregnable fortress that most Gu Immortals could not breach.

Fang Yuan recalled a crucial question: "Land spirit, how long until the next earthly calamity?"

"I was about to tell you, Master. The blessed land has weathered five earthly calamities; the sixth is a year and three months away," Hu Immortal said anxiously.

"What? A year and three months!" Fang Yuan sprang from the bed, his expression turning grim.

Blessed lands faced constant trials: an earthly calamity every ten years, and a heavenly tribulation every hundred years.

"Only a year and three months until the calamity! Why didn't Feng Jin Huang's biography mention this? Right, backed by Spirit Affinity House and immortal parents, withstanding it was trivial for her. But for me, this is perilous!"

He also had to guard against external enemies.

"I snatched Hu Immortal blessed land under everyone's watchful eyes. Though the ten sects have not moved yet, they are biding their time. Are they planning to exploit the earthly calamity?"

During a calamity, the land spirit could not protect him, leaving the rank four Fang Yuan vulnerable to ambush.

Calming his racing thoughts, he resolved: "I will prepare thoroughly for this earthly calamity. If I fail, I will detonate the blessed land rather than surrender resources to the righteous path, then escape with Fixed Immortal Travel Gu."

Changing into a black robe, Fang Yuan followed the land spirit up the stairs to the mountain peak.

"Master, the blessed land spans 4,000 square kilometers with a fivefold time flow, mostly covered in rich grasslands and flowers."

# Chapter 409: Managing the Blessed Land

Fang Yuan asked: "How many Gu are in the blessed land now?"

Hu Immortal raised her head slightly: "Currently, there are over eight hundred sixty thousand rank one Gu across fifty-two types, over one hundred thirty thousand rank two Gu in forty-eight types, and five thousand rank three Gu in twelve types. Only sixty-some rank four Gu of eight types, and one rank five Gu—Fox Skin Gu."

Time flowed five times faster in Hu Immortal blessed land: one day in the outside world was five days here.

This accelerated Fang Yuan's cultivation fivefold, giving him over a year of progress in three real months.

Naturally, this had a drawback: with only a hundred years of lifespan, he would age five times faster as well.

The land spirit added: "Over four million foxes across a thousand packs live here, spanning six distinct breeds."

To reach Gu Immortal, Fang Yuan needed to manage the blessed land while surviving its recurring calamities.

"Originally, there were far more foxes here—at least three times the current amount. The second earthly calamity brought meteor fire rain, devastating the eastern area and incinerating hundreds of thousands of foxes; its dark flames still burn today. The fourth calamity was a massive flood that submerged most northern grasslands, killing countless more foxes. That is why so few remain."

"Suppressing the dark flames and expanding flood will cost substantial immortal essence," Fang Yuan murmured.

Immediately after, Hu Immortal land spirit delivered even worse news.

"Master, look—this greatest danger remains from the fifth calamity." She displayed another scene.

Fang Yuan saw a scorched prairie where a humanoid figure of blue lightning sat cross-legged.

"Humanoid lightning—the earthly calamity, blue charm lightning shadow!" Fang Yuan inhaled sharply.

Fang Yuan immediately realized this blue charm lightning shadow was likely the killer of Hu Immortal.

"Master, be careful; this humanoid lightning roams randomly and only avoids Dang Hun Mountain," the land spirit warned.

"This lightning is both an earthly calamity and a living being. Having a soul, if it nears Dang Hun Mountain, the soul shockwaves will reduce it to ashes." Fang Yuan had calmed down.

"Can I use Dang Hun Mountain to eliminate this lightning shadow? But how do I lure it?" As Fang Yuan pondered, the buzzing in his ears resumed.

"Is there any other bad news? Tell me at once," he asked the land spirit with a wry smile.

The land spirit shook her head; having reported the worst, only good news remained.

First, a tribe of rockmen inhabited the blessed land's southern region.

Second, Hu Immortal blessed land possessed abundant immortal essence.

The land spirit led Fang Yuan into Dang Hun Mountain's palace. Deep inside, an enormous golden bowl was filled with green immortal essence.

This was exclusive to rank six Gu Immortals—green grape immortal essence!

"With this immortal essence, there is still hope!" Fang Yuan finally breathed a sigh of relief.

# Chapter 410: Dang Hun Mountain’s Gutstone

Fang Yuan counted seventy-eight and a half beads of green grape immortal essence in the golden bowl.

Fang Yuan held a bead of green grape immortal essence and willed Fixed Immortal Travel Gu to appear.

"Master, be careful! Summoning an Immortal Gu with such severe soul injuries could incapacitate you," Hu Immortal warned.

"Don't worry, I know." Fang Yuan gritted his teeth, opening his palm for Fixed Immortal Travel Gu to land.

"Fixed Immortal Travel consumes an entire bead of immortal essence, but this feeds it for six years."

After feeding the Gu, Fang Yuan let it roam inside the palace safe from the lightning shadow.

"Let's go, little Hu Immortal, go find the gutstones with me."

"Teleport for what? We must save immortal essence!" Fang Yuan glared.

After walking a while, the land spirit paused and pointed down. "Master, there is a gutstone here."

Fang Yuan hurried over, squatted, and smashed the gutstone with his hand.

The shattered stone released a Gu that dissolved into eerie grey light and entered Fang Yuan's body.

Fang Yuan felt his mind clear as novel strength infused his soul, diminishing the buzzing in his ears.

Dang Hun Mountain shattered souls into death, but the land spirit's suppression allowed Fang Yuan safe passage.

Souls that shatter on the mountain scatter and merge into it over time, forming gutstones.

Some gutstones contain guts Gu, which can strengthen one's soul.

Guided dutifully by the land spirit, Fang Yuan found and smashed open another dozen gutstones.

Obtaining eight more guts Gu to nourish his soul, Fang Yuan completely healed his injuries and surpassed his prior strength.

"Hahaha, with Dang Hun Mountain, I have endless gutstones! By consuming guts Gu, my soul foundation will one day reach unprecedented heights!"

A potent soul foundation offered immense advantages, easing Gu refinement, beast enslavement, and resisting soul-based attacks.

Dang Hun mountain is a forbidden ground, first appearing in The Legends of Ren Zu.

Legend held that Verdant Great Sun flew into the sky and plunged to his death.

Grief-stricken upon hearing the news, his father, Ren Zu, sought out Wisdom Gu for answers.

Wisdom Gu quickly replied, "Ren Zu, do not trouble me. Reviving your son is not impossible. If you enter the door of life and death and guide him along the road of life back into the sunlight, he will be resurrected."

"As a living being, you must enter the door of life and death via the road of death. This extraordinary path was created by Fate Gu when departing from Fairness Gu, and is called the path of destiny. Many suffering Gu dwell within the road of death; you must possess Courage Gu so you will not fear their torment."

"Upon reaching Fairness Gu inside the door of life and death, you will already be dead. There you will find the soul of your eldest son, Verdant Great Sun, to lead out along the road of life. The road of life was trodden by Fate Gu when visiting Fairness Gu, also known as the path of destiny."

"Along this path lie three obstacles: Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley, and the Reverse Flow River. To scale Dang Hun Mountain, you must smash gutstones and obtain the aid of guts Gu. To cross Luo Po Valley, you need Faith Gu's help. To traverse the Reverse Flow River, you must push forward ceaselessly without pausing for a single second."

Securing Courage Gu's assistance, Ren Zu entered the road of death within the door of life and death.

In the pitch-black road, Courage Gu's brilliant light repelled the swarming suffering Gu.

As Ren Zu descended, his body paled and turned hollow, gradually becoming a ghost.

At the road's end, amidst the tranquil darkness, he saw Fairness Gu.

Fairness Gu spoke grandly: "Life and death are the world's greatest fairness. Ren Zu, your son is right there."

# Chapter 411: Great Future Plans

Overjoyed to see his son, Ren Zu ran toward him.

Now a white ghost, Verdant Great Sun lay beside a lake, scooping and drinking water with a bowl.

"My son, stop drinking. Come, let us return," Ren Zu called as he approached.

Snatching the bowl, Ren Zu scolded: "Stop drinking! Ghosts who drink from the bewitching lake lose all desire to leave."

Verdant Great Sun refuted: "This is soul calming wine, one of the world's finest wines that cleanses impurities and calms the soul."

"I don't care what wine it is, you must come back with me." Ren Zu pulled Verdant Great Sun's hand, only to find him as unmovable as a mountain.

Verdant Great Sun shook his head: "In life I possessed Reputation Gu and died bathed in glory's light. Upon arriving here, my body grew heavier than a mountain; I cannot take a single step and can only lie here."

Anxious and dismayed, Ren Zu shouted: "Reputation is a burden—cast Reputation Gu away!"

Verdant Great Sun sighed: "We bring no fame or fortune at birth, nor can we take them in death. Reputation Gu left when I died; only Fixed Immortal Travel Gu accompanies me."

Fairness Gu spoke: "Ren Zu, do you still not understand? The two paths in the door of life and death were created by Fate Gu. Life and death are determined by fate! He drinks supreme wine, free from all mortal worries—do you know what a blessing that is?"

Unable to move his son, Ren Zu left the death domain.

This time he took the path of life, leading from darkness into light.

Courage Gu warned: "Suffering Gu are multiplying endlessly. Hurry to Dang Hun Mountain and smash gutstones—to survive, you need guts as well as courage!"

Enduring the tremors in his soul, Ren Zu hurried to Dang Hun Mountain and collected guts Gu.

Passing through Dang Hun Mountain, he arrived at Luo Po Valley.

Luo Po Valley was a maze of winding paths, filled with bewilderment fog that loosened souls and Luo Po wind that sliced them apart.

Ren Zu nearly lost his way entirely, but Faith Gu flew forth and illuminated his path.

With only his soul essence remaining, Ren Zu managed to escape Luo Po Valley.

He reached the Reverse Flow River, the final barrier on the path of life.

However, he forcibly persevered and walked towards the light.

Exhaling in relief, he relaxed and forgot Wisdom Gu's warning, coming to a halt.

That brief pause caused the river to sweep Ren Zu away.

Swept by the river into the depths of Luo Po Valley, Ren Zu was too exhausted to budge, trapped within.

Fang Yuan crushed the final gutstone, groaning in satisfaction.

He felt profoundly refreshed; his severe soul injuries had fully healed, and his soul strength had increased fivefold.

Nearly ten thousand beasts had to perish on Dang Hun Mountain to produce a single gutstone.

With his soul healed, Fang Yuan quietly planned his future without relaxing in the slightest.

"With Dang Hun Mountain, my soul foundation can keep strengthening. Coupled with my past-life experience controlling blood bats, pursuing the enslavement path is an obvious choice."

"However, enslavement path Gu Masters are vulnerable to being beheaded, so I must not slacken in strength path cultivation either!"

"Refining second aperture Gu is ideal—dual apertures allow cultivating both enslavement and strength paths while providing ample primeval essence."

Fang Yuan retrieved the embryonic second aperture Gu from his aperture.

Resembling a golden peanut shell with scarlet veins, this embryonic Gu had a lifespan of forty years.

"I have enough immortal essence and can easily obtain two third watch Gu, but I still need Divine Travel Gu," Fang Yuan pondered.

Since Divine Travel Gu had evolved into Fixed Immortal Travel Gu, a new one could now exist.

The Legends of Ren Zu stated clearly that drinking the world's four finest wines would condense Divine Travel Gu in one's body.

"Southern Border's Fei clan owns Zhuang Si Fei wine, Eastern Sea's Zui Xian Weng holds fine wines, and Northern Plains' Imperial Court possesses long life wine. These great forces or other Gu Immortals likely hold top-grade wines, giving them a far better chance to claim Divine Travel Gu than me."

Thus, Fang Yuan needed to swiftly gather four top-grade wines to refine second aperture Gu.

"However, the most crucial issue is Spring Autumn Cicada. Time flows five times faster here, so its recovery will accelerate drastically. Rebirthing three times was immense luck; I cannot gamble on luck a fourth time. Before it fully recovers, I must secure a success-guaranteeing Gu to safely use it."

# Chapter 412: I like your fear

Hu Immortal blessed land, southern district.

Fang Yuan summoned the rockman tribes to the surface. Seated on a grand green rock altar in black robes with hair unbound, Fang Yuan gazed down at them with deep, dark eyes.

Dozens of rockmen knelt below, including eight chieftains: two grey, three granite, one iron, one green, and one white rockman.

Ores of gold, silver, bronze, and iron lay piled alongside gems, jewels, and Gu worms.

"You wish to reduce the tribute?" Fang Yuan narrowed his eyes, rising and descending the steps toward the rockmen leaders.

"Esteemed Lord Immortal, with recent floods and fires, supplies have grown scarce and life difficult across our tribes. Please show mercy, forgive our hardship, and reduce the tribute slightly," the oldest rockman chieftain pleaded.

"Reduce offerings? Hehehe, of course! In fact, I can exempt you entirely." Fang Yuan smiled warmly.

"On one condition," Fang Yuan added. "You must dig a river from the north to channel water east and halt the spreading fire."

"Digging a river is a massive project, and we rockmen need sleep. Without enough rest, we will die."

Stubborn and proud, rockmen would foolishly refuse demands and attack even Venerables without fear.

"Master, rockmen don't reason. Those offerings were already their limit..." Little Hu Immortal reminded Fang Yuan secretly.

"Limit?" Fang Yuan bared his white teeth in a ruthless laugh. "Insolent rockmen, you dare bargain with me? The land you live on is mine. The dirt you eat is mine. The spirit spring beside your tribe is also mine. Living here makes you my slaves! Digging a new river is not a request or transaction, but an order!"

"Rockmen are born of heaven and earth—we will not be your slaves! Let's relocate; I've had enough of this wretched place!"

"You want to leave?" Fang Yuan sneered coldly. "Do you think you can come and go as you please? The old rules are gone. From now on, I am supreme and my words are heaven's will! You will obey whether you want to or not!"

Roar!

Fang Yuan pushed his palm forward, sending out a golden dragon.

The golden dragon roared, slaying the loudest rockman.

Enraged, dozens of rockmen charged Fang Yuan in furious waves, shaking the ground.

Little Hu Immortal struck, sealing all the Gu worms.

Fang Yuan snickered as he began his slaughter.

Fearless but outmatched, the rockmen were shattered into shards by Fang Yuan, dying pathetically.

But these rock fragments gathered like magnets, forming new rockmen.

Tiny rockmen charged over, and were all slaughtered by Fang Yuan.

When an elder rockman died, its shattered body and soul coalesced into newborn rockmen inheriting fragments of its memory.

After Fang Yuan slaughtered the third wave, silence finally returned.

Only one rockman remained, lying on the ground, shivering.

"What is your name?" Fang Yuan slowly walked towards him.

"My... my name is Yan... Yan Yong." The young rockman stammered.

"Do you know why I left only you alive?" Fang Yuan stood on Yan Yong's head.

"No... I do not know..."

"Because you are terrified. I like your fear and horror of me." Fang Yuan smiled warmly.

# Chapter 413: A show

Three days later, a badly injured Yan Yong returned to his tribe and woke all hibernating rockmen.

"A demonic male immortal has arrived, seeking to enslave us all!"

"We resisted on the spot. Though the immortal was formidable, we fearlessly fought to the death, finally wounding him and forcing his retreat."

"All the other leaders perished; before retreating, the immortal vowed to return with his fox army!"

Leaderless after their chiefs perished, all eight rockman tribes fell into chaos.

Amid their frantic discussions, just as Yan Yong warned, wave after wave of fox packs attacked the rockman tribes.

The rockmen resisted fiercely, but overwhelming fox packs forced the eight tribes to ally and retreat underground for defense.

Recovering through sleep, Yan Yong stepped forward to lead counterattacks.

"The immortal is merely an injured paper tiger, sending these fox packs to their deaths because he cannot fight!"

"The old white rock leader entrusted his tribe to me before dying in my arms!" Yan Yong beat his chest in feigned sorrow.

"Since our old leader entrusted the tribe to you, please lead us white rockmen."

Thereupon, Yan Yong first inherited his tribe's tribe leader position and then white rock tribe.

Over the next month, he took control of the remaining tribes, becoming supreme leader of all eight.

Another half month later, he led the rockmen to repel the fox packs and secure his tribes.

"We must march on the immortal mountain and slay him to secure our peace!"

"Attacking the immortal mountain was a secret the old white rock leader shared before dying."

"He revealed this is the legendary Dang Hun Mountain, where gutsstones can bolster our strength and empower our tribes!"

Swayed by these 'dying words' and Yan Yong's might, the agitated rockmen mounted an expedition against Dang Hun Mountain.

Fang Yuan deliberately stationed a weak defensive line of foxes around Dang Hun Mountain.

At Dang Hun Mountain, Fang Yuan emerged with foxes to stage a 'fierce battle' against the rockmen.

Yan Yong loudly declared the immortal weakened before engaging Fang Yuan in 'decisive combat.'

With the foxes wiped out, a 'defeated' Fang Yuan fled from Yan Yong's assault.

"Wait until I gather immortal essence from the water and fire! That will be your end!" Fang Yuan snarled malevolently before retreating.

The rockmen revered Yan Yong for driving off the immortal, cheering victoriously.

"Tribesmen, do not celebrate yet," Yan Yong called out. "Dang Hun Mountain is demonic ground. The old white rock leader told me we can only enter safely during these few days each year. We must quickly gather the gutsstones and leave within three days!"

Absorbing guts Gu from the stones expanded their souls, triggering the birth of new rockmen.

Three days later, inside the mountain, in Dang Hun palace.

Yan Yong knelt fearfully: "Lord Immortal, three days of guts Gu produced six thousand new rockmen, tripling our population!"

"Good. Now you have enough manpower to dig the river. You remember what to do, or do you need reminding?"

Fang Yuan nodded indifferently. "I give you three months to dig a great river cutting across the northern and eastern regions."

"Three months?" Yan Yong was stunned. "Mighty immortal, rockmen need sleep to nurture our souls. Overexertion will kill us, and digging such a long river in three months leaves no time to rest. Working like this will wipe out our tribes!"

"Hehehe, not completely. By my calculations, over two hundred will survive," Fang Yuan chuckled.

"In three months, I expect a river. If not, I will reveal the truth to your people before killing you. Now get lost." Fang Yuan's tone was cold and unfeeling.

"Master, bringing in these rockmen cost a great price," Little Hu Immortal softly pleaded, unable to bear watching so many perish.

"Don't worry, multiplying them is easy," Fang Yuan said, retrieving a soul-storing burial soul toad from his aperture.

He had used it to harvest souls from fallen rockmen.

Now deflated, its stored souls had already been placed on Dang Hun Mountain to produce fresh gutsstones.

Fang Yuan used some gutsstones to strengthen his soul to six times that of an ordinary person.

And the remaining gutstones were given to the rockmen tribes.

The rockmen never realized their soul growth was fueled by the deaths of their own kin.

# Chapter 414: Conscience of those in power

Yan Yong emerged from Dang Hun Palace onto the mountain.

Gazing at the crystal-pink mountain, Yan Yong exhaled deeply, his dread easing away from Fang Yuan.

He looked at his smiling tribesmen, destined to die of exhaustion digging the river in three months. Yet what could he do?

"That immortal is a demon. Weak as I am, resistance means death. I admit my cowardice—at only a hundred and eighty, I haven't slept nearly enough."

"Tribesmen, our victory is not enough. Will you follow me toward a brighter future?" Yan Yong shouted.

"These past three days, I considered how to deal with the escaped immortal. His immortal essence commands the terrifying fox army. He likely retreated to the northern lake or eastern fire pit. We cannot let him recover!"

Cutting off their discussions, Yan Yong shouted, "Therefore, our only solution is to fill the fire pit and lake with soil, preventing him from recovering his immortal essence!"

"Great leader, the lake is vast and the fire pit scalding hot. Filling them with soil is impossible!" an old rockman protested.

Daring to question him showed insufficient devotion; Yan Yong resolved to work this elder to death.

Another old rockman spoke up: "Brute force won't work. Instead, we can dig a river to channel lake water into the fire pit, neutralizing fire with water."

Yan Yong resolved to assign this clever elder to a defense mission where the fox army would eliminate him.

Yan Yong shouted, "We will dig a river to extinguish the fire, denying the immortal any recovery! The old white rock leader revealed before dying that the northern water and eastern fire are the evil immortal's power source, just as soil nourishes us rockmen!"

After deliberation, the rockmen agreed Yan Yong should oversee digging the canal connecting water and fire.

Observing secretly from behind the scenes, Fang Yuan saw the plan finalized and instructed Little Hu Immortal.

The land spirit unleashed Dang Hun Mountain's power, sending dizzy tremors through the rockmen's souls and felling many young ones.

"Dang Hun Mountain is attacking—flee!" Yan Yong cried, leading his tribesmen away.

Instead of returning home, they marched in grand fashion toward the northern and eastern regions.

From Dang Hun Mountain, Fang Yuan watched the departing rockmen expressionlessly through a smoke cloud.

"Master, have you heard the story of the rockmen?" Little Hu Immortal asked meekly, swaying her tail.

Fang Yuan chuckled. "You want me to treat the rockmen gently?"

"Master is so smart!" Little Hu Immortal's large eyes shone.

"Heh, fear and hatred often surpass gratitude by far."

When Fang Yuan first discovered this rockman group, he had been overjoyed.

Rockmen made excellent excavation slaves, sought after by Gu Immortals for their blessed lands.

With Dang Hun Mountain and enough souls, a single rockman using gutsstones could spawn an entire clan.

Fang Yuan could mass-produce rockmen and trade them as slaves to other Gu Immortals.

Rockmen were fearless and stubborn; most Gu Immortals coaxed them with kindness to maximize their worth.

After dealing with the rockmen, only seven months remained until the sixth earthly calamity.

The northern lake and eastern fire pit were scars from past calamities—the blessed land's greatest vulnerabilities.

Restoring the blessed land was paramount, regardless of rockman casualties. Dang Hun Mountain could always produce more.

# Chapter 415: For tomorrow!

This was the site of the river digging project.

"Lord leader, we cannot continue! Yesterday, three tribesmen died of exhaustion without leaving a single offspring."

An elderly rockmen kneeled before Yan Yong as he cried.

Dying of exhaustion completely dissipated a rockman's soul, leaving nothing behind to birth new young.

"That is why we cannot slow down! The fox attacks are growing—the immortal is regaining essence. We must dig the river to sever his power!"

"These heroes will not die in vain. See those gravestones? Descendants will honor their sacrifice," Yan Yong said, pointing to rows of monuments.

As soon as rockmen began dying, Yan Yong had immediately ordered gravestones built.

Morale surged; though countless rockmen collapsed from exhaustion daily, their spirits remained high.

Adult rockmen excavated while youngsters patrolled, inspecting progress, carving slogans, and erecting gravestones.

These young rockmen were called rock guards, formed by Yan Yong personally.

"Reporting to the leader!" Several young rockmen approached Yan Yong to report the results of their labor.

"Great leader, we excavated another twenty-five kilometers in this segment!"

"Great leader, we sacrificed a hundred and twenty tribesmen—all heroic martyrs!"

"Great leader, we caught three tribesmen slacking off. They disgraced the tribe and must be denounced!"

"Erect gravestones for the fallen, and bind the slackers for public denunciation," Yan Yong said warmly.

Across the excavated sectors, countless rockmen bent their thick backs over the yellow earth.

The canal stretched tens of meters wide across the landscape in a vast, connected line.

"This is the last estrus Gu, go."

Infusing it with primeval essence, Fang Yuan flicked the bean-sized Gu into the air.

The estrus Gu burst into pink powder, raining down over the fox pack below.

Inhaling the powder, the entire fox pack stirred restlessly.

The ordinary foxes in Hu Immortal blessed land had short gestation periods.

Fang Yuan used estrus Gu daily to rapidly bolster his fox army.

Through his hard work, the fox group had multiplied several times.

Yet Fang Yuan cared little, his entire focus on enduring the sixth earthly calamity.

A few months passed quickly.

A river connected the north and east.

The overflowing lake surged down the channel with splashing ripples.

The flood poured into the fire pit, evaporating into rising steam.

Nearly half the black flames were doused, leaving only three burning areas at the edges.

As fire and water neutralized each other, the northern flood eased, and ground surfaced once more.

Though the land remained scarred, the clash of fire and water had stabilized the blessed land's worst wounds.

Yan Yong led the hundred-odd exhausted survivors back to their southern homes.

"Master, what do we do with these clouds?" Little Hu Immortal looked at the dense sky, feeling helpless.

"Ignore them." Fang Yuan looked at the sea of clouds and retracted his gaze.

# Chapter 416: Enduring the Earthly Calamity (1/2)

Several months later.

The fox army gathered, encircling Dang Hun mountain.

Time passed mercilessly, today was the day of the sixth earthly calamity!

The breeze died down. High above, clouds rumbled as a mass of light formed.

In the cloud sea, the light burst open into a massive round white door facing the blessed land.

Amid dazzling light, a massive brownish-yellow monster dropped from the glowing door like a giant boulder.

"Is this a desolate beast calamity?!" Fang Yuan squinted, staring unblinkingly.

One or more desolate beasts would appear, charging toward the central control area to wreak havoc across the blessed land.

As Fang Yuan wondered about its identity, a pair of pincers like bronze poles stretched from the shell.

Nine pairs of legs extended from its flanks, hoisting its heavy body up.

"Swamp crab!" Fang Yuan instantly recognized the desolate beast.

This mountain-sized crab stood a quarter as tall as Dang Hun mountain when raised on its legs.

Its front pincers were capable of crushing boulders or severing a flood dragon in two!

Numerous water and earth path Gu worms lived across its body.

The land spirit immediately used heavenly power to suppress all its Gu worms.

Crucially, it bore no Immortal Gu—otherwise, everything would depend on what Immortal Gu it possessed.

Fully extending its limbs, the swamp crab lumbered toward Dang Hun mountain.

At Fang Yuan's command, mountain hordes of foxes surged like a tide toward the desolate beast.

They clawed and bit at its legs, while tougher golden foxes crashed directly into it.

Yet the crab pressed on undeterred, trampling the ordinary foxes into paste.

He had bred so many foxes as disposable pawns; any accumulated damage they dealt counted.

A barrage of attacks landed on the swamp crab like dazzling fireworks.

Fox hundred, thousand, and myriad beast kings unleashed their Gu worms.

Under the Gu barrage, the mud coating the swamp crab was blown away.

This giant crab, for the first time, stopped its movement.

It spewed massive amounts of mud from its mouth and belly.

In the blink of an eye, an army of a million crabs formed.

"It really is a swamp crab! It can spawn an army of smaller crabs anywhere." Fang Yuan's expression darkened.

The fox groups clashed fiercely with the crab army.

The foxes steadily dwindled against the desolate beast's endless crab swarm.

"Thankfully, I used estrus Gu to breed so many foxes, or my forces wouldn't have been enough!"

In just this short period, Fang Yuan felt dizzy.

Commanding such a massive horde strained his soul to its limits.

With the crab army paving the way, the swamp crab resumed its advance at former speed.

The swamp crab advanced ruthlessly, crushing both foxes and crabs beneath its massive legs.

Covered in a thick shell and having lost its eyes to the deep mire, it had no obvious weak spots.

He could only watch helplessly as the swamp crab got closer!

"Can you teleport it away?" Fang Yuan asked Little Hu Immortal.

"Let me try." Little Hu Immortal activated immortal essence with all her might.

With a swoosh, the giant swamp crab vanished, teleported nine thousand steps away.

"Ma... master, I just expended one bead of green grape immortal essence." Little Hu Immortal reported painfully.

After five minutes, the swamp crab got close again. Land spirit teleported it away once again.

Some crabs got through unguarded areas and charged up the mountain.

Fang Yuan snorted coldly, ordering the land spirit to unleash Dang Hun mountain's might.

Instantly, countless crabs dropped dead with intact bodies but shattered souls.

"Unfortunately, Dang Hun mountain exerts gradual soul pressure; the desolate beast's soul is tough enough to endure it awhile, and I cannot let it ruin this precious forbidden ground."

Soon the swamp crab returned. As it was teleported away a third time, Little Hu Immortal's expression changed.

Without waiting for Fang Yuan to react, she grabbed his arm, and both vanished on the spot.

A fierce lightning bolt struck where they had stood.

It turned into a human-shaped lightning and emitted a loud growl.

This was the blue charm lightning shadow!

# Chapter 417: Enduring the Earth Calamity (2/2)

Clutching its head, the blue charm lightning shadow screamed in pain, flashing wildly before finally settling down.

Clearly, entering Dang Hun mountain had inflicted soul injuries on the lightning figure.

Inside Dang Hun Palace, Fang Yuan watched the smoky scene with an ashen face.

Had the land spirit not teleported him in time, he might already be dead.

*When it rains, it pours.* The blue charm lightning shadow joining the battle made things far worse!

Enraged by the failed sneak attack, the blue charm lightning shadow collided repeatedly into Dang Hun mountain.

Each collision shook Dang Hun Palace and gouged large scorched pits into the mountain.

After dozens of impacts, the lightning shadow's soul was heavily damaged, forcing it to retreat.

Meanwhile, the land spirit had teleported the swamp crab twice more, wasting five beads of green grape immortal essence in total!

The originally endless fox army was now on the brink of extinction.

The desolate beast bore only minor wounds, marching forward as steadily as ever.

Both calamities sought to exhaust the immortal essence, kill the land spirit, and destroy the blessed land.

As Fang Yuan and the land spirit fretted over the crab, the blue charm lightning shadow gave up on Dang Hun mountain to target the blessed land itself.

Not daring to strike the mountain again, it attacked the sky and earth instead.

It destroyed everything in sight, gouging craters everywhere and cracking the sky like a shattered mirror.

"Not good! Master, there is a hole in the blessed land!" Little Hu Immortal spoke hurriedly.

"Sever the area around the hole," Fang Yuan said coldly.

"What?" Little Hu Immortal's eyes opened wide in shock.

If left unpatched, holes would form passages for outside Gu Immortals to invade.

Under Fang Yuan's orders, the land spirit severed each damaged section as holes tore open.

The swamp crab repeatedly charged, forcing repeated teleports until thirteen beads of immortal essence were consumed.

"*Sob sob*, the blessed land has shrunk and so much immortal essence has been lost..." Little Hu Immortal sobbed, tears falling.

"Don't cry!" Fang Yuan coldly shouted, his expression ashen.

"Delaying is pointless; our only hope is killing both calamities! But without an attack-type Immortal Gu, rank five Gu can hardly harm the swamp crab in the short term. My only choice now is to gamble!" Fang Yuan gritted his teeth with crazed determination.

Especially the swamp crab—its defense was formidable, ranking among the strongest desolate beasts. Fang Yuan's rank five Gu were like pebbles against the swamp crab, creating only slight ripples.

Leaving the mountain invited lightning attacks, and giving his Gu to the land spirit was too risky.

Land spirits could die; if destroyed by the lightning shadow, Fang Yuan would not even be able to activate Fixed Immortal Travel.

"Stop teleporting it—let this damned swamp crab attack Dang Hun mountain!" Fang Yuan ordered resolutely. "Release the full might of Dang Hun mountain!"

Dang Hun mountain unleashed its full power as dense fog rose, radiating a soul-shaking force across three thousand steps.

The giant swamp crab soon neared Dang Hun mountain.

Under Dang Hun mountain's power, its sturdy shell offered no defense as fierce soul attacks slowed its advance.

Yet this drove it berserk, doubling its speed as it charged Dang Hun mountain.

Its enormous pincers slammed onto Dang Hun mountain like steel clamps.

As Dang Hun Palace shook violently, dust fell and cracks fractured the walls.

Little Hu Immortal let out a tragic shout: "Not good! That blue charm lightning shadow moved north, openly tearing holes through the sky and earth!"

Corroded by remnant calamity forces, the eastern and northern regions were weaker; the blue charm lightning shadow seized on these vulnerabilities.

"Master, what should we do?" Little Hu Immortal asked in panic.

Fang Yuan's eyes flashed with an ominous glint.

The worsening crisis only stoked his fighting spirit!

"Land spirit, teleport the swamp crab three thousand steps away each time!"

A shorter distance saved immortal essence while keeping the crab within soul attack range.

"Land spirit, sever the entire northern area!" Fang Yuan commanded.

"What?!" Little Hu Immortal was stupefied, hardly believing her ears.

"Do as I say!" Fang Yuan shouted sternly, his gaze fixed on the projection.

Little Hu Immortal's lips trembled as tears fell, and she began crying aloud.

To a land spirit, severing territory was like carving off her own flesh.

Yet Fang Yuan's expression remained ruthless, refusing the slightest compromise.

Unable to disobey her master, Little Hu Immortal endured the pain and severed the entire northern area.

Rampaging at the center of the north, the lightning shadow sensed danger and tried to flee.

Indignant screeches sealed its fate; as the northern territory vanished, the lightning shadow was cast into the outside world.

"Success!" Fang Yuan almost shouted in joy at this scene.

Dang Hun mountain still shook as the swamp crab's robust soul withstood the pressure, relentlessly attacking the mountain.

The closer it drew to Dang Hun mountain, the stronger the soul-shaking power became.

Little Hu Immortal teleported the swamp crab away time and again.

If the desolate beast toppled Dang Hun mountain, Fang Yuan lost; if the mountain held firm, the calamity was defeated.

Pillars crumbled and roof beams snapped across Dang Hun Palace amidst Little Hu Immortal's cries.

Fang Yuan was silently standing with a cold expression.

"Strength, I need more strength!" He clenched his fists, screaming indignantly in his heart.

The swamp crab gradually slowed, finally collapsing dead at Dang Hun mountain's waist.

After an arduous process, the sixth earthly calamity was finally over.

# Chapter 418: Losses and Gains

Fang Yuan walked out of Dang Hun palace.

Pitted with holes and rubble, the pink mountain was strewn with blood, mud, and mingled corpses.

The swamp crab's colossal body lay pinned against Dang Hun mountain's waist like an eye-catching hill.

Behind him, Little Hu Immortal sniffled with red, tear-streaked eyes as she reported:

"Master, we lost 666km2 of land and have only sixty-eight immortal essence beads left. The fox army fell to 310,000, and we lost 700,000 Gu worms."

"Stop crying. Dang Hun mountain did not collapse, so we can start over. The lost land will not hinder our development."

Fang Yuan patted her head: "Soon Dang Hun mountain will produce gutsstones for new rockmen, and with the blue charm exiled, we can develop peacefully. The blessed land will flourish again!"

The swamp crab's shattered soul was absorbed directly into Dang Hun mountain.

"Rejoice, this desolate beast lacked an Immortal Gu, otherwise we might not be standing here," Fang Yuan sighed deeply.

"Land spirit, clean up the battlefield and preserve the crab's corpse. I am going to rest."

"Where is the land spirit?" He stomped his feet, calling.

"Master, I dismantled that crab; we can sell it for a good price!" Little Hu Immortal beamed.

"Oh right, Master, three letters were sent through the loophole on the day of the calamity," Little Hu Immortal said, handing three Gu to Fang Yuan.

They were a rank three lightning symbol paper crane Gu, a rank five letter sending green bird Gu, and a rank three flying sword letter Gu.

Fang Yuan's gaze shone as he took out the letter sending green bird Gu.

The green bird transformed into a letter sent by the rank seven Gu Immortal Feng Jiu Ge!

In a calm tone, Feng Jiu Ge expressed admiration and praise for Fang Yuan before stating his intention—to arrange a battle between Fang Yuan and his daughter, Feng Jin Huang!

Feng Jin Huang wanted a fair fight with Fang Yuan to reclaim her pride and wager the glory of their sects.

"Hmph, you want to battle, do I have to agree?" Fang Yuan scoffed in disdain.

"What a stupid idea. She wants to reclaim her glory, so I must play along? Laughable!" Fang Yuan snorted. Unlike others, he did not fear Feng Jiu Ge. Soon, Feng Jiu Ge would be summoned by Heavenly Court and ascend, making it difficult for him to descend to Central Continent again.

"Yet this father and daughter seem to think I'm an Immortal Crane Sect disciple. What is going on?" Fang Yuan's eyes shone with suspicion.

Fang Yuan retrieved the flying sword letter Gu.

Opening it and taking a look, it was another challenge letter!

The letter cursed Fang Yuan, using Immortal Crane Sect's honor to goad him into accepting.

Fang Yuan looked carefully, lightly smiling: "Oh, it is this rascal Jian Yi Sheng."

A demonic path Gu Immortal on Tian Ti mountain, he was truly a mean, devious coward.

Jian Yi Sheng had coincidentally encountered the blue charm lightning shadow cast onto Tian Ti mountain.

"A Gu Immortal challenging a mortal while speaking of fairness... shameless as ever. But why does he think I belong to Immortal Crane Sect?"

Fang Yuan opened the lightning symbol paper crane Gu with great suspicion.

Opening it, his pupils shrank: "What! Fang Zheng is alive?"

"So that's it. Immortal Crane Sect's He Feng Yang is clever, using this method to eliminate competitors."

"He greatly underestimates me—why would I join Immortal Crane Sect? Still, what the letter offers is exactly what I need now."

He called the land spirit: "Go, open the blessed land slightly, and let the Gu Master who resembles me in."

# Chapter 419: Fang Zheng’s pain

Immortal Crane Sect's elite disciples had already waited an hour at the foot of Tian Ti mountain.

Since Fang Yuan controlled Hu Immortal blessed land, the sect sought to recruit him, offering an elder position if he surrendered it.

If Fang Yuan became an elder, Fang Zheng would have to bow to his enemy whenever they met! What meaning was there in such a life?

"Master, was all my hard work in vain?" Waiting at the foot of Tian Ti mountain to meet Fang Yuan, Fang Zheng fell into deep self-doubt.

Lord Sky Crane quickly consoled him: "Fang Zheng, adjust your mindset. Immortal Crane Sect sacrificed immensely for the Hu Immortal Inheritance, even expending an Immortal Gu! For the sect, we must consider the big picture and set aside personal grudges temporarily. Fang Zheng, understand that Immortal Crane Sect nurtured you. Now that the sect requires sacrifice, you cannot forget your roots!"

"What else could we do? That blessed land contains the forbidden Dang Hun mountain! Its gutstones can elevate our disciples and dramatically boost the sect's strength. Furthermore, Fang Yuan holds the blood skull Gu and fixed immortal travel Gu! These treasures are far too valuable—how could an elite disciple compare?"

Saying so, Lord Sky Crane recalled what He Feng Yang instructed him —

"I know the enmity between Fang Yuan and Fang Zheng. If needed, we can sacrifice Fang Zheng—you can negotiate in his place!"

"Master, you want me to treat this as a trial? I... I will try." Fang Zheng unclenched and reclenched his fists, torn by inner turmoil, pain, and anger.

"Hehe, don't worry too much. Fang Yuan might not be faring well during the blessed land's calamity. Its might is beyond imagination, and despite holding an Immortal Gu, your brother is still a mortal. Soon, he will experience the terror of an earthly calamity. With the blessed land riddled with loopholes and him suffering heavy losses, your chances of success are high," Lord Sky Crane consoled him again.

"The earthly calamity is beginning," muttered He Feng Yang, watching from behind the scenes to guard the disciples and intervene if Fang Yuan failed.

Patches of grassland appeared on Tian Ti mountain, drifting like illusory clouds and mist.

This was a massive loophole in the blessed land, allowing outsiders to see the scene within.

Nearby, Lord Sky Crane called out: "The loophole appeared; send the lightning symbol paper crane Gu in!"

Fang Zheng gritted his teeth, under everyone's supervision, he injected primeval essence and activated the Gu worm.

Lightning symbol paper crane Gu was fast as lightning, flying into the loophole.

Immediately after, the grassland image dispersed into primeval essence. The lightning symbol paper crane Gu circled twice before flying back to Fang Zheng's hands.

"Fang Yuan is discarding a portion of the blessed land entirely! He must fear that Gu Masters will enter once the loophole becomes a tunnel." Slightly shocked, He Feng Yang soon sneered: "Go ahead, let's see how much land you can discard. Abandoning each piece is akin to giving up your own flesh."

# Chapter 420: Meeting of Brothers

Besides Immortal Crane Sect's elite disciples, numerous Gu Immortals were also watching from behind the scenes.

After three attempts, Fang Zheng finally sent the lightning symbol paper crane Gu into the blessed land.

A green bird spread its wings and flew through the loopholes into Hu Immortal blessed land as well.

"A letter sending green bird Gu! What is Feng Jiu Ge trying to do?" Seeing this, He Feng Yang's expression darkened.

Fang Yuan discarded six hundred square kilometers of land; vast grassland projections covered Tian Ti mountain's waist, filling everyone's vision.

At this time, a bright white-gold light appeared.

Within the light stood a thirty-meter-tall red door bearing a rainbow-colored plaque.

Pink clouds gathered and rainbow light shone on Fang Zheng, causing him to vanish in the blink of an eye.

"I reached Hu Immortal blessed land," Fang Zheng realized. Just as during the competition, all his Gu worms were sealed.

A smoky shadow expanded into a mirror before him, showing Fang Yuan seated with his back leaning against a chair.

"My cute little brother, to think I would see you again in Central Continent." Fang Yuan spoke.

Shuddering with rage, Fang Zheng growled: "Gu Yue Fang Yuan, you hopeless demon, you murdered your entire clan! I will kill you personally!"

Saying so, he rushed towards Fang Yuan.

Yet this 'Fang Yuan' was merely a smoky projection; it dissipated as Fang Zheng charged through, then quickly reformed into Fang Yuan's image.

Fang Zheng shouted: "Fang Yuan, you coward! You murdered your entire clan just to preserve your life—how could you do such an outrageous thing?!"

"Hehehe," Fang Yuan laughed heartily, casually leaning back. "My cute little brother, you're as stupid as ever. They were doomed regardless—why shouldn't I live? Without my counterattack, do you think you would be brought to Central Continent? In truth, I saved your life; I am your benefactor."

Ceasing his laughter, Fang Yuan sighed: "Fang Zheng, all these years, you haven't improved one bit; you're just a pawn. Alright, let's talk business. I've read Immortal Crane Sect's letter; drop those ridiculous promises like making me an elder. However, we can proceed with transactions and deals."

Fang Zheng took deep breaths to suppress his killing intent, recalling the sect's instructions: "Our sect is not interested in the foxes or Gu worms in Hu Immortal blessed land, but Dang Hun mountain's gutstones have value. We will send disciples here by batches, you will bring them to Dang Hun mountain..."

"Stop," Fang Yuan cut him off. "I do not believe Immortal Crane Sect's sincerity."

"This is what I want, traded for the swamp crab's corpse. Read the letter for details, then return and consider it."

Once he finished speaking, a small lightning bolt flew and landed in Fang Zheng's hand.

Fang Zheng looked up to speak, but the scenery shifted—he had already been transported out.

"Check around—are there any suspicious things?" Rather than relaxing after Fang Zheng left, Fang Yuan instructed the land spirit.

Because the blessed land could not restrict Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan avoided meeting Fang Zheng in person, worried he might carry one.

The land spirit checked several times and found no problems; only then did Fang Yuan finally relax.

To devour Hu Immortal blessed land alone, Immortal Crane Sect shielded him—boldness expected of one of Central Continent's ten great sects!

"Immortal Crane Sect will naturally negotiate once they realize force is futile, without fear of rumors about allying with the demonic path. After all, Immortal Crane Sect already admitted I am part of their sect—what a meticulous decision."

"Yet this serves my needs too. Though fake, this disciple identity deters rival forces; the letters from Jian Yi Sheng and Feng Jiu Ge prove how precious it is." Fang Yuan didn't mind.

"Originally, I wanted to visit Lang Ya blessed land to snatch connecting heaven Gu, but dealing with Immortal Crane Sect spares me the need. Immortal Crane Sect trades only out of wariness and necessity; I must not give them weaknesses to exploit."

The priority now was stabilizing the situation and leveraging the blessed land's resources to build his own strength!

# Chapter 421: Development of the Rockmen Tribe

He Feng Yang carefully read the detailed content of the lightning letter.

Fang Yuan made only three requests: primeval stones, Gu worms, and materials.

"Requesting five million primeval stones? No problem! Fifty million would be fine," He Feng Yang grinned.

"Huh? Five spring egg Gu?" He Feng Yang was slightly dazed.

Planted deep underground, spring egg Gu could form a spirit spring eye, producing a spirit spring.

"To think a mortal knows the importance of spring egg Gu. Three is enough; the blessed land he manages will eventually become Immortal Crane Sect's property anyway."

"Hmph, I see. This kid is vigilant! Fearing we might tamper with rank five Gu if requested directly, he intends to refine them himself. Gu refinement is intricate; tampered worms would ruin the process, whereas a newly refined Gu is completely clean and secure."

"Huh? He requested relic Gu too—one yellow gold and three purple crystals?" He Feng Yang paused, discerning Fang Yuan's scheme.

A yellow gold relic Gu would push Fang Yuan to rank four peak stage. Upon advancing to rank five initial stage, the three purple crystal relic Gu would elevate him straight to rank five peak stage.

He Feng Yang could easily provide these relic Gu, but letting Fang Yuan advance to rank five so quickly clashed with Immortal Crane Sect's interests!

"Hehehe, I will first hand over one purple crystal Gu to whet his appetite. Since he wants relic Gu most, we'll use them to demand guts Gu!"

"So refining Gu is his main plan. Go ahead. But why does he need star heron bile, toad stones, ascension wine, and other rare materials?"

"We're here; plant the spirit spring at this location," Fang Yuan stopped on the grassland and told Little Hu Immortal behind him.

Little Hu Immortal nodded and raised her palm, releasing a spring egg Gu.

The transaction with Immortal Crane Sect succeeded; Fang Yuan sold the entire swamp crab corpse in exchange for most of what he needed.

Fang Yuan buried these three spring egg Gu near the rockmen tribes.

After the sixth earthly calamity, the few surviving fox groups were not worth nurturing, so Fang Yuan focused entirely on the rockmen tribes.

"Let's return. The rockmen tribes should be rejoicing now," Fang Yuan commanded the land spirit.

The next moment, the two teleported to Dang Hun mountain.

The rockmen struck the gutstones in a frenzy and strengthened their soul.

From only a few hundred rockmen at first, their population expanded tenfold in just a single day!

By the second morning, their population surpassed ten thousand; by the third evening, their numbers reached three hundred thousand.

# Chapter 422: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable

In a huge five-man-tall cauldron, green-blue colored liquid was bubbling inside.

Standing before the large cauldron, Fang Yuan multitasked, controlling it while retrieving a primeval elder Gu.

Fang Yuan expended around half a million primeval stones for this refinement.

Sweat quickly formed on his forehead, he could only call out: "Land spirit."

"Yes!" Little Hu Immortal responded quickly, throwing pieces and pieces of silver ingots into the cauldron.

Fang Yuan breathed heavily: "After refining Gu for three days, it's finally done. Up!"

Silver colored ice broke apart, and Gu worms flew out.

Little Hu Immortal cheered: "Master, you refined one hundred fifty-nine rank three Gu at once! What are these Gu worms? Can we sell them?"

"Hehe, these are silver cup Gu; they are for further refinement, not for sale," Fang Yuan smiled.

In his previous life, a Gu Immortal created silver cup Gu three hundred eighty years from now. Refining them to rank five would yield the Gu Fang Yuan needed.

"Using many guts Gu to strengthen my soul to fifty-two times an ordinary person's, I felt little fatigue refining so many Gu at once." Fang Yuan was extremely pleased with the result.

Three to four days had passed, and numerous gutstones had formed on Dang Hun mountain.

Fang Yuan casually stepped on a few pieces; the emerging guts Gu replenished and strengthened his soul.

He laughed: "Guts Gu is truly divine, its effect amazing. Today, I shall strengthen my soul to the limit."

A hundred times!

"This is the limit; I cannot use more guts Gu!" Fang Yuan bit his tongue, using the pain to stay conscious and resist addiction.

Normal people could only strengthen their soul a hundredfold, known as a hundred man soul!

"Too bad I don't have Luo Po valley, inside it, there is the bewilderment fog that can loosen the soul. There is also the Luo Po wind that can cut the soul. After torture and trials, the soul will become more refined and condensed." Fang Yuan sighed in his heart.

Simply strengthening the soul was merely quantitative; only refinement and purification brought qualitative transformation.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable once said: Dang Hun mountain strengthens the soul best, while Luo Po valley refines it best. Possessing both grants supreme soul path mastery and the power to dominate the world.

Thus, Dang Hun mountain and Luo Po valley became the two sacred lands of soul path.

"Even without Luo Po valley, I can substitute other soul path Gu worms. Divine soul Gu, dragon soul Gu, ice soul Gu, dream soul Gu, moon soul Gu, general soul Gu, grudge soul Gu, poem soul Gu, and others can all refine my soul, allowing me to surpass hundred man soul and reach thousand or ten thousand man soul."

"For now, a hundred man soul suffices; I should focus on trading rockmen." Fang Yuan returned his thoughts to the matter at hand.

In the following days, Fang Yuan continued refining Gu while cleansing his aperture.

A month passed, and aided by the nine eyes liquor worm, Fang Yuan advanced to rank four peak stage.

Next, he refined silver cup Gu and gold cup Gu; after seven days and six nights, he obtained three rank four gold and silver cup Gu.

Setting aside his work, he checked on the rockmen: "So many days have passed; the rockmen should have reproduced by now."

Spurred by the gutstones, the rockmen tribes had expanded rapidly to around three hundred thousand.

Governing a hundred thousand at most, the rockmen split into three groups of roughly a hundred thousand, each settling around a spirit spring.

Fang Yuan handed his newly refined slavery Gu to little Hu Immortal.

Unable to match Fang Yuan's soul, the rockmen were easily enslaved.

In moments, Fang Yuan controlled three rockmen tribe leaders—including Yan Yong—and over a dozen elders.

Instantly, all three hundred thousand rockmen fell under his control.

# Chapter 423: Fang Yuan you little bastard!

"Not selling gutstones, but selling rockmen instead?" He Feng Yang read the letter with a grim expression.

Dang Hun mountain's guts Gu was what Immortal Crane Sect needed most, capable of increasing overall disciple strength by thirty percent.

Furthermore, since gutstones had to be used on Dang Hun mountain, sect disciples could enter Hu Immortal blessed land on that pretext. Over time, Fang Yuan's vigilance would wane, allowing Immortal Crane Sect to lay traps inside.

Despite his battle strength, He Feng Yang could not act. Fang Yuan hid like a tortoise inside the blessed land and could flee anytime via fixed immortal travel Gu; wary of these trump cards, Immortal Crane Sect dared not attack.

Several months had passed outside since the last transaction, giving Fang Yuan over a year inside the five-times-faster blessed land.

"With these rockmen, I can show results to the elders, shut Lei Tan up, and buy myself breathing room," He Feng Yang exhaled heavily, steadying himself.

Narrowing his eyes with a cold smile, he thought: "Don't be smug, Fang Yuan. Tit for tat—if you refuse to sell guts Gu, I won't sell relic Gu. You want yellow gold and purple crystal relic Gu? No way in hell!"

Fang Yuan reclined in his chair, reading Immortal Crane Sect's reply.

In his letter, He Feng Yang agreed to the deal while reiterating his goal to buy guts Gu, offering relic Gu or assistance against the seventh earthly calamity in exchange.

Admitting He Feng Yang into Hu Immortal blessed land was more dangerous than the calamity itself, making it impossible.

"I will never sell guts Gu, but selling rockmen keeps Immortal Crane Sect hooked safely. Still, I must expand business beyond them," Fang Yuan considered.

"This profit eases He Feng Yang's pressure. He covets my land, but I need time to grow. Once I become a Gu Immortal, why should I fear Immortal Crane Sect?" Fang Yuan gave a faint laugh.

Reading on, He Feng Yang set a transaction time and requested Fang Yuan open the door to receive a hole earth Gu.

In this massive transaction, Fang Yuan would sell sixty thousand rockmen, but they could not leave through the blessed land's entrance.

This Gu was rank five and consisted of paired main and sub Gu.

Its primary function was creating a tunnel connecting two locations, allowing bidirectional travel between the main and sub Gu.

"Transferring these rockmen requires hole earth Gu. But fearing traps in yours, I would rather refine my own."

Fang Yuan leaked Spring Autumn Cicada's aura to refine flying sword letter Gu, quickly penning a reply to He Feng Yang.

Half a day later, He Feng Yang opened the letter, finding a long list of Gu worms and ingredients.

"You refuse my hole earth Gu claiming you improved the recipe and want to refine it yourself?" He Feng Yang was furious.

"Bullshit! Hole earth Gu's recipe has been known for five centuries—you think you can improve it? Fang Yuan is far too vigilant. He wants to extort me so I won't dare reject his deals again. I know without looking that relic Gu, spring egg Gu, or rare strength path Gu are on this list... eh? None?"

He Feng Yang hesitated: "Judging by this list, he really intends to refine Gu. With decent luck, these materials suffice for three hole earth Gu. Did he truly improve the recipe? No, Fang Yuan is a mere mortal—how could he? Unless a Gu Immortal backs him?"

# Chapter 427: Just take me
