The wolf group gathered once more, launching a relentless charge at Dong Fang tribe's first line of defense.

This intense battle cost the pack dearly; two hundred and eighty thousand wolves died in a short period!

"Wolf King Chang Shan Yin, such a ruthless heart you have, do you intend to spare no one?!" Dong Fang Yu Liang's expression was grim. The wolf pack's heavy casualties had drastically consumed the Dong Fang army's primeval essence.

"Retreat!" Helplessly, Dong Fang Yu Liang could only send down the command to retreat.

Just as Fang Yuan proclaimed, Dong Fang tribe's first line of defense fell in a quarter of an hour. Leaving crippled Gu Masters to cover their retreat, Dong Fang Yu Liang swiftly led the survivors toward the second defense line.

"My wolf group is exhausted and unfit to pursue them." Fang Yuan withdrew his wolves, clearing the way for the Hei tribe army to advance.

"I sustained some injuries in battle; you guys pursue and kill them all. But be careful, that Dong Fang lad definitely made preparations." Staying in the main tent, Hei Lou Lan dispatched Hao Ji Liu, Pan Ping, the Wang tribe leader, and others to pursue.

Yet the moment the troops crossed the defense line, an intense explosion suddenly erupted.

*BOOM!* Like a crack of thunder, dozens of Gu Masters were instantly fried, leaving behind scorched flesh and broken limbs.

"It is charred thunder potato Gu! Dong Fang Yu Liang buried large numbers of them under the defense line!" the investigative Gu Masters reported in the main tent.

"I can see that!" With an exceedingly dark expression, Hei Lou Lan waved his hand for the scouts to leave.

Before the battle, Dong Fang Yu Liang had deliberately sent a war challenge. Listening to Sun Shi Han, Hei Lou Lan delayed for several days until his rear army assembled, giving Dong Fang Yu Liang the opportunity to execute this plan.

"We gained a massive victory today; that Dong Fang lad is merely delaying his death. I will enjoy killing him later!" Pacifying himself, Hei Lou Lan began managing postwar affairs.

Unwilling to waste precious time, Fang Yuan casually excused himself from the main tent and returned to his large lizard house Gu to cultivate.

"The Wolf King wasn't injured in the blast...?" Listening to the investigative Gu Master's report, Dong Fang Yu Liang felt deeply regretful.

After this battle, he regarded Fang Yuan as his primary threat, rating him even above Hei Lou Lan.

Watching the battle conclude from Ni Yu blessed land, Dong Fang Chang Fan withdrew his gaze and gathered the table's smoke into his sleeves.

Even without deducing, he could see Dong Fang Yu Liang was at an absolute disadvantage; unless Hei Lou Lan made a major blunder, Dong Fang Yu Liang's hopes of reaching the Imperial Court were slim.

# Chapter 516: Battle Merit Board

The red cloud surged overhead, radiating burning heat toward Fang Yuan.

Sitting cross-legged on a mat with eyes closed, Fang Yuan mentally held the fire cloud together.

"It is time." Calculating the moment, he opened his eyes and took out a wine vat.

The wine vat was filled with dark blue liquid that shimmered like moonlight on the sea.

"Descend," Fang Yuan spoke softly, and the fire cloud descended completely into the wine vat.

The merging of fire and water instantly produced thick black smoke.

Fang Yuan repeatedly flicked his finger, throwing Gu worm after Gu worm into the wine vat. The wine vat kept on shaking for two-three minutes before finally calming down.

Gazing into the vat, Fang Yuan saw only black mud; the Gu worms had fully merged into a semi-finished product hidden at its center.

"Rise." Fang Yuan cautiously poured his primeval essence.

The surface of the black mud split open as a glossy green sprout emerged, rapidly growing into a small sapling.

"Open," Fang Yuan shouted softly, pouring large amounts of primeval essence into the tree.

The green fist slowly opened, revealing a Gu worm in its palm.

This Gu possessed an oval dark brown carapace and a majestic horn on its head, giving it a thick, powerful appearance.

A trace of joy flashed in Fang Yuan's eyes.

This was the all-out effort Gu; after three failed attempts, he had finally succeeded on his fourth try.

Rank four all-out effort Gu had four pairs of legs and was larger in size, over two times bigger than its rank three counterpart. And because it was refined in Northern Plains, it became a Northern Plains Gu and did not suffer from suppression, thus letting out a genuine rank four aura.

"With this rank four Gu, most of my strength path battle strength is restored. I must now prepare its rank five recipe. With access to treasure yellow heaven and Lang Ya blessed land, obtaining the rank five recipe of all-out effort Gu is well within reach."

Storing the Gu into his aperture, Fang Yuan stepped out of the lizard house Gu.

Countless Gu Masters bustled between tents, exchanging Gu worms at supply camps or constructing defenses.

Eight days had passed since the great battle with Dong Fang alliance army.

"Subordinate greets Lord Wolf King, please come this way." When Fang Yuan arrived at the supply camp, a smiling female Gu Master led him into a Gu house.

"Lord Wolf King is mighty, you rank first on the battle merit list!" The young, beautiful female Gu Master handed Fang Yuan a scroll with reverent worship.

Unrolling the scroll, Fang Yuan saw Chang Shan Yin at the top with over a hundred thousand battle merits.

Opening the scroll further, Hei Lou Lan was listed beneath him with over eighty thousand battle merits.

Fang Yuan set the scroll aside. Observing his reaction, the female Gu Master handed him a Gu worm.

This was rank four east window Gu, an information path Gu, used to store information.

East window Gu glimmered, pouring an enormous amount of information into Fang Yuan's mind.

The inventory held vast goods: Gu worms of every path, beasts, vegetation, primeval stones, variant humans, and Gu recipes.

Though Fang Yuan could connect to treasure yellow heaven, trades there required immortal essence stones—unsuitable for his current needs.

Moreover, purchasing Northern Plains Gu worms in treasure yellow heaven risked exposing clues to Old Man Yan Shi.

"Among my strength path Gu worms, all-out effort Gu has been raised to rank four and adapted to Northern Plains. Yet the rest of my strength path Gu are from Southern Border and suppressed in Northern Plains."

"To remove the regional suppression, I must advance them in Northern Plains, but that requires too much investment."

# Chapter 517: Lurking Soul Coat Gu

Advancing bitter strength Gu, expend strength Gu, and charging crash Gu to rank five was a massive project requiring immense materials and Gu worms.

"My enslavement path Gu originated from Chang Shan Yin; almost all are rank four, making advancement to rank five in a short time extremely difficult. I need to focus on gathering recipes just in case."

"As for my strength path Gu, those originate from Southern Border; rather than refining them, it might be better to make direct purchases. After all, these Gu are not my vital Gu, so if the refinement fails, they will perish. And if I want to refine again, I will have to accumulate them again."

Though only one rank five Gu was listed, rank four Gu were plentiful, including bitter strength Gu, tusita flower, and primeval elder Gu.

Fang Yuan opted for the next best choice, taking two pairs of rank three horizontal charge Gu and vertical crash Gu to fuse himself.

Self-reliance Gu was a rare, ideal match for strength path Gu Masters. Hei tribe's vast list of goods had one, but it was only rank two—lower than Fang Yuan's.

"Without strength qi Gu, I lack ranged strength attacks. Yet with two apertures, my dual cultivation of enslavement and strength paths allows them to complement each other."

"For now, I can only try to gather rank four and five recipes for strength qi Gu. Qi path is extinct; though available in treasure yellow heaven, their prices are high. My best hope lies in Lang Ya blessed land. Yet the Lang Ya land spirit is difficult to deal with; obtaining the recipe will cost a steep price."

"Enslavement Gu Masters fear leader-beheading tactics, which strength path defends against. Conversely, enslavement path covers strength path's weaknesses. There is no need for strength qi Gu."

Following this, Fang Yuan spent battle merits to exchange for numerous space path Gu and large amounts of refinement materials.

Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable had sealed Luo Po Valley; entering required a rank five open door Gu rather than ordinary methods.

Fang Yuan soon saw his battle merits drop by more than half, falling from first place on the merit board.

"Lord Wolf King, your exchanged goods will be delivered gradually today and completed by dawn," the female Gu Master softly informed.

Fang Yuan nodded and was about to leave when she whispered: "Lord Wolf King, wait a moment. The tribe leader specifically instructed me to reserve a Gu recipe perfectly suited for you."

Fang Yuan realized this was Hei Lou Lan reciprocating for his restraint regarding Hei Xiu Yi's earlier desertion.

With lurking soul coat Gu concealing his soul fluctuations, he could mobilize his wolf pack at full strength while hiding.

Fang Yuan used all his remaining battle merits and barely obtained it.

Skimming the recipe, he saw the refinement difficulty was not high, but the steps were monumental and costly, especially one procedure requiring large quantities of fresh beast skins.

"The tribe leader said if merits are insufficient to hire refinement masters, you may borrow five hundred thousand," she added.

Fang Yuan nodded and borrowed five hundred thousand battle merits on the spot.

Soon after, several assignments from the Wolf King stirred the quieted camp back into a clamor.

Several days later, Fang Yuan's strength path broke through hundred jun, and he had received ten thousand rank one lurking soul coat Gu.

After resting and reorganizing for a week, Hei tribe army struck camp and advanced toward Dong Fang tribe's defense line.

"Dong Fang Yu Liang, you are surrounded and your defeat is certain. A wise man submits; surrender, and the chief military advisor position remains yours."

Hei Lou Lan stood atop his twin-headed rhino, his voice echoing across the battlefield.

# Chapter 518: Famous

Facing Hei Lou Lan's surrender offer, Dong Fang Yu Liang remained silent.

Despite his brilliant schemes and predictive initiative, the overwhelming disparity in power had brought them to this point.

Even with his killer move Seven Star Light, the primeval essence drain was unsustainable against Hei tribe's numbers.

"An enslavement path Gu Master might salvage this, yet even they must fear decapitation tactics. Even Wolf King Chang Shan Yin does not dare roam alone with his pack away from the army. Only by ascending to Gu Immortal can one truly reign above mortals," Dong Fang Yu Liang sighed inwardly.

Before the two armies, multiple battle rings formed as experts clashed. "I am Pan Ping, who will battle me?" Exuding a fierce aura, Pan Ping entered the field as the thirteenth challenger with Hei Lou Lan's permission.

Most of his rank four experts had perished, while the survivors held back their strength to preserve themselves.

The injured Tang tribe leader Tang You stepped forward, taking the field despite his son Tang Fang's worries.

Reaching the defense walls, Tang You took the field against Pan Ping.

Suddenly, Pan Ping burst forward and drew the scimitar at his waist.

The next moment, Tang tribe leader was beheaded!

"Tang tribe leader Tang You has been slain by me, Pan Ping!" Pan Ping shouted with bloodthirsty eyes, raising the severed head.

By slaying a peer expert, Pan Ping won great fame, drawing even the resting Fang Yuan's fleeting glance.

Hei Lou Lan laughed loudly, ordering fine wine brought to reward Pan Ping.

He had obtained this Gu by chance at an inter-tribal market, buying the scimitar merely out of interest because it looked beautiful.

Though ignorant of its true name, its razor-sharp attack had executed many strong foes for him.

# Chapter 519: Just a game

Following female Gu Immortal Tan Bi Ya, a new guest arrived in the blessed land.

"Junior Hei Bai pays respects to Senior Dong Fang." The visitor was Hei tribe's rank six Gu Immortal.

Dong Fang Chang Fan shook his head: "We wisdom path Gu Masters gather every piece of information to deduce. Though dazzlingly talented, Liu Yi Feng failed when charging toward Gu Immortal realm. Among that generation, you alone remained standing—the famed 'Hei tribe rockman'."

"Becoming a Gu Immortal is as hard as ascending to heaven. Now my hopes rest on this child." Dong Fang Chang Fan pointed his index finger, and colorful smoke rose from the stone bench, displaying the live battle at Cao Fu.

Coincidentally, the two Gu Immortals saw Pan Ping's scimitar flash, beheading Tang tribe leader.

Hei Bai gasped softly: "Interesting. If I am not mistaken, this is sole blade Gu. Once activated, it ignores all defenses of the same rank. Created by Gu Immortal Blade Demon, it takes the form of blade light and must reside on a blade. It feeds on blades, gradually reducing its host weapon to dust."

Dong Fang Chang Fan nodded: "Indeed. Sole blade Gu reaches rank six at most. Blade Demon used it to hold his own, unchallenged, until he finally lost to Butterfly Sword Immortal. It seems this lucky lad obtained one of Blade Demon's gifts."

As a rank seven Gu Immortal, he was an undeniable northern plains titan and Dong Fang tribe's pillar.

Urgently seeking an heir, Dong Fang Yu Liang was the best candidate he had found.

Hei Bai understood this would be his final meeting with this legendary northern plains Gu Immortal.

Eventually, Dong Fang Yu Liang challenged Hei Lou Lan, entering the battle himself.

Empowered by the night, waves of night wolves under Fang Yuan's control broke through Dong Fang army's final defense line.

"Dong Fang Yu Liang has few flaws, save for overprotectiveness toward his sister, having held back a portion of troops to guard her. Thus, Dong Fang army became far weaker against Hei tribe. Otherwise, this first battle might not have ended so decisively. Hehehe, forgive the embarrassment, Hei Bai."

"Dong Fang Yu Liang did remarkably well preserving his tribe's strength," Hei Bai noted.

"Indeed," Dong Fang Chang Fan sighed. "Other tribe members matter little, but we are all descendants of Ancestor Giant Sun. He established the Imperial Court contest precisely to weaken other tribes and preserve our bloodline. Yet even Giant Sun Immortal Venerable perished when his lifespan ended. In this world, what can truly be immortal..."

Calming his emotions, Dong Fang Chang Fan laughed softly, extending his palm: "Alright, let's get to business."

"Yes." Hei Bai retrieved a list from his storage Gu and handed it over.

Having lost and become captives, Dong Fang tribe could redeem themselves by paying resources per Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's rules.

Showing no resentment, Dong Fang Chang Fan nodded: "Winner takes all; since we failed, this price is fair. We agree."

A giant light ring suddenly appeared in the battlefield's night sky.

Receiving the reparations and surrendered tribes, Hei Lou Lan's military strength surged by half.

"We will meet again." Accepting the outcome, Dong Fang Yu Liang calmly bid Hei Lou Lan farewell and led his tribesmen through the light door.

Some chased fame, while others grieved in agony. As a participant in this vast game, Fang Yuan watched coldly, calculating his own moves.

# Chapter 520: Stealing Shoes (1/2)

Seated on his cushion, Ma tribe's young leader Ma Ying Jie bowed his head, assisting his father with the alliance army's administrative affairs.

"Report!" an investigative Gu Master called from outside the tent.

Ma Ying Jie set aside his documents: "Come in."

Apologizing profusely, the scout changed shoes and entered, dropping to one knee: "Subordinate greets Young Tribe Leader. I have brought important information regarding Yu Tian."

"In past Imperial Court contests, the first battle is most crucial for establishing foundations. The defeated are almost certainly eliminated, rarely reversing the situation. Hei tribe has won their first battle, while Ma and Song tribes remain deadlocked..."

After Fei tribe's destruction, the bewildered Fei Cai had been chosen as Ma Ying Jie's personal servant, escaping his tribesmen's grim fate.

Fei Cai held the investigative Gu Master's worn shoes, hesitating before stuffing the other pair into his shirt.

Squatting by the pond, he washed the worn shoes so intently that he failed to notice someone behind him.

"Hey, big dummy, why are you washing shoes so seriously?" A small hand roughly patted Fei Cai's shoulder.

Startled, Fei Cai turned to see the jade-like young girl, Zhao Lian Yun.

Zhao Lian Yun shoved his head away, muttering unhappily, "Hey blockhead, don't get so close. Haven't you heard of propriety between sexes?"

Nearly shoved into the water, Fei Cai paid it no mind, secretly pulling open his shirt to reveal the hidden shoes. "Look, what's this?" he asked, seeking praise.

Fei Cai said, "Lady Xiao Yun, didn't you say you lacked primeval stones? These exquisite shoes can be sold on the black market for primeval stones."

Zhao Lian Yun raised her brows, seeing him in a new light. "Oh wow, blockhead, you actually thought to embezzle public property? Impressive! But how much could these shoes even sell for? My daily allowance is ten times that. I appreciate the thought, but sell them yourself and replace your filthy rags."

A group of old servants shouted arrogantly, pouring out of the entrance to search for Fei Cai.

Fei Cai paled in panic, but Zhao Lian Yun snapped: "Fool, you've been framed! Follow me!"

She pulled him into the alleys, but the exits were blocked.

Zhao Lian Yun stomped her feet, fuming inwardly: *"Was it easy finding an insider for information?! Where else could I find a dummy like Fei Cai nowadays? Wherever there are humans, there's conflict and scheming. No way! I won't take this lying down—you're courting death trying to harm my informant!"*

"Big dummy, you're in luck—I just bought silk from the market," Zhao Lian Yun said, pulling high-grade silk from her pocket.

Overjoyed, they encircled him, only for Fei Cai to clench his fists and thrash them like a madman.

# Chapter 521: Stealing Shoes (2/2)

Fei Cai glared furiously and kicked the old slave before him. "Filthy bastard, I'm going to see the young tribe leader—out of my way!"

Flanked by the old slaves, Fei Cai marched toward the young tribe leader's tent.

Ma Ying Jie stood at his tent's entrance, displeased after discovering his shoes missing.

Remembering Zhao Lian Yun's instructions, Fei Cai strode forward with head held high.

"This subordinate greets young tribe leader," Fei Cai said clearly, kneeling on the ground.

Ma Ying Jie snapped displeasedly, "Did you steal my shoes?"

"I wouldn't dare steal Lord's shoes even with a hundred guts," Fei Cai denied flatly.

"He's lying! His clothes are bulging—check him and see!" the old slaves shouted from behind.

Fei Cai opened his shirt, revealing the shoes wrapped inside.

Recognizing his shoes, Ma Ying Jie smiled coldly. "Great, the proof is here. Such a confident thief is truly rare."

"I implore young tribe leader to investigate thoroughly." Fei Cai placed the shoes down respectfully and pressed his forehead to the ground.

Killing a slave was trivial, but Ma Ying Jie cultivated a 'wise and benevolent' reputation to become a sage ruler.

"I have always been fair," Ma Ying Jie said. "Fei Cai, explain yourself."

Fei Cai exhaled in relief, bolstered by Zhao Lian Yun's accurate prediction.

"My father died in our tribe's internal strife, so young tribe leader wiping out Fei tribe avenged me. Young tribe leader is so wise and benevolent—how could I repay benevolence with enmity?"

Pleased by the praise, Ma Ying Jie asked gently, "Then did you have another reason?"

Fei Cai shook his head. "I only wanted to repay you. As a mortal, I cannot fight for young tribe leader. I am foolish and can only clean and arrange shoes. Left outside in the cold, your shoes would freeze your feet. So I used my savings to buy silk, wrapping them against my chest so your feet wouldn't feel cold."

"Eh? So that was it!" Ma Ying Jie was astonished.

*'Fei Cai is truly a devoted servant.'* Ma Ying Jie's gaze softened.

Fei Cai suddenly kowtowed. "Young tribe leader, I have sinned!"

"Eh? What sin have you committed?" Ma Ying Jie asked, smiling openly.

Fei Cai replied, "I forgot it would inconvenience you when leaving. Please punish me!"

Ma Ying Jie sighed. "Fortunately, I didn't wrongfully blame a loyal servant."

"Young tribe leader, please investigate thoroughly," Fei Cai added. "These old slaves have stolen shoes repeatedly. Because I refused their incitement, they resent me. I request young tribe leader to investigate and grant me justice!"

He immediately summoned an investigative Gu Master, ordering a full inquiry into the matter.

The investigative Gu Master worked swiftly, uncovering the truth within moments.

Exposed, the old slaves fell to their knees, begging for mercy.

Ma Ying Jie snorted. "Flattering superiors and bullying subordinates—you slaves dared deceive me! You deserve death, but considering your long service since my childhood, I will spare your worthless lives. You are banished to the supply camp to serve the army. Clean the faeces and latrine!"

"As for you..." Ma Ying Jie smiled at Fei Cai. "As punishment for taking my shoes, you are appointed head of the slaves!"

Fei Cai was stunned before realizing Ma Ying Jie's 'punishment' was actually a promotion!

Ma Ying Jie waved his hand. "Now get out and serve me properly!"

"What? You became the head of the slaves?" Zhao Lian Yun's eyes widened in shock upon hearing the news.

# Chapter 522: Rank Five Amplify Effect Gu

She said gently, "Big dummy, now that you're servant leader, you must work hard."

Kicking his leg, Zhao Lian Yun barked, "Idiot, your situation is even more precarious now! Countless people will target you—even Gu Masters!"

Fei Cai was shocked: "Then what should I do?"

"Idiot," Zhao Lian Yun snorted. "With the old servants gone, you must recruit new subordinates to manage."

"You also need to learn the young tribe leader's habits from those old servants," she added.

"Reduced to the lowest slaves, they will fear your revenge and tell you everything. And if not, I have ways to make them spill everything!"

Cao Fu, Hei tribe camp.

In the supply camp, Fang Yuan held the east window Gu, silently reviewing the inventory.

An attending female Gu Master waited aside for his decision.

Following Dong Fang tribe's reparations, the exchange inventory had increased tenfold.

Fang Yuan had arrived immediately to claim the best items before others.

"Oh? A rank four self-reliance Gu?" Fang Yuan was stirred to find the very Gu he coveted.

Self-reliance Gu was rare. His rank three version from Southern Border had been suppressed to rank two, and lacking the recipe, he couldn't advance it.

He was determined to claim this rank four version.

Most appealing of all was the refine essence spirit Gu.

Refine essence spirit Gu converted physical flesh essence into energy that healed the soul.

It was far superior to standard soul-healing Gu, previously bolstering Dong Fang Yu Liang's wisdom path deductions.

As for Fang Yuan, this Gu suited him even more.

Dual-cultivating enslavement and strength path, Fang Yuan had a strong body but an easily fatigued soul. Refine essence spirit Gu formed the perfect bridge between them.

Fang Yuan took both the Gu and its recipe.

Scanning further, Fang Yuan found over a dozen amplify effect Gu.

A rule path worm, amplify effect Gu supplemented other Gu to magnify their effects.

Higher ranks yielded greater effects at the cost of higher primeval essence consumption.

Hei tribe had only one rank five amplify effect Gu, alongside one rank four, three rank three, and several rank two Gu.

Fang Yuan chose the rank five Gu, which would quintuple a worm's power.

"Lord Wolf King, taking so many Gu may exceed your battle merits..." the female Gu Master tactfully reminded him.

"I know. One is a rank five amplify effect Gu, and refine essence spirit Gu is Dong Fang tribe's specialty," Fang Yuan replied understandingly.

"Advance me another five hundred thousand merits."

"Lord, you still owe three hundred thousand," she gasped. "Rules require settling old debts before borrowing again."

Fang Yuan replied nonchalantly, "Rules can be changed. Lend me eight hundred thousand—I'll speak to Hei Lou Lan personally. Now hand them over!"

# Chapter 523: Tai Bai Yun Sheng

Mirror lake.

Ma tribe and Song tribe had officially started their battle.

Both sides had erected three to four defensive lines before engaging.

From his seat in the main tent, Ma tribe leader Ma Shang Feng gazed grimly at Song tribe's dense, spirited formation; though Ma tribe had superior numbers, victory would not come easily.

Pondering a moment, Ma Shang Feng smiled at Cheng Hu. "Cheng Hu, go out first and boost our army's morale."

Overjoyed, Cheng Hu bowed and rushed to the front line.

"I am Cheng Hu! Who dares come die?" Cheng Hu challenged loudly.

After barely three moves, Cheng Hu suddenly roared, his entire body blazing with dazzling orange light.

When the light faded, he had transformed into an elephant-sized striped tiger king!

As a transformation path Gu Master, Cheng Hu could manifest tiger claws, tail, or skin—this full transformation was his killer move!

Such was the advantage of transformation path: collecting the corresponding Gu worms granted a Gu Master at least one killer move.

The tiger king directly bit apart Su Yi's head.

And on another battlefield...

Luo Bo Jun looked around and smiled bitterly. "Retreat where? This is our final defense line. Against Liu Wen Wu, none of our lines lasted over three days. They're far too strong—we might as well surrender!"

Liu tribe alliance had won their first battle!

Now, they would absorb the captives and enemy forces to bolster their strength before advancing.

Meng Qiu.

Nu Er Tu stood with hands clasped behind him and head held high, surrounded by majestic mutated leopards.

In contrast, his opponent Jiang Bao Ya—an acclaimed enslavement path master of Northern Plains—was sweating profusely, pale as paper.

"Jiang Bao Ya, you've lost. Do you know why? Your rat group is too bloated at six hundred and fifty thousand. Armies and beast groups value quality over sheer numbers. Now, become the stepping stone for my fame in Northern Plains!" Nu Er Tu spoke calmly, his voice echoing in everyone's ears.

Playing with the fire in his hand and morphing it into various shapes, he narrowed his eyes at the surrounding Gu Masters, his voice cold and cruel amidst the blazing inferno: "It is your honor to be defeated by my supreme fire path. Surrender, otherwise... all of you and this lowly grass shall turn into ashes."

After Hei tribe's victory over Dong Fang tribe, major battles concluded across Northern Plains.

After reorganizing at Cao Fu and expanding his army by sixty percent with captives, Hei Lou Lan resumed the expedition.

This time, his target was Guan Xi.

Seven days later, Hei tribe army confronted Gu tribe army.

Gu tribe suffered an initial crushing defeat, retreating to their main camp.

Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily, advancing his army with crushing momentum.

Yet at the final battlefield, he was dumbstruck, asking his subordinates: "How is there a mountain here?"

Gu tribe had piled stones into a mountain, garrisoning atop the high ground with countless traps to defend to the death.

Hei tribe attacked repeatedly but was repelled each time, leaving behind numerous corpses.

Fang Yuan watched indifferently, committing only token wolf forces. The steep terrain hindered the wolves, slowing the battle considerably.

Gu tribe continually added stones, expanding the mountain.

Hei Lou Lan fumed: "Gu Guo Long is obstinate. When I win, I will trample him to death!"

"Had I known, I wouldn't have come here to chew on such a hard bone!" Hei Lou Lan was considering retreat when a figure emerged from the camp.

Holding a letter, he approached Hei Lou Lan: "This old man Tai Bai Yun Sheng received benefactor's letter and came to lend you a hand."

Overjoyed, Hei Lou Lan grasped his hands: "With old sir helping us, we can definitely succeed!"

# Chapter 524: Number one in prestige and merit

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was tall and aged, with white temples and deep wrinkles.

Past eighty, his eyes held gentle pity and detachment from the mortal world.

A solitary righteous Gu Master, his reputation for benevolence and immense prestige far surpassed Chang Shan Yin, Hei Lou Lan, and Liu Wen Wu.

Years ago, Hei tribe supreme elder Hei Bai had rescued Tai Bai Yun Sheng repeatedly. Observing the predicament, Hei Bai had written requesting his assistance.

Knowing his abilities, an overjoyed Hei Lou Lan hosted a banquet in his honor.

At dawn, Hei Lou Lan deployed his army and requested Tai Bai Yun Sheng to make his move.

Under expectant gazes, Tai Bai Yun Sheng walked forward toward the towering mountain.

Alliance leader Gu Guo Long looked down from the summit toward the mountain's base.

Depleted by defeats, Gu Guo Long had decided to submit to Liu tribe.

Liu Wen Wu was benevolent and widely respected; Gu Guo Long had already sent a secret letter offering allegiance.

"Lord Liu Wen Wu is leading reinforcements. As long as I hold out for seven days, the crisis will pass."

As Gu Guo Long encouraged himself inwardly, Tai Bai Yun Sheng slowly extended his hands.

As he slowly channeled primeval essence, a faint silver light blossomed from his hands. It grew brighter and brighter, turning so dazzling within seconds that none could look at it directly.

"Mountain as before," Tai Bai Yun Sheng chanted, his voice resonating through the air.

On the summit, a shocked Gu Guo Long gasped: "Tai Bai Yun Sheng!"

The silver light erupted into a pillar, striking the mountain peak.

Under the silver light, the massive stones beneath Gu tribe melted away like snow, vanishing rapidly.

With the ground gone, Gu tribe's troops plummeted hundreds of feet in a crushing defeat.

The collapsing mountain and Tai Bai Yun Sheng's towering prestige completely shattered their will to fight.

"Tai Bai Yun Sheng's moves are extraordinary!" Hei Lou Lan laughed wildly.

In Fang Yuan's memories, Tai Bai Yun Sheng joined Hei tribe here, providing immense assistance to Hei Lou Lan.

Yet disgusted by Hei Lou Lan's brutality, Tai Bai Yun Sheng would later ascend to Gu Immortal and refuse to become Hei tribe's external elder.

"Kill these bastards who dared resist!" Hei Lou Lan shouted.

Halting his attack, Tai Bai Yun Sheng transmitted his voice: "Alliance leader, heaven cares for life; why slaughter them? It is better to absorb Gu tribe's army. I am willing to persuade them on your behalf!"

Though boiling with killing intent, Hei Lou Lan had to give face to Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Hei Lou Lan replied: "I heed old sir's words, but I will send six rank four experts to escort you!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng nodded and climbed the mountain under heavy escort.

Given his reputation, enemy troops spontaneously parted as he climbed.

"I never thought I would meet my benefactor at such a time," Gu Guo Long laughed bitterly, stepping forward in greeting.

Persuaded by Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Gu Guo Long surrendered.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng descended after merely a quarter of an hour.

He had climbed up with six people, but descended with over a hundred thousand!

On his first day, Tai Bai Yun Sheng topped the battle merit list.

Wolf King Chang Shan Yin's name sat dead last in scarlet red with negative merits.

That night, Hei Lou Lan hosted a victory banquet to celebrate.

Toasting repeatedly, Hei Lou Lan praised: "With old sir assisting us, all defense lines are useless!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng possessed two rank five Gu renowned across Northern Plains.

One was Mountain as Before and the other was River as Before, both time path Gu.

The former restored terrain to its past state, while the latter restored water bodies.

Since army defenses relied on earth path walls, Mountain as Before could revert them to flat ground, making all defensive lines useless.

# Chapter 525: Rapid Changes and Fierce Experts

At Mirror Lake, Ma tribe dominated Song tribe, smashing through two defense lines.

Enslavement master Ma Zun deployed his pegasus group to kill Song Qing Yin in midair, collapsing Song tribe's army.

Ma tribe annexed most of the tribes, while remnants fled in all directions.

Meng Qiu.

Nu Er Tu's leopard group unexpectedly overpowered veteran enslavement master Jiang Bao Ya.

This elevated Nu Er Tu into Northern Plains' 'five beast kings' alongside Jiang Bao Ya, Yang Po Ying, Ma Zun, and Chang Shan Yin.

Jiang Bao Ya barely escaped, his rat pack halved to under three hundred thousand.

Du Jiao.

Empowered by an Immortal Gu, Ye Lui Sang swept through rivals to dominate Du Jiao region.

Yet as Ye Lui's army spread like wildfire, a seven-army alliance hit them with a pincer attack.

Meanwhile, Hei tribe army also faced a mighty enemy, leaving them no time to relax.

Liu tribe's Liu Wen Wu personally led his army, pressing closer to Hei tribe each day!

Midway through their march, Liu tribe learned Gu tribe had submitted to Hei tribe thanks to Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng aiding Hei Lou Lan was tantamount to adding an entire army.

Liu Wen Wu soon realized this was the handiwork of Hei tribe's Gu Immortal.

Countless figures owed Tai Bai Yun Sheng debts of gratitude; if even a fraction repaid him, the resulting force would be terrifying.

"Hei Lou Lan gained immense reparations from defeating Dong Fang Yu Liang. With Tai Bai Yun Sheng aiding them, giving Hei tribe time to expand will make them too formidable."

Liu Wen Wu firmly ordered his army to continue marching toward Hei tribe.

Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily at this news: "Come, come!".

He then ordered defense lines set up across the area.

Twelve days later, Hei tribe advanced five hundred li from their fourth defense line to confront Liu tribe army.

Both armies parted to open the stage for expert challenges.

Hei tribe expert Hao Ji Liu charged forward, taking the initiative.

Liu Wen Wu saw this and sent Pei Yan Fei.

Both at rank four upper stage, the two clashed in a dead heat.

Hao Ji Liu thrust his palms forward, unleashing a roaring waterfall toward Pei Yan Fei.

Pei Yan Fei soared skyward, evading the waterfall.

Transforming into a golden rainbow, Pei Yan Fei sliced through the waterfall and pierced Hao Ji Liu!

Yet upon impact, Hao Ji Liu dissolved into water—it was only a decoy.

Using the torrent to block vision, Hao Ji Liu had cast a water decoy while hiding inside the waterfall.

Realizing the trap, Pei Yan Fei channeled his remaining essence into swallow wings Gu.

Two pairs of swallow wings flapped, carrying him away from the battlefield.

Standing dripping wet, Hao Ji Liu felt no joy—the enemy's killer move was terrifyingly powerful.

Stepping before the ranks, Ouyang Bi Sang called out softly: "I am Ouyang Bi Sang, who wants to come spar with me?"

As Mo Shi Kuang's second brother, Ouyang Bi Sang was a renowned transformation path expert.

His rank four peak stage cultivation granted him battle strength comparable to a rank five Gu Master!

Seeing Ouyang Bi Sang coming forward, Hei Lou Lan felt a slight headache.

Compared to Liu Wen Wu, he found himself sorely lacking in fierce generals.

Hei tribe fielded three rank five masters: Hei Lou Lan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, and Gu Guo Long.

He surveyed his rank four experts: Chang Shan Yin, Hao Ji Liu, Bian Si Xuan, Tang Miao Ming, and Pan Ping.

Pan Ping looked uneasy, while Bian Si Xuan stood veiled in black, her cold gaze unreadable.

Hei Lou Lan turned to Bian Si Xuan: "I must trouble Shadow Sword Expert to make a move."

"I can only ensure my survival, not guarantee a victory," Bian Si Xuan replied coldly.

Hei Lou Lan gave a dry laugh; even with her poison vow, he could not force her to fight to the death.

# Chapter 526: Asura Ouyang, Losses to both sides

Stepping before the ranks, Bian Si Xuan engaged Ouyang Bi Sang in battle without a word.

Liu Wen Wu's sworn brother soon grew impatient: "If this is all, go die!"

With a low shout, his entire body underwent a drastic transformation.

His teeth grew long and sharp like swords, while two pairs of canines jutted out like fangs.

Rank five, asura zombie Gu!

Bian Si Xuan's sword shadows sparked against his body, only shaving off green hair.

Overlapping shadow Gu!

Her eyes flashing, Bian Si Xuan overlaid multiple sword shadows into a pitch-black, intensely condensed blade.

"Now this is something!" Green light flared in Ouyang Bi Sang's pupils; facing the attack, he felt only excitement instead of fear.

Forming a claw with his right hand, he snatched at the sword shadow like catching a rabbit.

He crushed the blade shadow, but bursting fragments severed four fingers on his right hand and nearly cleaved his fist in two as she retreated.

"Facing someone head-on is not my style..." Ouyang Bi Sang's display weakened Bian Si Xuan's battle intent.

After ten more moves, Bian Si Xuan shouted, broke away from Ouyang Bi Sang, and retreated toward Hei tribe camp.

With deliberations settled, Hei tribe army sent Pan Ping into battle.

Before long, Pan Ping could no longer stall, frantically unsheathing his scimitar and activating sole blade Gu.

A cold light flashed but it was in vain.

Sole blade Gu ignored defense only with a certain probability, requiring eight hours of rest after activation.

"I can't leave him alive!" With surging killing intent, Ouyang Bi Sang pounced at Pan Ping.

As Pan Ping fled from the pursuing Ouyang Bi Sang, three rank four experts charged out to rescue him.

As the three experts surrounded Ouyang Bi Sang, an impatient Mo Shi Kuang charged from the Liu tent: "Second brother, I will lend you a hand!!"

"No need to interfere, third brother! Look at my Asura Transformation!" Ouyang Bi Sang roared, unleashing his killer move.

His aura surged sharply as his body expanded into a ten-foot giant.

His muscles inflated like balloons into bulging, rock-like masses, while two new pairs of arms sprouted beneath his original pair.

The protruding fangs turned dark brown and a third vertical eye opened from the center of his forehead!

Swatting his fist like batting a fly, Ouyang Bi Sang sent one flying.

"Die!" He attacked fiercely with all six hands—punching, swatting, grabbing, and holding—moving in seamless coordination without the slightest hindrance.

One rank four Gu Master lasted only briefly, smashed into blood paste, while another was seized by Ouyang Bi Sang.

Blood gushed from his orifices as Ouyang Bi Sang crushed him to death with two hands.

Liu Wen Wu laughed at this sight before waving his hand: "Commence the battle! All troops, charge!"

Immediately, the Liu tribe army surged forward like opened floodgates with world-drowning momentum, led by Mo Shi Kuang, Pei Yan Fei, and others.

Gritting his teeth, Hei Lou Lan ordered his army to brace for the assault.

As Liu tribe's experts rampaged across the battlefield, Hei Lou Lan and his higher-ups fell into an immediate disadvantage.

At the lower ranks, Fang Yuan's wolves slaughtered Liu tribe's Gu Masters, forcing them to squander precious primeval essence against the pack.

Sensing this disadvantage, Liu tribe's Gu Master experts began searching for Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan hid in a battlefield corner; three lurking soul coat Gu concealed his soul fluctuations under eighty percent exertion.

As night fell, the night wolves grew fierce, prompting Liu Wen Wu to retreat to prevent further casualties.

The first battle ended in a draw as night deepened. Both sides withdrew behind their defensive lines to rest and prepare.

# Chapter 527: Wolf King, Striving For Victory

Hei tribe's main tent. The atmosphere here was stifling, almost everyone including Hei Lou Lan was injured.

"Liu tribe's assault was too fierce. Liu Wen Wu, Luo Bo Jun, and Nie Ya Qing are rank five experts, while Mo Shi Kuang and Ouyang Bi Sang wield rank five battle strength at rank four peak stage. Along with experts like Pei Yan Fei and Chang Biao, such quality was rarely seen in past struggles," Sun Shi Han sighed.

"With more time, Old Sir's prestige could have recruited enough experts to match them," Hei Lou Lan sighed bitterly.

Understanding Hei Lou Lan's intent, Tai Bai Yun Sheng said: "I once saved Gao Yang and Zhu Zai, and they promised to repay the favor. I can write to invite them over."

Known as northern plains' demonic twin demons, Gao Yang and Zhu Zai always fought in tandem. Both were rank four peak stage experts who had once killed a rank five expert together!

Hei Lou Lan's pressure eased slightly: "Gao Yang and Zhu Zai's help would narrow the gap between our armies. But battle concerns our lives, and we cannot rely solely on their willingness to repay a favor. Today, Wolf King slaughtered vast numbers of their lower ranks, inflicting heavy losses and forcing Liu Wen Wu to retreat."

All eyes turned to Fang Yuan, awaiting his thoughts.

Fang Yuan looked tranquil and completely uninjured. Though he had stayed hidden while commanding the wolves, he had earned the most battle merits.

Feeling their gazes, Fang Yuan looked up and remarked: "Liu tribe's enslavement Gu Masters are led only by Bei Cao Chuan, whose grass soldiers are insignificant. Right now, both sides have distinct strengths. Liu tribe is stronger in top experts, while my wolf group devastates their lower ranks, resulting in today's draw."

"To win, we must restrain their experts. I can do so if provided a trump card mutated wolf pack. However, commanding them will expose my soul fluctuations beyond what my rank four lurking soul coat Gu can hide."

"Trump card wolf group..." Hei Lou Lan lowered his head and mumbled.

Securing a mutated wolf group for Fang Yuan so quickly left only one option: seeking aid from Hei tribe's Gu Immortals.

"A mutated beast group is indeed an option; I will try," Hei Lou Lan said vaguely after pondering.

"Even so, Lord Wolf King currently ranks dead last on the battle merits list, does he not?" Sun Shi Han remarked with veiled jealousy.

"I will exchange battle merits for them," Fang Yuan replied. "Since my current merits fall short, I must simply borrow more."

Fang Yuan added: "I also require a rank five lurking soul coat Gu; refining one has too low a success rate. I have three rank four Gu, but dare not fuse them to rank five."

Though extra requests would lower his tribe's evaluation, Hei Lou Lan gritted his teeth and nodded: "I will handle it."

As Hei Lou Lan's camp strategized, Liu Wen Wu and his group also plotted how to battle Hei tribe.

"In Hei tribe's army, Wolf King Chang Shan Yin is our greatest threat. He inflicted disastrous losses on us today, with at least thirty thousand Gu Masters dying in the wolves' jaws. Sigh, this toll truly makes my heart bleed. Everyone rallied behind me out of trust, yet my incompetence has cost us such heavy casualties!"

Sighing inwardly at the troublesome Wolf King, Liu Wen Wu opened his tearful eyes and asked, "Does anyone have a good method to deal with Wolf King?"

Bei Cao Chuan stood up: "Wolf King was originally a Chang tribesman; his blood ties cannot be severed. Current Chang leader Chang Biao was once Chang Shan Yin's best friend. After Chang Shan Yin vanished, Chang Biao married his wife and raised his three-year-old son, currently young tribe leader Chang Ji You. We might as well exploit this against Wolf King; it could prove effective."

"Hmm...this idea is not bad!" Liu Wen Wu's eyes gleamed.

After the discussion ended, Fang Yuan returned to his large lizard house Gu.

Using Hei tribe's Gu Immortals to assemble mutated wolves and refine the rank five Gu would solve his recent dilemma.

Fang Yuan knew Hei Lou Lan ultimately entered Imperial Court, an achievement inseparable from his backing Gu Immortals' support.

# Chapter 528: True Martial Secret, Awaiting Assistance

Xiao Hun blessed land.

Two Gu Immortals were sitting inside this treehouse, both in black clothes.

On the left sat Hei Bai, an ordinary-looking man dubbed the 'Hei tribe stoneman' in his youth—awkward in speech, yet internally shrewd and meticulous.

On the right was supreme elder Hei Cheng, Hei Lou Lan's father and protagonist of Su Xian's night elopement.

"You just returned from Ni Yu blessed land; did you see Dong Fang Chang Fan? How is he?" Hei Cheng asked leisurely, sipping tea.

"Magnanimity? Broad vision?" Hei Cheng scoffed in disdain. "Brother, you are mistaken. Dong Fang Chang Fan is truly petty and insidious; having schemed against all northern plains, he is despised by every Gu Immortal. If it was not so, he could have already bought lifespan Gu, why would he have fallen into this state? I have been secretly investigating over these years and have discovered he had a hand in my wife Su Xian Er's death!"

Hei Bai turned solemn: "Did Sister-in-law not die from the blessed land's earthly calamity twenty years ago?"

Hei Cheng scoffed: "An earthly calamity did occur, but it was man-made. Do not forget, our ancestor Giant Sun Immortal Venerable possessed such methods. Sigh, I only have a little evidence, it is not enough to prove Dong Fang Chang Fan as the main culprit."

Hei Bai's expression suddenly froze: "Hei Lou Lan has sent a letter."

Hei Bai closed his eyes, focusing on Hei Lou Lan's butterfly letter Gu.

As Hei Bai opened his eyes, Hei Cheng snorted displeasedly: "What is it? Did that disappointing child ask for help again?"

Hei Bai forced a smile: "Brother, Hei Lou Lan is you and sister-in-law Su Xian Er's son. Though giving birth to him left her severely weakened, leading to her death in the earthly calamity years later, the child is innocent. You should not resent him for it. You gave him to Fairy Jiang Yu to adopt and barred him from honoring his mother."

Hei Bai sighed: "This is your family affair and it is truly not my place to meddle. Yet I understand your intentions: you had the childless Fairy Jiang Yu adopt Hei Lou Lan to preserve his life through her Immortal Gu Dark Limit. Hei Lou Lan possesses the Great Strength True Martial physique. To motivate him, you stipulated that he may only burn incense for his mother once he becomes a Gu Immortal. Deeply admiring your intentions, I still fear this method will only deepen the rift between father and son."

Hei Cheng sighed without replying, instead asking: "What did the child request?"

Hei Bai smiled: "He asks for a mutated wolf group and a rank five lurking soul coat Gu."

"Hmph, how insolent! A lurking soul coat Gu is fine, but our Hei tribe has no mutated wolf group."

"Hei tribe is currently fighting Liu tribe, whose leader Liu Wen Wu cannot be underestimated. Back then, he obtained the inheritance of Harmony Immortal. He has two sworn brothers, both fierce warriors matching ten thousand soldiers. However, Nephew Lou Lan has Wolf King Chang Shan Yin, upon whom he has pinned his hopes," Hei Bai explained.

Hei Cheng muttered: "I have the Gu, but mutated wolves must be bought from treasure yellow heaven. I must trouble you, Brother."

Hei Bai nodded: "I rely on our nephew to retrieve Immortal Gu Wooden Chicken from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building."

Hei Cheng sighed wearily: "The Great Strength True Martial physique requires a strength path Immortal Gu to ascend to Gu Immortal. Unfortunately, Immortal Gu are exceedingly rare, and our Hei tribe possesses none in strength path. Success and failure is decided by heaven, we can only try our best. We have already done all we can, now everything will depend on Hei Lou Lan's efforts and luck."

Returning to Ku Mu blessed land, he immediately connected to treasure yellow heaven to purchase mutated wolves.

Once word spread of his high offer for mutated wolves, Hei Bai soon received a divine sense from 'Fox Immortal'.

'Fox Immortal' possessed over a hundred mutated wolves and demanded an exorbitant price, clearly exploiting Hei Bai's predicament.

Hei Bai had anticipated opportunism, but gritted his teeth and bought the mutated wolves.

The seller was none other than Little Hu Immortal, acting under Fang Yuan's instructions.

Fang Yuan had previously instructed Little Hu Immortal to snap up cheap mutated wolves in treasure yellow heaven.

Thus, Hu Immortal blessed land had amassed over a hundred mutated wolves, including blood forest, berserk, shark fin, and white-eyes wolves.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan rested calmly in camp, awaiting Hei tribe's assistance.

# Chapter 529: Diligence despite transmigration

Despite the difficult march through muddy swamp, Ma tribe's army remained in high spirits.

Riding his horse, Ma Ying Jie surveyed his troops with satisfaction as an investigative Gu Master brought the latest battle reports.

He opened up the documents and read:

"Hei tribe and Liu tribe have engaged. The first battle ended in a draw, and both sides are now stalemated opposite each other."

The report made Ma Ying Jie smile: 'Hei Lou Lan and Liu Wen Wu clashed so early—it is ideal if both suffer.'

"As long as we keep winning, devouring tribes, and expanding, our chances of entering Imperial Court will only grow!"

Meanwhile, amid the high-spirited army, a little girl wept inside a carriage.

"Lady Xiao Yun, please stop grieving and eat, or you will faint," an anxious Fei Cai comforted her clumsily.

This weeping little girl was none other than Zhao Lian Yun.

Her father, Zhao tribe's leader, had perished in the previous battle.

Without her father's protection, her status plummeted the night he died when her stepmother remarried the new tribe leader.

The old caretaker pulled the carriage curtain aside and grabbed Zhao Lian Yun: "Come along, your mother is calling."

Zhao Lian Yun struggled, shouting: "My mother is dead—she isn't my mother! I won't go!"

"That's not up to you!" the caretaker sneered, trying to drag Zhao Lian Yun out by force.

"Let go of Lady Xiao Yun!" Fei Cai shouted and punched the old caretaker.

Falling from the heavy punch, the bruised caretaker screeched: "A slave dared to hit a civilian? Who gave you such guts! I will report you, you are going to die! You will be skinned alive and your corpse hung in the sun to dry!"

Zhao Lian Yun stood on the carriage, scoffing: "You want to punish Fei Cai? Alright! Go inform his master to demand compensation—Fei Cai is young tribe leader Ma Ying Jie's slave leader!"

Recovering from her shock, the humiliated old caretaker glared gloomily at Zhao Lian Yun: "Little girl, even young tribe leader Ma Ying Jie's slave leader cannot protect you. The current tribe lady has already arranged your marriage to Wei tribe's eldest young master! Now behave!"

Zhao Lian Yun shook all over and collapsed onto the carriage boards.

In dazed despair from the shock, Zhao Lian Yun curled motionless in the carriage for three days.

This sudden turn of events and cold reality shattered Zhao Lian Yun's foolish pride as a transmigrator.

*'A transmigrator is nothing special. Why did I think I could whip up a storm here after being ordinary in my previous life?'*

Under Northern Plains customs set by Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, women were commodities who could not refuse forced marriages.

"Wei tribe's eldest young master is famously useless—pig-fat, pockmarked, and only rank one peak stage, yet extremely lecherous and fickle. Due to his incompetence, the young tribe leader position went to his younger brother."

"I won't marry that pig even if I die! But what can I do? I am only a mortal under thirteen, unable to awaken my aperture or cultivate, and might not even have aptitude. And my father's killer is Dou E, a rank five Gu Master who joined Ma tribe and is now an alliance higher-up!"

At dawn on the fourth day, Fei Cai lifted the carriage curtain and entered with food and water, morning light shining on Zhao Lian Yun's face.

"You brought food?" She snatched the food from Fei Cai's hand and devoured it.

"Lady Xiao Yun, are you okay?" Fei Cai was happy at this change.

"I must rely on myself. Though bound by betrothal, it only takes effect at sixteen. I still have time!" Her eyes shone.

Zhao Lian Yun rolled her eyes, declaring self-righteously: "Hmph, I won't compromise! Since I cannot return to the tribe now, I'll stay here for a while and rely on you, Fei Cai."

A letter was placed in front of Fang Yuan.

Openly sent by the enemy, this special letter was delivered by Cunning Gentleman Sun Shi Han.

Penned by Chang Biao, the letter reminisced about the past and invited Wolf King to meet so Chang Ji You could see his father.

"Great ploy." Fang Yuan scoffed and placed down the letter.

Sun Shi Han smiled: "The mutated wolves and rank five Gu arrived, but higher-ups demand Lord Wolf King fight your kin to prove innocence."

# Chapter 530: Adjusting his appearance for him

Liu tribe defense line, inside the camp tent.

"Mother, what kind of person was father?" After much hesitation, Chang Ji You finally voiced the burning question in his heart.

He had never met Chang Shan Yin; when Chang Shan Yin's mother died of poison and he fought Ha Tu Gu to the death, Chang Ji You was still in his mother's womb.

Frowning, his mother Ni Xue Tong sighed nostalgically: "My child, has your heart wavered? Don't forget our current circumstances. Don't worry about your father; he is a Northern Plains legend who single-handedly killed Ha Tu Gu and his bandits, a hero who eliminated a great menace for the people."

Chang Ji You interrupted: "Mother, I'm sick of hearing that. All my life, wherever I go or whatever I do, people say, 'As expected of Chang Shan Yin's son." Father is like an eagle soaring high, casting his shadow on the ground. I will meet him in a few days, and my heart is in a mess—I just want to hear his...""

As Chang Ji You was speaking, the tent flap opened and a domineering middle-aged man with a powerful aura walked in.

It was Chang tribe's current tribe leader, Chang Shan Yin's brother, rank four upper stage wind path expert, Chang Biao.

"Greetings to lord stepfather." Chang Ji You quickly paid respects.

"Go outside first, child; I need to speak with your mother," Chang Biao said gently.

"Husband!" Ni Xue Tong threw herself into Chang Biao's embrace, tears streaming from her weak eyes.

"I know you have been feeling terrible lately." Chang Biao embraced her, activating a Gu worm to isolate the tent.

Ni Xue Tong sobbed: "You Er keeps asking about Chang Shan Yin—what can I say? I nearly blurted out the truth just now, that he isn't Chang Shan Yin's blood, but the crystallization of our love!"

Chang Biao said solemnly: "It is all my fault for being useless! We were childhood friends, but Chang Shan Yin lusted after your beauty and snatched you away on our wedding day. Unable to match him, I met you secretly, conceiving Ji You. If his bloodline were examined, the truth would doom us. Thus, Ha Tu Gu and I plotted against Chang Shan Yin."

"I then married you and made Chang Ji You my godson and young tribe leader. This secret must never be exposed."

"Why does Longevity Heaven treat us like this! We love each other dearly, yet end up like this! Chang Shan Yin was the evil culprit, so why is he praised? While we must live behind masks, lying even to our own son?" Ni Xue Tong wept emotionally.

"Do you think Alliance Leader Liu will recruit Chang Shan Yin? If he agrees, will he discover our plot against him? What will we do if he returns to the tribe?" Ni Xue Tong asked, looking up from her lover's embrace.

"Chang Shan Yin hasn't discovered our involvement, or he would have exposed us already. He merely suspects Chang tribe has a traitor, but doesn't know who."

"Alliance Leader Liu certainly wants to recruit Chang Shan Yin. As the Wolf King and an enslavement path master, any alliance would welcome his aid. But Lord Liu Wen Wu is extraordinary; knowing there is little hope of recruiting the Wolf King, his primary goal is to sow discord and shake his fighting spirit."

"Chang Shan Yin believes Chang Ji You is his son. Knowing his wolves could kill his own child, will he truly go all out in the coming battle?"

A person broke the large lizard house Gu's window and crashed in.

Sprawled on the ground with a bruised face, Cunning Gentleman Sun Shi Han screamed in fearful malice: "The Wolf King attacked me! He's revolting! He's murdering us—save me!"

As Hei Lou Lan's favorite, Sun Shi Han's cries quickly attracted numerous Gu Masters.

Fang Yuan snorted, leaped from the window, and kicked Sun Shi Han again.

Neither Fang Yuan nor Sun Shi Han used Gu worms, keeping the altercation a rule-abiding scuffle.

"Chang Shan Yin, you're too arrogant! Your family is in the enemy camp—I merely gave a kind reminder, yet you beat me in rage! You are definitely guilty!" Sun Shi Han screeched as he scrambled up.

Hei Lou Lan and others arrived, asking Fang Yuan coldly: "What is going on?"

Shuddering, Sun Shi Han somehow found the strength to scramble up and cry: "Alliance Leader, please seek justice for me..."

Before he finished, Fang Yuan forcefully stomped on his head, grinding his entire face into the dirt.

Hei Lou Lan roared: "Stop! Wolf King, what are you doing?!"

Fang Yuan glared like a dagger at Hei Lou Lan and the surrounding Gu Masters: "Can't you see? I am thrashing him."

Hei Lou Lan glared at Fang Yuan, shouting: "Wolf King, explain yourself! Why beat him? Are you trying to rebel?"

Fang Yuan scoffed and drawled: "No need for anger, Leader Hei. If I wanted to rebel, why make such a scene?"

Fang Yuan said casually: "I won't tolerate plots targeting my family. In battle, I will do my duty and fight with full strength. If they die, it is their honor as warriors on the battlefield. Having joined the Hei army, I won't waver over personal ties. However..."

Laughing arrogantly, he added: "The mutated wolves were exchanged with battle merits in a fair trade. I owe you nothing. Hei tribe leader, if you are suspicious of me, you can take away the mutated beast wolf groups and not let me control them. In the future battle, I swear in the name of the Wolf King, I will still go all-out."

"Good, well said, Wolf King." Hei Lou Lan laughed in cold fury. "I naturally trust your loyalty, but why beat Sun Shi Han? With the enemy at our doorstep, what are you doing starting internal conflicts?"

"Hehehe." Fang Yuan shrugged. "My mistake—Sun Shi Han was so ugly he offended my eyes, so I beat him to adjust his appearance. He looks much better now. This was my personal action, I will take responsibility for it. According to the rules, I have to compensate Sun Shi Han ten thousand battle merits, no worries, I will compensate him!"

Hearing this, Sun Shi Han coughed up blood in sheer fury and fainted.

Even Tai Bai Yun Sheng looked at Fang Yuan with admiration, feeling that while Chang Shan Yin was ruthless, he held his principles, protected his family, and acted like a true man.

With threats useless, Hei Lou Lan had no choice but to comply.

# Chapter 531: Huge Battle (1/4)

The two armies, hundreds of thousands strong, confronted each other.

After reorganizing and exchanging war letters, Liu tribe and Hei tribe clashed once more.

"Second brother, you went last time; it's my turn now!" Mo Shi Kuang shouted, impatiently charging to the front.

With fluttering white hair, dark skin, and gleaming panther-like eyes, Mo Shi Kuang roared thunderously: "Who seeks death?"

Hei Lou Lan scoffed, looking at the two newcomers: "Who wants to go first?"

These were Gao Yang and Zhu Zai, rank four peak stage Gu Masters famed as the demonic path's Twin Demons.

Having reviewed Hei tribe's intel, the two exchanged glances. Zhu Zai rose and bowed: "I shall go."

"A rank four peak stage, good! You don't look impressive, though—I hope you last more than a few punches!"

Zhu Zai snorted and activated a Gu, rocketing forward like an artillery shell.

Zhu Zai slammed into Mo Shi Kuang, forcing himself back several steps and sending Mo Shi Kuang flying.

"Third brother, be careful! That is Zhu Zai of the Twin Demons—he cultivates strength path!" Liu Wen Wu called out from the main tent.

"A strength path Gu Master? Great!" Spitting blood, Mo Shi Kuang leaped back up, thrilled by the injury.

The two clashed in fierce melee, their heavy blows generating a rapid series of explosions. Though pitting qi path against strength path, Mo Shi Kuang held his own against Zhu Zai without falling into a disadvantage.

An elephant-sized grand emperor boar phantom appeared in the air with awe-inspiring might.

After a dozen exchanges, Zhu Zai unleashed the boar phantom, sending Mo Shi Kuang rolling across the ground.

Zhu Zai seized the opening to pursue, activating his trump card.

Sensing the danger, Mo Shi Kuang laughed wildly: "Interesting! Come, let me show you my true strength!"

Activating his movement Gu, he flew into the air, easily evading Zhu Zai's three-boar strike.

Hovering aloft with white hair fluttering, Mo Shi Kuang unleashed punch after punch at Zhu Zai.

"Not good, Brother Zhu Zai can't hold out by purely defending!" Knowing his sworn brother's limits, Gao Yang anxiously asked to join the battle.

Hei Lou Lan also saw the unfavorable situation and immediately agreed.

"A mere variant human—I'll teach you a lesson!" Gao Yang shouted, swirling mist propelling him forward.

"Don't think numbers will help you!" Ouyang Bi Sang snorted, darting out at high speed to intercept Gao Yang midway.

Unwilling to waste time with Ouyang Bi Sang, Gao Yang unleashed his trump card Gu.

Rank five, treacherous cloud wave Gu!

A carriage-sized grey cloud pulsing with dark red light surged rapidly toward Ouyang Bi Sang.

Though Ouyang Bi Sang dodged repeatedly, the cloud dogged him like a shadow and engulfed him.

Engulfed by the cloud, Ouyang Bi Sang lost his sense of direction, his thoughts grinding to a halt.

"Mo Shi Kuang, don't be rampant!" Leaving Ouyang Bi Sang, Gao Yang reinforced Zhu Zai in time.

Fighting in seamless coordination, the duo gradually suppressed even the fierce and fearless Mo Shi Kuang.

Barely twenty moves in, Ouyang Bi Sang's shout rang out: "Asura transformation!"

Unleashing his killer move, Ouyang Bi Sang's battle strength multiplied several times, shattering the grey cloud around him.

"Despicable scoundrels, die!" Thoroughly enraged, Ouyang Bi Sang took to the sky, joining Mo Shi Kuang against Gao Yang and Zhu Zai.

With this powerhouse joining in, Zhu Zai and Gao Yang were forced into passive defense, their situation turning critical.

"Alliance leader, Gao Yang and Zhu Zai are indispensable experts, we cannot let them die!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng urged, seeing the dire situation.

"Sir is right!" A solemn Hei Lou Lan stood up.

With Hei tribe weaker in high-tier strength, Hei Lou Lan ordered an all-out war!

Liu Wen Wu sneered: "You could not win the experts' challenge, so now you gang up? Good, I'll accompany you!"

Both armies, hundreds of thousands strong, surged toward each other like torrents.

As the armies closed, Gu Masters unleashed vast barrages of fire, icicles, bone spears, and wind blades.

Most survived the barrage, and the armies collided like two torrents, unleashing blood and chaos.

# Chapter 532: Huge Battle (2/4)

The surging crowd disrupted even the duels between Gao Yang, Zhu Zai, Mo Shi Kuang, and Ouyang Bi Sang.

The two armies completely intertwined as heaven-shaking battle cries erupted.

From their main tents, Hei Lou Lan and Liu Wen Wu observed the battle, dispatching elite troops to stabilize weak points.

To maintain control, both deployed their elite troops, leaving only the black banner and grand white elites in reserve.

The battle entered a stalemate.

"Our experts are holding. Wolf King, the rest is up to you," Hei Lou Lan transmitted.

From the start, Fang Yuan had left the main tent to lurk on the battlefield, his exact location unknown even to Hei Lou Lan.

Fang Yuan received the transmission without replying, mobilizing the wolf group to sprint in two directions.

Liu tribe Gu Masters reflexively gave chase, loosening their tight formation.

Over eight hundred mutated wolves shot like a sharp arrow toward Liu tribe's main camp.

"Mutated wolf reinforcements..." Liu Wen Wu frowned as the charging wolves tore through his formation.

Yet Liu Wen Wu remained unfazed. Backed by Liu tribe and its Gu Immortals, he had means to handle this mutated wolf pack.

"Bei Cao Chuan, it is time to strike." Liu Wen Wu instructed the Gu Master beside him.

Exiting the main tent, Bei Cao Chuan rapidly expended primeval essence to activate his newly acquired Gu worm.

Grass grew past a man's height in breaths, intertwining into grass soldier puppets.

Bei Cao Chuan activated his Gu again, upgrading many puppets into rank four grass sword elite soldiers!

The empty central camp quickly filled with grass soldiers, becoming the battlefield's most densely packed area.

The charging mutated wolf group was obstructed by these obstacles.

Fang Yuan focused on commanding, cloaked atop a blood forest wolf by the rank five lurking soul coat Gu.

Yet Fang Yuan felt he was battling a fellow enslavement path master.

The grass soldier army managed to barely hold back Fang Yuan's mutated wolf pack.

"We blocked it? Haha! Hei Lou Lan, you are bound to lose!" With his worries gone, Liu Wen Wu laughed heartily, his voice ringing across the battlefield.

"Damn it..." Hei Lou Lan gritted his teeth. Gao Yang and Zhu Zai were in peril, and the wolves were bogged down.

Left with no choice, he mobilized the black banner troops.

Hei tribe's trump-card black banner troops cut into the battlefield like a black blade slicing tofu.

"Can't hold back anymore?" Liu Wen Wu's eyes shone, watching the black banner troops advance.

Liu Wen Wu laughed arrogantly: "Your Hei tribe has the black banner troops, but my Liu tribe has our grand white troops. Let's see who prevails today!"

# Chapter 533: Huge Battle (3/4)

The black banner and grand white troops clashed. As opposing forces contesting for centuries with shared victories and defeats, both unleashed killer moves without either gaining a clear advantage.

While the grass soldiers stalled the wolves, Gao Yang and Zhu Zai were on the verge of collapse against Ouyang Bi Sang and Mo Shi Kuang.

Sweating profusely, Hei Lou Lan realized the peril. Alone in the main tent, he could only rely on his own strength!

Vanishing from the tent, he reappeared in the air above the grass soldier army.

He aimed to kill Bei Cao Chuan, knowing that once slain, the grass army would crumble.

Killer move — Dark Vortex!

Just as Hei Lou Lan activated his killer move, a white light flashed before him, revealing Liu Wen Wu.

"You're courting death!" Hei Lou Lan roared, charging at Liu Wen Wu.

The two clashed midair amid thunderous booms and brilliant flashes.

"Strange. Hei tribe defeated Liu tribe in my previous life, yet Liu tribe holds the advantage now. Did my presence cause these changes?" Fang Yuan observed secretly from the shadows.

Fang Yuan needed only to reveal himself with wolf howl Gu and rank five amplify effect Gu to instantly crush Bei Cao Chuan.

But Fang Yuan did not move, he chose to observe.

"My vision cannot be confined to this battle; the Imperial Court contest is manipulated by Gu Immortals. If I reveal my full strength, even in victory, the enemy will target me once reinforced by their Gu Immortals. Without hidden trump cards, my control over the situation would plummet."

With his sights set on the Imperial Court, Fang Yuan stayed calm, unfazed by the peril before him.

"Neither side has exhausted their trump cards yet. At least I know Tai Bai Yun Sheng possesses the rank five Man as Before Gu. The less strength I expose, the better. When I strike, it must be fatal! Now is not the time..."

Amidst the ruthless faces and deafening screams around him, Fang Yuan felt profound serenity and peace.

"Take this, my killer move—World Devouring Qi!" a thunderous roar erupted across the battlefield.

"Retreat!" Gao Yang tried to flee, but the air turned solid as a wall, trapping him.

Floating midair, Mo Shi Kuang brought his ten fingers together before his chest.

"Go!" Facing death, Zhu Zai unleashed the strength of three grand emperor boars, piercing a hole through the compressed air.

Yet Zhu Zai himself was crushed into meat paste by the intense air pressure of Mo Shi Kuang's killer move.

"Second brother, your killer move is incomplete, don't use it recklessly," Ouyang Bi Sang warned, rushing over to support him midair.

Seeing this, Liu Wen Wu laughed with supreme confidence, "This begins our Liu tribe's string of victories! Brother Lou Lan, you have no hope left!"

"Is that so?" replied Tai Bai Yun Sheng from another ring, not Hei Lou Lan.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng burst away from his foe and fired a silver beam from his open palms.

The silver beam illuminated Zhu Zai's mangled remains.

Rank five — Man As Before!

As the light faded, Zhu Zai reappeared uninjured, his primeval essence at its peak.

"Magnificent healing Gu!" Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily. With such a trump card, Hei tribe's experts could endure indefinitely.

"Now is the time!" Fang Yuan's eyes flashed as he activated rank four eagle rise Gu, soaring into the sky.

Rank five amplify effect Gu and rank four wolf howl Gu!

Under wolf howl Gu, his mutated beasts expanded, their eyes glowing red as their battle strength surged fivefold!

"Damn it, I can't hold on!" Bei Cao Chuan resisted, but his grass soldiers were torn to shreds within breaths.

Before Bei Cao Chuan could flee, a frenzy wolf tore through his armor and bit into his throat.

With the grass soldiers destroyed, Fang Yuan directed the wolf pack against the grand white troops.

"Hahaha, Liu Wen Wu, looks like I have the last laugh!" Hei Lou Lan roared in joyful surprise at the sudden reversal.

"I haven't lost yet!" Transforming into white light, Liu Wen Wu flew toward Ouyang Bi Sang and Mo Shi Kuang.

"Second brother, third brother!" He shouted.

# Chapter 534: Huge Battle (4/4)

"We're here, big brother!" Ouyang Bi Sang and Mo Shi Kuang shouted in unison.

Green, gray, and white lights collided—BOOM! The light cleared to reveal a humanoid monster.

The monster stood twenty feet tall with bronze skin, taut muscles, three heads, and six arms.

"Behold our killer move—Three Heads Six Arms! Tremble, for this is your final moment!"

"Shameless boasting!" Gao Yang snorted, activating treacherous cloud wave Gu.

With a sonic boom, the three-headed monster appeared above Gao Yang.

One arm pierced his light barrier while another shattered Gao Yang's head like a watermelon.

"Brother!!!" Blinded by grief and fury, Zhu Zai charged madly at the monster.

The strike blew Zhu Zai apart, scattering blood and crushed bone across the battlefield.

"Does this fusion combine Asura Transformation, qi path power, and light path speed?" Watching this, Fang Yuan felt an intense urge to battle.

Suppressing his battle intent, Fang Yuan descended back into the mutated wolf pack.

Man as before Gu!

Two silver beams shone down, resurrecting Zhu Zai and Gao Yang fully restored!

"Old geezer!" Its six eyes blazing with icy killing intent, the monster charged toward Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng retreated in panic; though he possessed Man as Before Gu, he could only use it on others, not himself.

"Protect Tai Bai Yun Sheng!" Hei Lou Lan shouted, rushing to reinforce.

The monster transformed into a beam of green light, shooting toward Tai Bai Yun Sheng like lightning.

"Benefactor, leave quickly!" Gao Yang and Zhu Zai rushed to shield Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

*THUMP THUMP*, Zhu Zai and Gao Yang were smashed again.

Dark vortex!

Hei Lou Lan plummeted from the sky as a hill-sized black sphere pressed down.

Roaring, the monster clawed with all six hands toward the descending black sphere.

Killer move — World Devouring Qi!

The air solidified like a mountain wall, halting Hei Lou Lan completely.

Surging air from all around unexpectedly swallowed his killer move.

*Howl!*

Taking advantage of Hei Lou Lan's stall, the mutated wolves rushed in and encircled the monster tightly.

"Lord Alliance Leader, let me help!" A Liu tribe Gu Master rushed forward to assist.

Yet the frenzied monster instantly smashed him to pieces!

The battlefield fell into an uproar as Liu tribe's morale plummeted.

"What do we do?" asked Hei Lou Lan, frustrated by the troublesome monster.

"Don't worry. This killer move drains immense essence and the monster has lost its sanity. A mindless powerhouse is nothing to fear," Fang Yuan analyzed calmly.

Just as he finished speaking, the unexpected occurred.

The three-headed monster split back into three people, who charged in different directions.

While Liu Wen Wu and Mo Shi Kuang missed, Ouyang Bi Sang shouted: "Chang Shan Yin, I found you! Die!!"

"Die!" Ouyang Bi Sang still had enough primeval essence to reactivate Asura Transformation!

Yet Fang Yuan merely wore a peculiar smile as he watched Ouyang Bi Sang attack.

Rank four eagle raise Gu and rank five amplify effect Gu!

Eagle wings sprouted from his back, launching him skyward at fivefold speed.

"Leave him to me!" Liu Wen Wu shouted, streaking forward in a beam of white light, but Fang Yuan nimbly evaded.

"To think the Wolf King is also a flying master!" The crowd marveled in astonishment.

"Damn it..." Liu Wen Wu gritted his teeth, his heart sinking.

Fang Yuan outclassed them completely, directing his wolves to slaughter the Liu army while dodging every attack with ease.

# Chapter 535: Meeting of ‘Father and Son’

Liu Wen Wu lost.

Dodging effortlessly, Fang Yuan mobilized his wolves to slaughter Liu tribe's forces.

Forced to abandon the chase, Liu Wen Wu's group turned to slay wolves and rescue their lower-ranked Gu Masters.

Faced with an endless wolf tide, the three Liu brothers fought until their primeval essence ran dry.

"Hei Lou Lan, today I did not lose to you, but to Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Chang Shan Yin!" Disheveled, wounded, and stripped of his gentlemanly poise, Liu Wen Wu shouted indignantly.

With their primeval essence depleted, Alliance Leader Liu Wen Wu and his brothers were captured.

Rather than killing the captured Liu Wen Wu and his leaders, Hei tribe demanded massive war reparations from their long-time rivals.

Three days later, Liu tribe's envoy arrived to escort all Liu tribesmen and their vassal tribes back into the blessed land.

The battered Hei army camped to manage captives, tally battle gains, and digest the spoils of war.

Inside the large lizard house Gu, Fang Yuan cultivated intently on his cushion.

At his will, a rank four wolf soul Gu emerged from his body.

The wolf soul Gu expanded into an elephant-sized, pure grey wolf soul.

Fang Yuan smiled lightly—a thousand man soul was not so easily shaken. The wolf soul crashed into it, only to be instantly frozen and suppressed.

The two souls tangled into mist before the wolf soul fused into the thousand man soul and reappeared.

"Ever since the Imperial Court competition, I have used wolf soul Gu daily to refine my soul. Now I've achieved small success—my soul is around thirty percent wolfman soul."

A fully converted wolfman soul would let him command vastly larger packs like his own limbs.

"At this rate, the contest will end before I finish. A rank four wolf soul Gu is far too inefficient," Fang Yuan sighed.

While Fang Yuan cultivated, Chang Biao led Ni Xue Tong and Chang Ji You to the large lizard house Gu.

I am Chang Biao, I was summoned by Lord Wolf King." Chang Biao's voice was low and polite, he respectfully informed the guarding Gu Master."

The two rank three guards stood expressionlessly by the door, one replying, "Lord Wolf King is cultivating and cannot be disturbed. You must wait!"

Hei Lou Lan had demanded Chang tribe as reparations to appease the indispensable Chang Shan Yin.

However, dismissing the matter casually would arouse suspicion given his status. Thus, Fang Yuan summoned Chang tribe's current leader, Chang Biao.

Chang Biao maintained a calm facade while Ni Xue Tong showed obvious anxiety, but young Chang Ji You's eyes sparkled with excitement.

After using three wolf soul Gu, Fang Yuan opened his eyes.

Having made them wait to assert authority, Fang Yuan finally opened the lizard house doors.

"Lord Wolf King has finished cultivating and will see you now," the guards outside relayed expressionlessly.

His breath catching with dread, Chang Biao walked in first with heavy footsteps.

Fang Yuan looked at the three people kneeling before him.

Fang Yuan laughed lightly.

His laughter made all three of them shudder.

# Chapter 536: Major Battles

"From today onwards, I am Chang tribe's sole supreme elder," Fang Yuan spoke, breaking the silence.

Shuddering, Chang Biao quickly bowed: "Chang Biao pays respect to lord supreme elder."

"Mm," Fang Yuan nodded. "Past matters will be investigated after the contest ends. Chang Ji You, you will be tribe leader. Chang Biao will be number one elder. Ni Xue Tong, continue being Chang Biao's wife."

"Ah?" Chang Ji You froze on the spot, completely stunned.

Suppressing his shock, Chang Biao bowed again: "This subordinate understands!"

"Leave," Fang Yuan dismissed them with a wave, eager to resume cultivating.

The three walked out in a daze until the cold wind snapped them awake.

"I... survived just like this?" Chang Biao felt overwhelming joy.

"With both apertures reaching rank five and ninety percent A-grade aptitude, I have ample essence to wield two sets of Gu worms. "With rank five amplify effect Gu, my strength explosive power is sufficient, but my body cannot withstand the strain.

Fang Yuan knew that unleashing five hundred jun of strength would cause his own body to collapse before his opponent's.

"My bones and skin cannot sustain five hundred jun. Yet modifying my body for strength path would compromise my enslavement path. Enslavement and strength conflict, making dual cultivation difficult—unlike soul and enslavement, or soul and wisdom."

Though he knew of Luo Po Valley, the future was uncertain. Ever vigilant, Fang Yuan refused to commit to soul path before securing it, focusing instead on perfecting his dual enslavement-strength cultivation.

After pondering with closed eyes, Fang Yuan retrieved the east window Gu from his aperture.

Inside east window Gu was the killer move 'three heads six arms,' which had fused the three Liu brothers into a giant monster.

Hei tribe had demanded this killer move as war reparations after defeating Liu tribe, and Fang Yuan had subsequently claimed it with his battle merits.

The killer move required eighteen Gu and, crucially, three Gu Masters, making solo activation impossible.

"If I had three heads and six arms, what would happen?"

A flash of inspiration struck him, opening a brand-new window.

His body was the cornerstone supporting both paths; expanding this physical foundation could allow it to sustain both enslavement and strength simultaneously.

Northern Plains, July.

Though victorious, Hei tribe suffered heavy losses and camped to recuperate.

Northern Plains, August.

Recruiting enslavement master Jiang Bao Ya surged Yang tribe's strength; after consecutive victories, they became a top contender for the Imperial Court.
