In mid-August, Hei Lou Lan ordered the conquest to resume.

By September, the Imperial Court contest narrowed to five frontrunning armies.

Hei tribe featured Chang Shan Yin and Tai Bai Yun Sheng; Nu Er tribe had the new Leopard King; Yang tribe fielded the Rat and Eagle Kings; Ma tribe possessed Horse King; and Ye Lui tribe had Ye Lui Sang, who owned an Immortal Gu.

After being routed by Ma tribe, ye Lui Sang escaped with his remaining troops, submitting to Hei tribe army.

In early November, Hei tribe marched north, setting up eight defensive lines before engaging Ma tribe in the final battle by mid-month.

Only the victor could enter the Imperial Court, while the loser faced harsh reparations and the ten-year blizzard in bitter defeat.

Hei tribe dominated the initial clashes; after losing two defensive lines, Ma tribe retreated to the third.

Seeking revenge, Ye Lui Sang issued constant challenges, slaughtering Ma tribe forces until they huddled defensively with dampened morale.

Cornered, Ma tribe had no choice but to seek help from their backer, Snowy Mountain blessed land.

# Chapter 537: Xue Song Zi

Amidst evergreen pines on a Snowy Mountain peak stood a seven-story ice crystal pavilion with a plaque reading: Xue Song Pavilion.

Its master, Xue Song Zi, was a famous Northern Plains rank six demonic path Gu Immortal.

Tall and thin with ground-length white hair, he stood atop Xue Song Pavilion, gazing down at his branch peak.

Yet he had one great regret: decades after becoming a rank six Gu Immortal, he still lacked a single Immortal Gu.

No amount of immortal essence stones could buy an Immortal Gu. Being unique, owners would not sell them, trading only Immortal Gu for Immortal Gu.

"If Ma tribe prevails and enters the Imperial Court, I might obtain my first Immortal Gu from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building..."

Mid-thought, Xue Song Zi sensed something and casually waved his hand.

Space tore open and a letter Gu flew in.

"So they have finally reached this stage," Xue Song Zi smiled.

Tracking the contest, he knew Ma tribe's plight and their earlier hesitation to accept his terms. Now, pressed by the dire battle situation, Ma tribe's plea for help effectively accepted his prior terms.

Summoned by his divine sense, three snowman Gu Masters immediately hurried toward the peak.

Kneeling before Xue Song Pavilion, they greeted in unison: "Xue Wa, Xue Mi, and Xue Ming greet Lord Immortal!"

Remaining unseen, Xue Song Zi sent several Gu worms into their hands.

"Take these Gu worms and battle troop D to reinforce Ma tribe and help them win," Xue Song Zi instructed via divine sense.

Hei tribe's Gu Immortals spotted the snowman troop departing Snowy Mountain blessed land.

"Brother, Ma tribe is indeed colluding with Snowy Mountain's demonic Gu Immortals," Hei Bai told Hei Cheng in Xiao Hun blessed land.

Hei Cheng replied calmly: "Do not fret. Lone demonic immortals rarely unite; only two or three at most support Ma tribe."

Hei Cheng asked, "Have you investigated who the demonic Gu Immortals supporting Ma tribe are?"

"I haven't but it should be easy."

"We will purchase five hundred thousand wolves, three hundred mutated wolves, two wolf emperors, and vast supplies for Hei Lou Lan."

"Also, instruct Hei Lou Lan to conclude the battle quickly to avoid new problems."

War was not merely a clash of lives, but a grueling war of attrition testing their underlying foundations.

With the Imperial Court struggle in its final stretch, supporting Hei Lou Lan became an increasingly heavy burden for Hei Cheng and Hei Bai.

The required resources were staggering, purchased mostly from treasure yellow heaven with precious immortal essence stones.

Ten days later, Hei and Ma tribes clashed again, their troops arrayed in endless formations.

In the command tent, Hei Lou Lan sat high with overflowing vigor: "We failed to inflict severe damage the last two times, but today we teach them a good lesson! It is not that easy to become a super tribe, hmph! Who will go first?"

Water Demon Hao Ji Liu immediately stood and bowed: "Lord Alliance Leader, I volunteer to go first!"

Hei Lou Lan nodded in satisfaction.

Hao Ji Liu strode into the field, taunting loudly. Ma Shang Feng snorted and pointed: "That Water Demon again! Who will teach him a lesson?"

"Lord Alliance Leader, let me handle him this time!" barked Cheng Hu, Ma tribe's general and a rank four transformation path Gu Master.

With Ma Shang Feng's consent, Cheng Hu eagerly charged out to battle Hao Ji Liu.

Stifled and pushed into a disadvantage, Cheng Hu roared furiously and activated his killer move, transforming into a slant-eye tiger.

Ferocious and powerful, the tiger instantly reversed his losing situation.

Famed for fierce offense, Hao Ji Liu struggled against the tiger's attacks, retreating steadily to adopt a defensive counter-attacking stance.

# Chapter 538: Challenge

The two armies placed their gaze on the battle ahead.

Hao Ji Liu and Cheng Hu's duel reached its crucial moment.

In tiger form, Cheng Hu held the advantage, forcing Hao Ji Liu to evade pathetically.

Yet the battle remained deadlocked; despite his huge advantage, Cheng Hu could not convert it into victory.

"Not good, this Water Demon is crafty! Cheng Hu is in danger," Ma Ying Jie warned.

The experienced Water Demon was simply stalling until Cheng Hu's primeval essence drained and the transformation ended.

Ma Shang Feng looked calm, but his heart sank.

Foreseeing Cheng Hu's defeat, Ma Shang Feng sighed inwardly and called, "Fei Sheng Cheng."

Fei Sheng Cheng immediately stepped up, placing his right palm at his heart, bowing: "I am here."

"You will take the second round," Ma Shang Feng ordered, seeking a swift counter-victory.

Right now, he came before the battle area and shouted.

In Hei tribe's tent, Sun Shi Han warned, "Fei Sheng Cheng wields the paralyzing numbness Gu and has slain eight rank four experts."

Hei Lou Lan nodded in agreement, looking around: "Who can battle?"

A hearty laugh rang out as someone stood: "Fei Sheng Cheng is nothing special. I will sweep him from your path of conquest!"

Hei Lou Lan looked over; it was none other than Sole Blade Pan Ping.

Recently resurrected by Tai Bai Yun Sheng's Man as Before Gu, Pan Ping was eager for battle.

"Alright, then you shall go." Hei Lou Lan nodded.

"Fei tribe lad, you shameless, glory-seeking traitor! Living is your greatest humiliation—quickly receive your death!" Pan Ping shouted, bounding into battle.

Infuriated by the insult, Fei Sheng Cheng snapped, "Demonic scoundrel, I only tolerated your arrogance before because you hadn't provoked me!"

Seeing Fei Sheng Cheng and Pan Ping deadlocked, Ma tribe sent out another six fierce generals.

Hei Lou Lan accepted all the challenges, sending Pei Yan Fei, Gao Yang, Zhu Zai and others.

As the six pairs battled, Cheng Hu finally lost. Water Demon Hao Ji Liu lacked the strength to pursue, watching him escape safely.

Hei tribe's morale surged, but Ma tribe quickly won the third battle, tying the score.

Both sides kept sending experts until over thirty battle rings formed between the armies.

Around seventy rank four Gu Masters were fighting at once!

Only Fang Yuan remained calm; in his previous life he had seen the even vaster chaotic battle of the five regions.

Ge tribe leader Ge Guang stepped forward with surging battle intent: "Lord alliance leader, I would like to battle!"

Stunned, Hei Lou Lan turned his gaze toward Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan commanded lightly: "Stand down, Ge Guang. A tribe leader should not risk himself unnecessarily."

Ge Guang stepped down obediently.

Fang Yuan asked: "Where is Chang Biao?"

"Lord, I am here," Chang Biao answered sickly, still injured from previous fighting.

But Fang Yuan did not care about this, saying: "You will go fight."

Unable to speak, Chang Biao raged inwardly. Ever since joining the Hei alliance army, Fang Yuan had ordered him into every major battle.

"Damn it! Ordering me like a beast! I will endure for now. If I could harm you ten years ago, I can send you to the underworld again!"

Screaming internally, Chang Biao outwardly obeyed, dragging his injured body onto the battlefield.

# Chapter 539: Rank Five Peak Stage!

With Chang Biao taking the stage, Ma tribe sent a female expert.

Gradually, rank four Gu Masters in both main tents dwindled, leaving few left to mobilize.

"Gu tribe leader, please show your strength now," Hei Lou Lan commanded.

Gu Guo Long's appearance shocked Ma tribe army.

Confronted by a rank five expert, Ma Shang Feng dispatched Cheng tribe leader Cheng Long.

He was a rank five transformation path expert and Cheng Hu's elder brother.

Having gained Jiang Bao Ya and Yang Po Ying alongside Ma Zun, Ma tribe now possessed three enslavement path masters!

Fang Yuan calmly observed the battle from his seat.

Fang Yuan then turned part of his concentration toward his aperture.

Many new Gu worms filled his aperture: mostly rank four, one rank three, along with rank five asura zombie Gu and rank five earth overlord Gu.

Drawing inspiration from 'three heads six arms,' Fang Yuan had researched a new transformation.

He condensed these findings into a killer move: Four Arm Earth King!

Activating it sprouted two extra arms from his ribs, multiplying his strength to rival the Liu brothers' combined might.

"However, Four Arm Earth King has short duration and requires grounded footing; in flight, its power drops by half."

"Ma tribe's trash can really take a beating!" Hei Lou Lan snorted impatiently.

Looking toward Fang Yuan, he was about to speak when three beast groups charged from Ma tribe's camp.

On the left, galloping horses made the ground rumble like muffled thunder!

On the right, countless squeaking, hissing rats surged in a spine-chilling swarm.

From the center, an eagle flock soared like dark clouds blotting out the sky!

Horse King Ma Zun, Rat King Jiang Bao Ya, and Eagle King Yang Po Ying mobilized simultaneously.

Beast groups charged, immediately dispersing most of the battle rings.

Ma Shang Feng sought to use the three enslavement masters to crush Hei tribe's vanguard.

Facing the combined attack of three beast groups, Hei Lou Lan immediately tensed up and looked at Fang Yuan: "Wolf King, it is your turn now!"

Fang Yuan nodded and leisurely stood up from his seat.

Each of the three enslavement path masters was on par with him, formidable opponents matching his attainments.

Yet Fang Yuan laughed coldly, his battle intent soaring.

Immense support from Hei tribe's Gu Immortals had expanded his wolf pack more than tenfold.

Hidden within the army and concealed by Gu worms, the wolves remained undetected by the enemy.

"Wolf King! I am Yang Po Ying, do you dare to fight me?" Riding a huge eagle, Yang Po Ying stood upright like a spear aimed at the sky.

He challenged first to pin down Fang Yuan's wolf pack.

"Hahaha, Old Yang, go easy on brother Chang Shan Yin, after all he is an enslavement master like us. You need to give him some face." From the right, Rat King's ridiculing laughter could be heard.

On the left, the taciturn Ma Zun grunted and charged amid the horses, surrounded and guarded by numerous mounted Gu Master experts.

"Brother Shan Yin..." Hei Lou Lan could not help revealing a worried expression. Although the scale of the wolf group had increased sharply, beyond that of the three beast groups, he was worried Fang Yuan would not be able to control all of them properly. After all, Fang Yuan had never controlled such a large number of wolves.

Fang Yuan stood silently on the twin-headed rhino's head, his back to Hei Lou Lan.

As the three beast groups charged within two hundred steps, Hei tribe fell into an uproar and Hei Lou Lan urged anxiously: "Brother Chang Shan Yin!!"

Fang Yuan raised his head and laughed: "It is time! The enemy poured all their strength to pressure me with the beast groups, but they do not know that they have brought about their own demise. Alliance leader Lou Lan, I need to congratulate you."

"Congratulate me for what?"

"This battle has already been won, the die is cast, alliance leader becoming the Lord of Imperial Court is a foregone conclusion." Fang Yuan lightly said.

Yet the next instant, Hei Lou Lan's eyes nearly popped out in shock.

Fang Yuan's aura was undergoing an astonishing transformation.

From rank four peak stage to rank five initial stage...

And from rank five upper stage to rank five peak stage!

Fang Yuan lifted the concealment of breath concealment Gu, no longer suppressing his true cultivation.

Under everyone's gaze, Fang Yuan activated eagle rise Gu, eagle wings lifting him into the sky.

In the sky, he gave a long howl.

Rank five amplify effect Gu and wolf howl Gu!

The wolf howl resonated across the sky, drowning out all sounds from the three beast groups.

*Howl... howl... howl!*

The wolves howled in succession, echoing Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 540: One vs Three!

Fang Yuan flew into the sky.

"Yang Po Ying, Jiang Bao Ya, Ma Zun, today is the day all of you die." He said plainly, his voice was loud and clear, reverbing in everyone's ears.

Jiang Bao Ya snorted: "Hmph, shameless words!"

"You are rank five peak stage, Chang Shan Yin, you truly hid your abilities well," Yang Po Ying said, eyes burning. "This kind of battle is truly interesting!"

Yet the moment the wolf group emerged, his battle intent froze.

A sea of wild wolves surged in boundless waves—first, second, third—unceasing as they connected heaven and earth!

"Such a huge wolf group, oh heaven, five hundred thousand? Eight hundred thousand? No, at least a million!" Jiang Bao Ya was shell-shocked, his battle intent vanished without a trace: "Retreat, my rat group was only six hundred thousand at its peak. After so many battles, I have not replenished them yet, thus I have less than two hundred thousand now! This is my foundation, I cannot lose them, retreat, retreat, retreat, we have to run!"

Selfish as a demonic cultivator, Jiang Bao Ya immediately fled with his rat group.

Yet Fang Yuan's wolf pack had reached an incredible one million five hundred and sixty thousand!

In contrast, the three commanders had suffered heavy losses—barely seven hundred forty thousand beasts combined.

No hot-blooded youth, Ma Zun quickly steered the horse group around to retreat.

Having purposely waited for the horses and rats to close in before unleashing his wolves, Fang Yuan's timing was ruthless.

Yet as a master, Ma Zun deftly guided the horses in a wide arc past Hei tribe's army, angling outward to break the encirclement.

Yet how could Fang Yuan let such prime meat escape?

With a thought, the howling mutated wolves gave chase.

The mutated wolves split into a pincer attack, intercepting the horse herd.

Countless ordinary wolves soon swarmed in, tightly surrounding the horses.

"A spectacular intercept, as expected of a master level!" Seeing this, Hei Lou Lan was overjoyed, finally putting his worries about Chang Shan Yin away.

Ignoring the Rat King, Fang Yuan turned his gaze to the sky.

"Damn it, two beast groups have been targeted, the horse group is deep within encirclement, while Rat King ran away, only my group is left." Yang Po Ying felt a huge burden on his shoulders.

While Yang Po Ying hesitated, Fang Yuan directed hundreds of thousands of wolves straight at Ma tribe's main tent.

"If we fought one on one, my wolves would suffer against your eagles. But in open war, if they slaughter your Gu Masters or drain their primeval essence, attrition alone brings victory. Yang Po Ying, what will you do?"

After brief hesitation, Yang Po Ying gritted his teeth and moved to restrain the Wolf King.

Spared from the eagles, the central wolf pack successfully crashed into Ma tribe's army.

With a steely expression, Ma Shang Feng mobilized his remaining enslavement path Gu Masters into a defensive line.

Spearheaded by mutated wolves, the massive pack easily tore through the paper-thin defense.

"We have not lost! The situation is dire, but fight with me—we still have trump cards!!" Ma Shang Feng roared as Xue Wa and the other rank five snowmen revealed their true forms, rallying an elite snowman troop.

Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily, dispatching elite troops while tribal leaders led their clansmen onto the field.

The two armies engaged in all-out combat.

The eagle group shrieked as they attacked Fang Yuan.

Beside Fang Yuan, Hei Lou Lan's guards and allied experts formed a tight defense.

As the eagles faltered, Fang Yuan used wolf care Gu to overcome blind spots, directing wolves to slaughter enemy forces.

"We have urgent matters, Wu Ye, you guys go and restrain the experts near Chang Shan Yin!" On the eagle's back, Yang Po Ying was sweating profusely as he ordered.

The flying experts charged, sharply increasing the defensive pressure on Hei Lou Lan and the others.

"Careful, they are trying to disturb us, don't step out easily. Don't forget that they have Wu Ming!" Hei Lou Lan snorted as he attacked, instructing his men.

Wu Ming was a rank five dark path master whose assassinations of enemy leaders had previously shattered alliance morale.

"Charge, charge over and kill Wolf King Chang Shan Yin!" Not just Hei Lou Lan, Yang Po Ying and Ma tribe's experts also rapidly understood the crux of this battle.

"Five million battle merits to whoever kills Chang Shan Yin! He will become Ma tribe's supreme elder and enjoy our resources for life!" Ma Shang Feng roared.

Such lavish rewards drew countless experts, their eyes turning red as they targeted Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 541: Four Arm Earth King!

Hei Lou Lan and the defenders soon felt mountain-like pressure!

Enticed by the rewards, enemies charged recklessly until the battle centered entirely around attacking and defending Fang Yuan.

Enemy rank four and rank five Gu Masters swarmed in, creating sheer chaos.

Hei Lou Lan and the defenders soon struggled to survive amid chaotic barrages of elemental attacks.

Cheng Hu had been struck from behind, flying toward Fang Yuan.

"Which scoundrel sneak attacked me!" Cheng Hu roared, scrambling up and charging back the way he came.

After five or six steps, Cheng Hu froze as if immobilized, turning around to stare rigidly at Fang Yuan within arm's reach.

"Hahaha!" Cheng Hu stared at Fang Yuan with ecstatic excitement, seeing five million battle merits and endless fame right before him.

He pounced, his limbs morphing into a gorgeous tiger upon landing.

"Damn it! Hide quickly!" Bian Si Xuan glanced back and involuntarily screamed.

The tiger leaped with maw agape, casting a huge shadow over Fang Yuan as its fangs snapped toward his head!

A pair of large hands grabbed the tiger's neck, immobilizing it!

Cheng Hu stared in shock at Fang Yuan's cold expression and the two bronze arms sprouting from his ribs!

The two bronze hands firmly grabbed Cheng Hu's tiger claws.

Fang Yuan was entirely unharmed; instead, the tiger went limp and numb from pain.

Killer move — Four Arm Earth King!

Fang Yuan's defense quadrupled and his strength reached eight hundred jun while rooted to the ground.

"Have you played enough?" Fang Yuan gave a cold smile, looking calmly at Cheng Hu, his gaze carrying a ridiculing and cold intent.

"Such a boring trick... sigh, it is better for you to die."

The next moment, the bronze hands exerted strength and pulled.

The tiger head reverted to Cheng Hu's, his wide eyes completely revealing his terror of death!

Fang Yuan grabbed Cheng Hu's skull and looked up, his gaze sweeping past everyone to land on Yang Po Ying.

Yang Po Ying's hair stood on end as an intense sense of danger rose in his heart!

Fang Yuan flapped his eagle wings and flew to the sky!

Yang Po Ying's pupils shrank, immediately mobilizing the thunder eagles to protect him.

Fang Yuan cut through the thunder eagle group like a hot knife through butter and reached Yang Po Ying.

"You!" Yang Po Ying's face lost all blood as he looked at Fang Yuan with extreme fear.

Fang Yuan burst Eagle King Yang Po Ying's head as easily as a watermelon.

Blood and brain matter splattered, and the eagle group instantly crumbled apart.

"Now, it is your turn." Without pausing, Fang Yuan fixed his cold gaze on Ma Zun.

Though protected by his majestic horse group, Ma Zun felt terror as if a calamity were descending upon him.

Wu Ye and Xi Xue flew together and pincer attacked Fang Yuan.

"A bunch of trash wants to block me?" Fang Yuan snorted, easily shaking off Xi Xue to charge directly toward Wu Ye.

A dragon roared like thunder as an enormous dragon blocked Fang Yuan's way.

The three-clawed, golden-horned giant dragon roared with lantern-like eyes: "Chang Shan Yin! You killed my brother, you shall pay the most bitter price!"

Countless gazes watched Fang Yuan, whose bronze-lustered body had doubled in size, his four arms thicker than a man's thighs.

He stood proudly in midair, holding a broken dragon horn.

The golden dragon fell like a puppet with severed strings, smashing into a giant crater amid splattered blood and scales.

"What?" Ma Shang Feng's pupils shrank as he blurted in disbelief, "Even Cheng Long could not take one move from him!"

"Ma Zun, I, Wolf King, will take your life." Fang Yuan said calmly, his voice carrying across the battlefield as if speaking of an insignificant matter.

"Uncle Ma Zun, leave quickly! I will block him!" shouted Ma tribe's young leader, Ma Ying Jie, from his side.

# Chapter 542: Dual Cultivating Two Paths!

Ma Zun's face turned ashen as he resolutely refused: "No, Ma tribe has only warriors who fight to the death, not cowards who run away. I am a symbol of Ma tribe; fleeing will heavily damage our army's morale! I cannot leave—we have not lost yet, I still have my pegasus group!"

With a thought, his pegasi flew into the air like clouds.

Fang Yuan shot forward like a meteor, crashing through the pegasus group without dodging.

"No, I have not lost yet!" Panicking, Ma Zun was about to unleash his killer move when Ma Ying Jie blocked him.

"Uncle, let me do it. Using this move drops your cultivation. Ma tribe can lose me, but never you!" Ma Ying Jie shouted.

"Besides, my death is not certain. Uncle, leave quickly!" Ma Ying Jie grew solemn, channeling primeval essence into several Gu.

Killer move — Dragon Horse Spirit!

With a thought, Fang Yuan sent wolves piercing forward, forcibly scattering the horse souls' formation.

As the defensive line thinned, Fang Yuan took the initiative to assault.

If Ma Zun guarded against Fang Yuan, the wolves charged freely; if he defended against the wolves, he could not block Fang Yuan.

The horse group crumbled apart and Ma tribe's army's morale lowered to the abyss!

"Wolf King dual cultivates enslavement and strength paths and fears no leader-decapitation tactics—how can we counter such an enslavement master?"

# Chapter 543: Victory has been decided

"Only Rat King's group can contend against the wolves!" Ashen-faced over Ma Zun's death, Ma Shang Feng looked desperately toward Jiang Bao Ya.

Rat King had actually fled!

"Wolf King is a monster! The other masters were all killed by him—how can I survive without running?"

Jiang Bao Ya's flight triggered panic; allied tribes rallied their forces and retreated in disorder.

"One truly cannot rely on outsiders!" Ma Shang Feng spat a mouthful of blood and fainted.

Ma tribe army was utterly crushed, the situation was set!

*'I almost had to break my seal and use my true martial physique. How fortunate!'* Battered and gasping, Hei Lou Lan watched with fierce eyes.

Under his order, Hei tribe army began a ruthless hunt.

Fang Yuan remained still, summoning the wolf group to protect him.

"Heavy internal bleeding, soul weakened to five hundred man soul..." Fang Yuan inspected himself, swallowing blood as waves of dizziness washed over him.

His two bronze arms vanished; the backlash of four arm earth king was far more severe than expected.

"Prior tests only scratched the surface. Pushing it beyond theoretical time limits has exposed problems. Truly, genuine knowledge comes from practice."

"The rank five earth overlord Gu requires ground combat to absorb the backlash; flying throughout the battle exposed this flaw."

"Four arm earth king has shortcomings. Flying is far more versatile, and with my flying attainment, I must leverage this advantage."

"Damn it... he's still vigilant, giving me no opening!" Assassin Wu Ming cursed from afar as he observed Fang Yuan.

As Hei tribe experts patrolled increasingly close, Wu Ming could wait no longer and quietly retreated.

Zhao Lian Yun kicked him furiously: "You idiot! I want a horse too, but where will you get one?!"

As the horse neared, Zhao Lian Yun's eyes widened at the injured rider: "Ma Ying Jie!"

"Hei tribe has won—even Gu Immortal backing cannot reverse Ma tribe's defeat," Hei Bai congratulated Hei Cheng.

Elder Brother's heavy investment of immortal essence stones was visionary. Hoarding the wolf packs to deploy them all at once caught Xue Song Zi completely unprepared. Now, even if Xue Song Zi wants to send more aid, no one remains to receive it."

# Chapter 544: Entrapping a Gu Immortal?

When Ma Ying Jie finally woke, he was met by Fei Cai's joyous smiling face.

'But it is still not enough, far from enough! What can being the peak of the mortal world be considered as? As long as one is not a Gu Immortal, they will simply be chess pieces. Not mentioning the goal of eternal life, just looking at my current goal, I have yet to save Dang Hun mountain.'

He glanced at Tai Bai Yun Sheng beside him.

Saving Dang Hun mountain required Tai Bai Yun Sheng's Immortal Gu — Landscape As Before.

Hence, Fang Yuan had two possible courses of action.

First, capture Tai Bai Yun Sheng, soul-search him with soul path Gu worms to extract Landscape As Before's recipe, and refine it himself.

First, capturing a powerful time path Gu Master alive carried disastrous consequences if the attempt failed.

Second, even if captured alive, Tai Bai Yun Sheng could simply detonate river as before and mountain as before Gu, wasting all of Fang Yuan's efforts.

Finally, it remained unknown whether Tai Bai Yun Sheng currently had the recipe for Landscape As Before in his mind.

Past-life rumors suggested that during Tai Bai Yun Sheng's immortal ascension, the two rank five Gu spontaneously fused into rank six Immortal Gu Landscape As Before.

If so, the recipe for Landscape As Before simply did not exist, and the refinement process could not be duplicated.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng would advance to Gu Immortal in Imperial Court blessed land. The second plan was to wait until he obtained the Immortal Gu before striking!

This meant Fang Yuan, as a mortal, would be plotting against a Gu Immortal!

# Chapter 545: Ma Hong Yun

Fortunately, Fang Yuan's plan did not rely on facing a Gu Immortal alone. Leveraging Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and Lang Ya land spirit's intelligence, his plan had good prospects. With this, he had a twenty percent chance of seizing Immortal Gu Landscape As Before.

Twenty percent probability was already the highest among the three ways to save Dang Hun mountain.

Only an Immortal Gu could contend against Immortal Gu Gruel Mud.

Drawing on five centuries of experience, only one viable Immortal Gu could save Dang Hun mountain.

Immortal Gu Landscape As Before was yet to be created, and Tai Bai Yun Sheng remained a mortal.

Thus, targeting Immortal Gu Landscape As Before carried the lowest risk and highest probability of success.

Tian Chuan, warm pond valley.

"Tribe leader, this is spirit spring C," Ma You Liang worriedly pointed out the dried spring to Ma Ying Jie.

Spirit spring C was one of only three spirit springs remaining in warm pond valley.

Rolling down, Fei Cai had dislodged the stone, uncovering the hidden spirit spring.

The spring's output was enormous; over a hundred primeval stones quickly gushed onto the ground.

Ma Ying Jie laughed heartily: "Fei Cai, you are my lucky star. From today on, change your name. Fei Cai sounds like trash. From now on, you are Hong Yun—Fei Hong Yun! It signifies fortune shining on our Ma tribe, joy after extreme sorrow!"

His joy was short-lived; seven days later, the Hei tribe army arrived and surrounded warm pond valley.

The night Hei tribe garrisoned nearby, warm pond valley's three spirit springs simultaneously turned black, completely polluted.

A letter to surrender soon reached Ma Ying Jie's land.

With their spirit springs contaminated by Gu worms, staying in warm pond valley was no longer viable.

"I never thought Hei Lou Lan would be so relentless! Demanding our surrender doesn't violate Ancestor Giant Sun's rules! Damn it, he is truly hateful!" Ma Ying Jie clenched his fists in rage and helplessness.

"The 'Black Tyrant' Hei Lou Lan has always been brutal. The previous battle must have made him wary of us, so bound by Ancestor Giant Sun's rules, he wants to keep us under his watch and oppress us."

Pausing briefly, he continued: "Actually, this works out. Surrendering to Hei Lou Lan means we can also enter Imperial Court blessed land."

Ma Ying Jie shook his head: "That is his sinister intent. Ma tribe can stay in the Imperial Court, but what about others? How many tribesmen with the surname Ma do we have left?"

Ma You Liang paled: "Only around one hundred and thirty."

"To grow our tribe, we must absorb outsiders, intermarry widely, and produce numerous offspring. If Hei Lou Lan forbids us from taking outsiders and restricts us to marrying only within the tribe, how long will it take us to grow?"

After a pause, Ma Ying Jie said resolutely: "We will bestow the Ma surname upon outsiders and take them as our own tribesmen!"

"Lord tribe leader, if we do this, our Huang Jin bloodline will really be..." Ma You Liang hesitated.

"The Huang Jin bloodline cannot be contaminated. Once our situation improves, we will strip their Ma surname."

# Chapter 546: The way forward for the insignificant people

The massive host of nearly a million marched toward Northern Plains' central Imperial Court region.

Countless mortal slaves fell along the journey, never to rise again.

Hei Lou Lan could have saved them, but refrained.

Fang Yuan approached the sealed glass window, gazing outward to the left.

Yet this remained confined by transformation path's limitations.

Building on his already solid foundation through laborious study, his comprehension of strength and enslavement paths multiplied several times over.

# Chapter 547: Search for Success

Flipping through The Legends of Ren Zu, Fang Yuan read:

When Ren Zu was trapped in Luo Po valley with no way out, facing certain death—

To save her father, Desolate Ancient Moon climbed Cheng Bai mountain to obtain the sole success Gu at its peak.

Reaching the foot of the mountain, Desolate Ancient Moon was obstructed by the rockman.

Love Gu appeared before her, laughing: "You interrupted my sweet dream. Now I will topple Cheng Bai mountain—find that success Gu among billions of rocks!"

Troubled and left with no choice, Desolate Ancient Moon returned to cognition Gu for advice.

"Now that Cheng Bai mountain has collapsed, you can only check these rocks one by one to find the real success Gu. There is no other way."

Cognition Gu continued: "Be careful, for Cheng Bai mountain holds two Gu: success Gu at the peak, and failure Gu at the bottom. Failure is the mother of success. Those rocks are its siblings; picking them will cause terrible disasters. Here is a secret: as long as you firmly believe in 'me' in your heart, these disastrous situations will gradually disappear."

Her heart sinking, Desolate Ancient Moon asked: "Then how do I differentiate the rocks? What do success Gu and failure Gu look like?"

Cognition Gu sighed: "They look almost identical, but differentiating them is simple. Just hold them, and you will learn their identities."

"In your search for success Gu, failure Gu will be your greatest threat. You must not hold it, or you will become completely lost and your life endangered."

Desolate Ancient Moon breathed in deeply, picking up the first rock.

The rock seemed ordinary, but shook slightly when Desolate Ancient Moon held it.

A light wound appeared on Desolate Ancient Moon's hand.

She chanted in her heart: "Me, me, me, me..."

As she chanted, the wound miraculously healed, leaving only a faint scar.

Yet as days passed, she found only failure Gu's children.

Some rocks injured her, others brought dejection, despair, or fear, and some made her grow a pig head or rat's tail.

Though Desolate Ancient Moon chanted 'me' continuously, scars accumulated and gradually turned her into a monster.

She grew six heads, three arms, five tails, and sixteen legs bearing fur, snake scales, sharp claws, and tough hooves.

In the search for success, people often transform completely.

Yet Desolate Ancient Moon grew far stronger because of this.

Through her immense effort, fewer and fewer unpicked rocks remained.

When only two rocks remained, Desolate Ancient Moon faced a difficult choice.

Obtaining success Gu would be best, but picking failure Gu would make her lose herself completely, endangering her life.

"If fear of failure keeps me from taking the next step, I will never succeed! I am a step from success. Even if I take failure Gu, chanting 'me' will let me endure it." Mustering courage, she picked one.

Unfortunately, she picked failure Gu.

An unforseen feeling of lost, self-doubt assaulted her.

"Me, me, me..."

Desolate Ancient Moon chanted 'me', but her voice softened until her expression turned blank.

Falling into endless perplexity, she completely lost herself.

Man's greatest tragedy is losing one's sense of self.

"Sigh..." Fang Yuan sighed as he closed the book.

Northern Plains, end of December.

When Hei Lou Lan's army arrived at Imperial Court blessed land's entrance at the last minute, only about half the alliance remained.

Hei Lou Lan carried the item to open Imperial Court blessed land.

The light ring expanded, turning into a grand city gate.

As if pulled by an invisible hand, the heavy door swung open.

The airborne snow halted, instantly forming a magnificent ice ladder under mysterious power.

Connected to the floating Imperial Court gate above, the ladder extended all the way to the ground.

"Imperial Court blessed land!" Unable to conceal his excitement, Hei Lou Lan bounded up the ice ladder, becoming the first to enter the Imperial Court.

"Eighty-Eight True Yang Building..." Fang Yuan entered second, his gaze solemn as he strode calmly inside.

An hour later, the entire Hei tribe army had entered; the ice ladder shattered and the red gate closed.

# Chapter 548:  Inheritance hidden in Eerie Fire Python’s den

When Fang Yuan opened his eyes, his surroundings had completely transformed.

Under a pale golden sky lay green terraces, gentle streams, and rolling mounds.

Fang Yuan looked around and found that he was alone.

"Originally created by an unnamed space path Gu Immortal, this blessed land is vast, far larger than ordinary ones."

Fang Yuan climbed higher on his eagle wings, easily avoiding the flame.

Activating over ten Gu worms and expending crystal purple essence rapidly, two bronze arms grew from his body.

He plunged like a comet straight toward the python.

He crashed into the eerie fire dragon python, engaging in fierce combat.

Eerie fire dragon python was a mutated beast king, mutated beasts has rank four battle strength, while their king had strength equivalent to a rank five Gu Master. But Fang Yuan was rank five peak stage long ago, and after using his killer move, his battle strength was even higher.

After half an hour, the battle was over.

Charred black, Fang Yuan stood amid the utterly devastated valley.

Fang Yuan coughed a few times, throwing up some blood.

Fang Yuan started collecting his loot.

The carcass was valuable: its blood fed blood path Gu, while its skin and tendons fetched high prices.

The eerie fire snake gall in particular was valuable enough to be sold in treasure yellow heaven.

Of Huo Zheng Jun's seven Gu worms, four had died over the years, leaving only three.

Fire pupil Gu ignited flames wherever the user looked, catching foes off guard with its convenient offense.

Fang Yuan reviewed it thrice, storing the information in east window Gu.

Storing the three Gu worms in his aperture, Fang Yuan shattered the stele.

Searching further, he found a cave and descended a hundred meters underground, discovering six eerie fire dragon python eggs.

Collecting the eggs, he promptly left the sweltering cave and took to the sky, resuming his journey without hesitation.

# Chapter 550: Poet Immortal’s demise on Xing Jiu peak

"Blatant demonic acts clash with my identity and bring no benefit. I may as well spare Pan Ping for later..."

Thus, Fang Yuan said: "Since you admit your mistake, very good. A junior should act like one. Do you understand?"

"Un... understood..." Pan Ping squeezed out through shut eyes, seething with fury.

Fang Yuan snickered, seeing through him: "Very good. Now compensate me. To educate you, I lost fifteen wolves whose corpses lie here."

"What?!" Pan Ping opened his eyes out of pure rage.

"Unwilling?" Fang Yuan smiled lightly, mocking Pan Ping like a cat toying with a mouse.

"I am willing!" Pan Ping took a deep breath, nodding in submission.

"A proper junior's attitude." Fang Yuan chuckled with a gentle smile that appeared terrifying to everyone present.

Laughing, Fang Yuan extorted all of Pan Ping's Gu recipes and several Gu worms.

Bored of toying with Pan Ping, Fang Yuan took flight: "There are still unique treasures inside—go claim them."

By seniority, Zhu Zai and Pan Ping charged in first.

Inside, they found only poems; Fang Yuan had swept away every Gu worm and recipe.

"Lord Wolf King was right, these truly are *unique* treasures." Zhu Zai laughed bitterly, holding the poems.

He abruptly spat blood and fainted from rage.

Several days later.

"At this speed, the sacred palace should be close," Fang Yuan mused atop the azure myriad wolf king.

"Eh? This terrain is so familiar, don't tell me..."

# Chapter 552: Giant Sun Immortal Venerable

A mound protruded high above the ground.

The smooth mound bore an opening resembling a large underground tunnel.

*"Light in the soil, shine up to a hundred thousand feet high, swimming in the sky for a hundred li, praising plum fragrant snow."* Seeing this scene, Fang Yuan recalled the verse.

"Is this Di Qiu inheritance ground?" Fang Yuan felt a flash of realization.

A fake grey-white stone slab's painting idea Gu had etched this Di Qiu inheritance map into his mind.

Flying overhead, he confirmed the terrain matched his memory perfectly.

"Di Qiu inheritance... set inside Imperial Court blessed land using a deceptive grey-white stone slab, the creator spent immense effort. It must be extraordinary."

Fang Yuan flew to the mound, observed the entrance, summoned several azure wolves, and entered the dark tunnel.

Investigating personally, he still found nothing.

Frowning, he left: "If this inheritance were easy, others would have claimed it long ago."

"Reaching this requires two conditions: obtaining the clue by having a skilled appraisal Gu Master decipher the grey-white stone slab, secondly, they need to enter Imperial Court blessed land, that means they need to survive the Imperial Court contest, thus they need to have a keen eye, in order to be part of the victors."

"This inheritance is not simple. To obtain it, I must interpret the cipher," Fang Yuan concluded.

"No matter, I still have time inside Imperial Court blessed land."

Fang Yuan flew toward the sacred palace with his wolves, the core purpose of his plans.

Landscape as before Gu was his top priority, alongside Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's inheritance inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

Sacred palace, the central control hall.

The silvery brilliant light shone on Hei Lou Lan's face.

He looked up at the central control hall's plaque, his bear-like frame standing upright under the silver light.

As alliance leader with Huang Jin bloodline, entering Imperial Court blessed land automatically brought him to the sacred palace.

"Lord." Cunning Gentleman Sun Shi Han came over, calling out softly.

"What is it?" Hei Lou Lan turned, concealing his expression beneath his usual arrogant, boorish demeanor.

Cunning Gentleman presented a letter: "Pan Ping claims Chang Shan Yin monopolized an inheritance and extorted him, begging lord for justice."

"This is only Pan Ping's side; Zhu Zai should have sent a letter too." Hei Lou Lan observed sharply.

Scanning the second letter, Hei Lou Lan remained expressionless, revealing nothing to Sun Shi Han.

Combined with Zhu Zai's letter, Hei Lou Lan understood the full situation.

With a squeeze of his hand, dark light corroded both letters into nothingness.

"Once Pan Ping and the others arrive, compensate them from the supply camp," Hei Lou Lan instructed.

"Yes, lord." Cunning Gentleman bowed, then asked in confusion: "Are we not punishing Wolf King Chang Shan Yin?"

"Punish? What a joke!" Hei Lou Lan laughed. "Why punish him? I would have done the same, just less crudely."

"Shi Han, you overthink. By bullying the weak and greedily hoarding the inheritance, his reputation is ruined. Furthermore, lacking Huang Jin bloodline, he cannot enter True Yang Building without a guest token."

Hei Lou Lan continued: "This proves Chang Shan Yin is only a mortal with desires and greed, making things easy. Moreover, I hold both Chang and Ge tribes in my hands. As a rank five peak stage genius, he surely seeks advancement. But I will only reveal the method to reach Gu Immortal after he joins Hei tribe."

"I know you hate Chang Shan Yin, but I need him when challenging True Yang Building. Do not bother me with such petty matters again. Understood?"

"Yes lord." Cunning Gentleman lowered his head, his voice slightly trembling.

"This subordinate takes his leave." Disappointed, Sun Shi Han exited the central control hall.

# Chapter 553: Imperial Court Sacred Palace

Fang Yuan rode the azure wolf king through the sky, wind blowing through his hair.

Pondering solemnly, he had made no progress deciphering the Di Qiu inheritance quote over recent days.

A glorious palace gradually emerged on the plains' horizon.

Sacred palace, he was finally there!

Drawing closer, the grand palace slowly revealed its full majesty.

It stood eight tiers tall, each roughly two kilometers high, with each level stacked upon the last.

As Fang Yuan touched down, an escort Gu Master greeted him: "Lord Wolf King, welcome. It is my honor to escort you. Your quarters on the eighth level are already prepared."

"No rush, show me around first," Fang Yuan said, dismounting, as riding steeds inside the sacred palace was forbidden.

Fang Yuan followed the escort Gu Master into the sacred palace.

"Let's go, bring me to the eighth level's accommodation." Fang Yuan sighed, instruction.

The only treasure in the sacred palace was the most valuable thing in Imperial Court blessed land—and Northern Plains.

At the eighth level's peak stood Eighty-Eight True Yang Building!

A Gu house personally crafted by Long Hair Ancestor at Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's behest.

The eighth level's peak was completely empty; Eighty-Eight True Yang Building would appear only when the ten-year blizzard struck.

In the following days, Fang Yuan cultivated in seclusion, waiting for True Yang Building to open.

During this period, Hei Lou Lan sent invitations, expressing intention to recruit him.

Fang Yuan feigned interest, though he resolved to refuse in his heart.

Human skin Gu disguised him as Wolf King, but as a mortal Gu, an Immortal Gu's investigation could expose him.

Hei Lou Lan never mentioned Xing Jiu peak, though rumors spread describing Wolf King as tyrannical for bullying the weak.

Fang Yuan laughed inwardly; someone was clearly smearing his reputation behind the scenes.

"Pan Ping, Sun Shi Han, or even Hei Lou Lan has motive. But so what if my reputation turns sour?"

Half a month later, water-like ripples appeared in the golden sky.

The entire land started shaking.

Sudden winds arose as a piercing light shone atop the sacred palace.

After forty-five minutes, the light dispersed, revealing a tower in the previously barren area.

Eighty-Eight True Yang Building!

# Chapter 554: Plotting is difficult, Living is tough

"This is only Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's initial appearance. Each layer will stabilize only when snow covers Northern Plains and all the blessed land's small towers sink into the ground. Only then can one enter and explore." Standing at his residence's entrance, Fang Yuan gazed toward the dome.

"Even when Eighty-Eight True Yang Building fully forms, I cannot enter without Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's bloodline. I'll need a guest token from Hei Lou Lan. Well, there is no hurry, is True Yang Building so easy to rush into? Hei Lou Lan will need external help like me sooner or later."

Fang Yuan entered a secret cultivation room and sat upright on a cushion.

"Both my apertures are at rank five peak stage. Between my azure wolves, the killer move four arm wind king, and my battle experience, I stand at the mortal peak. But against a Gu Immortal..."

He knew well the vast gulf between mortal and immortal; defying an immortal was as hard as ascending to heaven.

Ideally, Tai Bai Yun Sheng would already hold the Immortal Gu Landscape As Before recipe in his mind.

Striking in Northern Plains was ill-advised, but Eighty-Eight True Yang Building offered the perfect opportunity.

He could seize River as Before and Mountain as Before Gu, then plunder the Immortal Gu recipe from Tai Bai Yun Sheng's mind.

Fang Yuan could then slay the mortal Tai Bai Yun Sheng and have Lang Ya land spirit refine Landscape As Before.

However, the chances of the mortal Tai Bai Yun Sheng possessing the Landscape As Before Immortal Gu recipe were virtually nonexistent.

Furthermore, past-life rumors held that when Tai Bai Yun Sheng ascended, heaven and earth reacted, causing the two rank five Gu to spontaneously fuse into rank six Immortal Gu Landscape As Before.

Prudent by nature, Fang Yuan would never pin all his hopes on an indistinct future.

"If things go awry, I must confront Gu Immortal Tai Bai Yun Sheng alone. My azure wolves and four arm wind king won't be enough."

His only true hope lay in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building!

While spring filled Imperial Court blessed land, outside in Northern Plains, snow had fallen relentlessly for over a month.

Across Northern Plains, surviving tribes large and small sheltered in geographic havens like Warm Pond Valley to endure the blizzard.

Man tribe who occupied Hong Yan valley was one of them.

Hall of affairs.

The elders lined up in two rows before Man tribe's leader on the main seat.

Rank three external elder Shi Wu knelt: "Lord tribe leader, I come forward to beg for forgiveness."

"Oh, what is your fault?" Man Tu asked with a slight smile.

"Reporting to Lord Tribe Leader, spirit spring D under my care suddenly froze and dried up yesterday; it is now ruined," Shi Wu replied respectfully.

"Rise, Elder Shi Wu. During the ten-year disaster, spirit springs freezing is not your fault."

"However, spirit springs are major tribal affairs. Man Duo, how many do we have left?" Man Tu asked, frowning slightly.

Man Duo, Man Tu's shrewd third son, assisted him in handling tribal affairs.

He replied: "Father, Hong Yan valley has seven spirit springs left, but two will dry up within a month."

"Alright." Man Tu nodded. "Meaning in a month, we will only have five. Elders, what do you think?"

Man Tu nodded: "Spirit springs are vital for cultivation. The blizzard has just begun, and snow monsters will soon roam. Hong Yan valley's defense relies mainly on our Gu Masters."

He paused, then decreed: "Take a spring egg Gu from the warehouse and plant it as the new spirit spring D."

"Lord tribe leader, spring egg Gu is a rank five Gu." An elder objected in heartache.

Man Tu raised his brows: "Only with primeval stones can our Gu Masters advance and resist snow monsters. Preserving our Gu Masters preserves our strength to realize our ambitions once the blizzard passes!"

"Together, we shall seek supremacy!" Man Tu laughed heartily, then ordered, "Elder Shi Wu will oversee the new spirit spring D."

Deeply moved, Shi Wu's eyes reddened: "I will do my utmost to repay Lord Tribe Leader's trust!"

Shi Wu followed Man Duo to the tribe warehouse and took a spring egg Gu.

"This is spring egg Gu?" Shi Wu held the Gu with trembling hands, staring in awe.

Composing himself, he bowed to Man Duo. "Third Young Master, please instruct me on activating this Gu."

Man Duo smiled: "This rank five Gu demands immense essence; even a rank five master cannot activate it alone. With rank three cultivation, using lasting Gu and continuing Gu, planting the spirit spring will still take nearly a month. Worry not, Elder, I will assist you throughout."

# Chapter 555: Dancing snow claws, Appearance of the building

The location to create the spirit spring had already been decided.

Accompanied by Man Duo, Shi Wu channeled primeval essence into the spring egg Gu.

Inspecting the progress days later, Man Duo was overjoyed. "Almost there! Faint cracks have appeared; once it breaks, we succeed. Elder Shi Wu has worked hard."

Shi Wu's face fell: "Oh no, flying hand snow!"

Man Duo turned in shock: "How can there be flying hand snow in Hong Yan valley?!"

Fierce winds howled as palm-sized snowflakes bearing rank five Gu aura descended from the sky.

"Quickly, protect the spring egg Gu!" Man Duo shouted, summoning nearby Gu Masters.

Flying hand snow shattered their defense, gathering into a giant palm that seized the spring egg Gu before their helpless eyes.

Snowflakes drifted to the ground; the rank five spring egg Gu inside had vanished.

Fang Yuan let his wolves roam freely while soaring overhead on eagle wings, gazing down at the ground.

It was Di Qiu inheritance.

He had been visiting the inheritance grounds every few days.

Instinct told him that this Di Qiu inheritance was not simple.

Now second only to Hei Lou Lan, Fang Yuan's every move was scrutinized; he was no longer inconspicuous.

Imperial Court blessed land teemed with beasts and resources; countless wild Gu and worms gathered around the small towers.

Astride the azure myriad wolf king, Fang Yuan watched a glowing small tower slowly sink into the ground.

As Eighty-Eight True Yang Building gradually formed, the small towers across Imperial Court blessed land sank into the earth.

These small towers acted as nests housing all the wild Gu spawned over the past ten years.

Many surmised these wild Gu provided the energy to form Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, making the small towers part of the building itself.

"These towers are indeed part of it." Fang Yuan knew more than ordinary Gu Immortals, possessing complete information on the building.

His source was Lang Ya land spirit—formerly the rank eight Gu Immortal Long Hair Ancestor, who created Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

"Wait!" Fang Yuan jolted as a flash of inspiration dispelled his confusion.

He finally discovered the anomaly about Di Qiu—there was no small tower near it!

"Logically, a small tower should stand every eight li, each corresponding to a Northern Plains region. Yet near Di Qiu, there is nothing!"

Suppressing his excitement, he finished his hunting route before returning to the sacred palace.

Three days later, the aurora coalesced and took form.

The first layer of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building had formed!

Hei Lou Lan entered excitedly, only to emerge hours later battered and covered in wounds.

During the second expedition, he brought many Hei tribe Gu Masters.

Bearing Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's bloodline, Hei tribesmen could freely enter and exit True Yang Building.

Hei Lou Lan returned exhausted, and only sixty percent of the Gu Masters made it back.

True Yang Building proved treacherous at every step, yet offered enticing rewards...

# Chapter 556: It's actually a Gu Immortal Inheritance!

*Bam!*

Hei Lou Lan kicked his clansman Hei Qi Sheng to the ground.

"Useless thing!" cursed the black fatty, his face twitching with savage ruthlessness.

"Useless trash! Speak—how do we clear the 54th round? The tribe doesn't feed freeloaders! I gave you primeval stones, status, and luxury—now perform your duties!" Hei Lou Lan roared, rattling the windows.

First Elder Hei Pei stepped forward: "Lord, the 54th round tests enslavement path; it requires master-level attainment. Though Elder Hei Qi Sheng is our enslavement Gu Master, he is no master. We need Wolf King's strength to pass."

"Hmph, outside help? You want the world to laugh at Hei tribe as weaklings who need external aid?" Hei Lou Lan roared fiercely.

Trembling inside, Hei Pei bowed low. "Lord Tribe Leader is wise and mighty, Lord of the Imperial Court. None would dare call Hei tribe useless. Besides, Wolf King Chang Shan Yin belongs to our alliance army as your subordinate. Utilizing him is only natural. As an outsider, being granted entry to True Yang Building is the greatest honor—Chang Shan Yin will surely be grateful."

Hei Lou Lan heard this and his angered expression softened.

He held two guest tokens from clearing earlier rounds.

He wasn't merely saving tokens; inviting Wolf King meant the 54th round's reward would go to Chang Shan Yin.

Hei Lou Lan stopped walking: "Where is Hei Shu?"

Hei Shu, his personal attendant, entered upon hearing the summons.

"Go invite Wolf King here." Hei Lou Lan instructed.

Hei Shu soon returned apologetically. "Lord Tribe Leader, Lord Wolf King is outside feeding his wolves, not in the sacred palace."

"What?" Hei Lou Lan's voice rose, his brows furrowing in renewed anger.

"Lord, it's not my fault!" Hei Shu pleaded. "I sent a letter, but Wolf King replied that he was hunting with his wolves and wouldn't interrupt his routine. He asked us to wait, or summon Tang Miao Ming and the others instead."

Reading the star letter Gu, Hei Lou Lan sneered, "This Wolf King has patience, controlling his desires so well."

In truth, Fang Yuan was not focusing on True Yang Building at all.

He looked at Di Qiu below: "There really is no small tower here, only a pitch-black hole... the Gu Master who created this inheritance is impressive!"

"No, rather than a Gu Master, call him a Gu Immortal! Even with time weakening Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's setup, it is nothing mortals can alter. Only Gu Immortals can modify these arrangements to create such a place." Fang Yuan's eyes flickered with uncertainty.

He had accidentally gotten Di Qiu inheritance, but it was a Gu Immortal inheritance!

Light in the soil, shine up to a hundred thousand feet high, swimming in the sky for a hundred li, praising plum fragrant snow. What did this really mean?

Who was this "Gu Immortal Di Qiu"? Why set up an inheritance here, and how did an immortal enter? Most importantly, how did they understand this setup and the principles behind Eighty-Eight True Yang Building?

A star letter Gu tore through the sky toward him.

Fang Yuan caught it; Hei Lou Lan was urging him to return.

"I'll enter True Yang Building first. Inside, I may find clues to unravel this mystery!"

"I'll need to rely on Wolf King's strength this time." Hei Lou Lan laughed upon seeing Fang Yuan.

At the building, Hei Lou Lan handed Fang Yuan an ancient token: "Lacking Huang Jin bloodline, you will need a guest token each time you enter."

Taking the token, Fang Yuan chuckled nonchalantly: "I can't wait to witness the splendor of True Yang Building!"

Hei Lou Lan did not push the door open, but crashed straight into it.

With his guest token glowing, Fang Yuan entered True Yang Building as well.

# Chapter 557: Three grades of evaluation, clearing with high grade?

Fang Yuan felt his body stiffen as intense pressure assaulted him upon entering the building.

Having fully entered True Yang Building, a lake appeared before him.

The guest token melted into cold liquid, flowing through his fingers.

Looking around, he found himself on an island in the center of the lake, with Hei Lou Lan beside him.

"This is the 54th round." Hei Lou Lan looked forward without turning: "Look, that is the problem Brother Shan Yin has to deal with."

On the island, there was a group of water snake lions.

These water snake lions had bright blue fur, webbed feet, and venomous snake tails coiling across their backs.

Even without Hei Lou Lan's introduction, a stream of mystical information surged into Fang Yuan's mind—

"Use the hedgehog fish to breach the water snake lions' defense and occupy the island over there."

In the jade-blue water around the island, shadows of hedgehog fish swam.

"No need to worry brother Shan Yin, we are here today for practice." Hei Lou Lan patted Fang Yuan's shoulders.

Fang Yuan estimated that commanding these hedgehog fish against the lions was almost guaranteed success.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had divided every round's evaluation into low, middle, and high grade.

A low grade pass yielded the fewest rewards and sent challengers straight to the next round.

A middle grade pass doubled those rewards and provided advance information regarding the next round.

A high grade pass doubled middle grade rewards and transported the challenger deep into True Yang Building to the treasure room.

The treasure room held countless treasures, including several true immortal inheritances left by Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

Hei Lou Lan was satisfied with a low grade pass to reach the 55th round, but Fang Yuan aimed higher.

He needed a high grade pass to access the treasure room alone and deploy his prepared methods.

"A low grade pass is effortless, but I don't know the conditions for middle or high grade. I can only try!"

Fang Yuan took a deep breath and nodded at Hei Lou Lan to begin.

Hei Lou Lan drew a token and waved it toward the sky.

Unlike the guest token, this owner token signified Hei Lou Lan's status as alliance leader.

The owner token vibrated, rippling the air to reveal dozens of rank one, two, and three fish enslavement Gu.

Fang Yuan easily refined the Gu worms, while the others were restrained by an invisible force, unable to assist.

Only Hei Lou Lan could still speak, advising: "Brother Shan Yin, mind the time. You only have fifteen minutes."

Fang Yuan nodded and waved, sending the fish enslavement Gu flying out in dozens of mystical lights.

Every fish was instantly enslaved and swam forward, answering Fang Yuan's command without a single failure.

Alerted, the water snake lions shed their lethargy and sat up, lion heads roaring while snake tails hissed.

Many water snake lions leaped into the water, establishing a defensive line.

Yet the fish group did not attack as expected, instead circling the area to survey the surroundings.

Growing anxious, Hei Lou Lan urged: "Brother Shan Yin, time is running out."

"No rush." Fang Yuan was calm as he replied casually.

Seeing the fish hold back, several water snake lions crawled onto the island, weakening their defensive line.

Just as the crowd grew restless, Fang Yuan chuckled and commanded the fish to charge, attacking the water snake lions from all directions.

The sudden strike caught the water snake lions completely off guard.

Like hungry sharks, the hedgehog fish instantly devoured the few water snake lions in the water.

Enraged by the slaughter of its pride, the old lion king roared and led the lions into the water for revenge.

Curiously, Fang Yuan halted the ferocious assault and ordered the fish group to retreat.

The lions gave chase, only to plunge into sudden chaos in a particular stretch of water.

"So there was a hidden whirlpool here!" Hei Lou Lan mumbled.

As the whirlpool trapped the water snake lions, the fish group turned and struck.

The bulky lions were severely hindered by the whirlpool, whereas the small fish were barely affected.

Under Fang Yuan's control, the fish moved like an elite troop, picking off the trapped lions one by one.

"Good, what a Wolf King!" Hei Lou Lan laughed and clapped.

Upon slaying the lions, information entered Fang Yuan's mind—high grade evaluation!

The next moment, Fang Yuan vanished on the spot.

# Chapter 558: Giant Sun’s great scheme, treasure within the crystal

Fang Yuan was in a long crystal hallway.

Gazing around, Fang Yuan saw walls behind and to his flanks; he could only move forward.

Gu worms and recipes appeared embedded in the crystal walls, fixed like insects in amber.

These were treasures of the treasure room; obtaining them required exchanging items of equivalent value.

"Oh? A Heavenly Essence Treasure King Lotus." Fang Yuan halted, spotting a familiar Gu sealed in the crystal wall before him.

"The Heavenly Essence Treasure Lotus line acts as portable spirit springs, producing primeval essence naturally once refined. While rank three is useless to me now, the rank five Heavenly Essence Treasure King Lotus suits my current condition perfectly."

"Then let's trade." Owning a blessed land gave Fang Yuan the wealth and foundation of a Gu Immortal.

His core Gu and Spring Autumn Cicada were non-negotiable.

"Oh? Why are there eighteen spring egg Gu?"

Fang Yuan was shocked to find a batch of precious rank five Gu inside his first aperture.

He quickly realized: "This is the high grade evaluation reward, sent directly into my aperture."

Though spring egg Gu fell short of Heavenly Essence Treasure King Lotus, it was still a rank five Gu.

Fang Yuan retrieved a spring egg Gu to inspect it.

Fang Yuan sneered: "This Gu was snatched by flying hand snow. So this is where True Yang Building's rewards come from."

To realize his dream of hereditary rule, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had painstakingly schemed to ensure his descendants maintained absolute dominance.

The contest weakened rivals, while the blizzard funneled Northern Plains' treasures into Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

In Fang Yuan's previous life, Central Continent Gu Immortals exploited this trait of True Yang Building to destroy Imperial Court blessed land.

They deliberately scattered Gu for flying hand snow to seize, sabotaging True Yang Building from within.

Fang Yuan brought the spring egg Gu near the crystal wall sealing the Heavenly Essence Treasure King Lotus.

As it approached, the crystal wall glowed light red, turned orange, and finally settled on yellow.

Sneering, Fang Yuan brought a fourth spring egg Gu to the crystal wall.

This time, green light erupted, balancing alongside the other three colors.

The crystal wall turned ethereal; the Heavenly Essence Treasure King Lotus drifted out as the four spring egg Gu took its place.

Catching the Heavenly Essence Treasure King Lotus, Fang Yuan instantly refined it with his primeval essence.

Eighty-Eight True Yang Building was truly marvelous, allowing Gu Masters to refine Gu instantly inside.

"Eight tiers in total. The more colors illuminated, the more precious the treasure. Rank five Heavenly Essence Treasure King Lotus is merely a green-tier mid-grade item."

Fang Yuan reflected inwardly, his appreciation and understanding of the treasure room deepening.

Fang Yuan continued moving forward.

Though the hallway seemed endless, a stele blocked Fang Yuan's path.

The smooth, square stele was knee-high, inscribed with two words in Northern Plains script: Guest Halt!

"Guest halt? Hmph." Fang Yuan laughed coldly in disdain.

He tried walking past the stele, but was blocked by an invisible wall.

"The guest halt stele functions properly; I cannot force my way through." Fang Yuan sat before the stele.

Immediately, he took out a Gu worm, and it shot into the stele.

The first step to refining Eighty-Eight True Yang Building has started!

# Chapter 559: Immortal Venerable’s Will

Refining Eighty-Eight True Yang Building sounded absurd, but it was no mere wishful thinking.

In his previous life, Central Continent Gu Immortals attacked by sending Gu Masters to infiltrate the treasure room.

Once successful, they recorded the entire procedure with Gu worms and broadcasted it to the world.

After his rebirth, he immediately realized the huge value of this video.

While the clip only revealed surface details, Fang Yuan luckily possessed firsthand information from Lang Ya land spirit.

Combining theory with practical knowledge gave Fang Yuan far greater confidence in refining Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

"At my current cultivation level, fully refining Eighty-Eight True Yang Building is impossible, but I can refine a portion of it."

Weathered by ages, Eighty-Eight True Yang Building harbored loopholes like a colossal wooden cage.

A termite could never bring down the entire cage, but chewing through its corners was vastly easier.

Once the specialized Gu entered the guest halt stele, it gave off a faint yellow light.

Fang Yuan extended his palms, injecting primeval essence from his aperture into the stele.

Simultaneously, his will entered the guest halt stele alongside his primeval essence.

Fang Yuan's brows knitted tightly as his mind entered the stele.

As a rank eight Immortal Gu House, Eighty-Eight True Yang Building was immense.

Upon entering, Fang Yuan's will found itself in a sea of darkness.

"Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's will?" Fang Yuan's mind went on high alert.

Though Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had long perished, the will he infused still survived, slumbering within this shell.

"Fortunately, this will is dormant. I must not wake it, or my soul will disperse like the Gu Immortals in the video."

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's remnant will was like a slumbering sun at the center, radiating faint light.

Fang Yuan's will was like a sesame seed, lurking in the farthest corner.

Fang Yuan continued to inject primeval essence, slowly and carefully.

As primeval essence entered the guest halt stele, more of his will expanded into Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

"Refining this stele is astonishingly difficult. Without Heavenly Essence Treasure King Lotus, even two rank five peak stage apertures wouldn't suffice."

Four hours passed; Fang Yuan finally exhaled and pulled his palms back from the stele.

"I finally succeeded."

Yet the joy of success faded quickly as Fang Yuan's frown deepened.

"The video from my previous life cut out footage. That Gu Master refined it in one hour, yet I expended far more primeval essence."

Refining Eighty-Eight True Yang Building was dangerous; if misled by the video, a single mistake would prove fatal.

"Eighty-Eight True Yang Building is truly phenomenal. After all this time, I haven't even refined half a percent."

If he looked at Eighty-Eight True Yang Building as a hundred percent, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's remnant will would occupy thirty percent of it.

He turned, stepped back, and casually approached a crystal wall sealing several treasures.

Now that the guest halt stele was refined, the crystal wall turned hollow.

Fang Yuan reached into the wall as if plunging into water, retrieving the treasure inside.

"Oh? This must be the rush thunder stone..."

Rush thunder stone was a rare, nearly extinct Gu refinement material, rarely sold even within treasure yellow heaven.

Yet soon after, Fang Yuan returned the rush thunder stone to the crystal wall.

Small greed ruins big plans.

Because obtaining treasures required exchange, the total amount within the crystal walls remained constant.

If anyone later entered with a high-grade evaluation and found missing treasures, it would cause immense suspicion.

Feeling no regret, Fang Yuan finished testing and walked deeper into the crystal path.

Created by Long Hair Ancestor, Eighty-Eight True Yang Building naturally possessed other defenses.

Several mystical Gu flew from his aperture, shrouding him in colorful smoke.

Glancing around, Fang Yuan found the treasures in these walls a tier higher than before.

"Oh? This is..."

Fang Yuan's gaze froze as he spotted a rank five strength path Gu within the crystal wall.

# Chapter 560: Crucial problem

A borrow strength Gu appeared in front of him.

This nearly extinct rank five strength path Gu was rarer than all-out effort Gu, usable only when paired with other Gu.

"Four arm wind king uses wind overlord and tyrant strength to substitute for borrow strength Gu, achieving less than half its effect. With this borrow strength Gu, I can raise my killer move to a whole new level!" Fang Yuan was overjoyed.

Fang Yuan approached the crystal wall and exchanged nearly ten spring egg Gu for the borrow strength Gu.

Once this protective blood flame disappeared, Eighty-Eight True Yang Building would detect and instantly eradicate him.

"Before this protection disappears, I must find that owner token!"

Deceiving Eighty-Eight True Yang Building required costly Gu refined from a thousand jin of meticulously purified Huang Jin blood.

Memories of Central Continent Gu Immortals attacking the blessed land proved invaluable.

Hurrying forward while scanning the treasures, Fang Yuan suddenly paused: "Found it!"

An owner token was sealed in the crystal wall at knee height.

Nearly a millennium ago, Central Continent Gu Immortals schemed in secret, bribing that era's alliance leader and allegedly employing an Immortal Gu.

Using the Immortal Gu's power, they tampered with this owner token and concealed it inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building as a future key.

Exchanging for the owner token was effortless, but making it usable would not be easy.

Gu worms repeatedly struck the owner token at his command.

Once thirty-eight halos formed, the dull surface cleared, revealing the words 'owner token'.

Biting his finger, he dripped blood onto the owner token.

As his blood seeped in, the metallic token turned to translucent glass, drastically differing from Hei Lou Lan's authentic token.

"The method I used just now came from my past life's video, awakening this owner token's true form. This is likely the power of an Immortal Gu—only an Immortal Gu could tamper with an owner token without alerting Eighty-Eight True Yang Building." Looking at the glass token, Fang Yuan sank into contemplation.

A dozen breaths later, the blood flame light completely dispersed.

"Safe and sound." With his racing heartbeat subsiding, Fang Yuan stood up and exhaled turbid air.

Six days later.

# Chapter 569: Six Arm Heavenly Zombie King

Atop the sacred palace, two layers of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building had already formed, with crowds entering and exiting daily.

"Young man, I advise preparing the ink transformation killer move I taught you. It will save you trouble in the central control hall."

Fang Yuan snorted inwardly: "Several of its Gu worms are extinct, and collecting them requires significant effort. How can it be rushed?"

Presently, Fang Yuan could only think using space thought Gu.

Imbued with spatial power from space thought Gu, these thoughts prevented Mo Yao's will from reading them.

Will stood above thoughts. Over time, Mo Yao's will in his mind would grow familiar with these space thoughts, eventually breaching his defense.

"Hehehe, how terrifying..." Mo Yao patted her chest, unconcerned. "Yet over this half month, you've attacked me twenty-eight times across nineteen methods. Are you cultivating wisdom path alongside strength and enslavement?"

Sensing Fang Yuan's killing intent, Mo Yao waved her fingers: "I'm your benefactor—isn't calamity beckoning Gu yours now? A mortal possessing an Immortal Gu is an amazing feat. Rest assured, once you return Water Pavilion to Spirit Affinity House, my wish will be fulfilled and this will shall vanish."

"Young man, the refinement killer move ink transformation I taught you is priceless. You wish to exploit Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's loophole—hehe, your daring rivals my own. I will help you, so long as you return Water Pavilion to Spirit Affinity House," Mo Yao urged.

"Hmph, calamity beckoning Gu is mine, and I want Water Pavilion too—even Eighty-Eight True Yang Building might become mine! How can a mere will stop me?" Having clashed dozens of times, Fang Yuan rejected her flatly.

With a lonely expression, she sighed deeply: "Are all men like this? Even when wrong, they remain utterly confident and unyielding in their convictions."

"What counts as wrong in this world? Right and wrong are merely different ways of living."

Mo Yao laughed cheekily: "An interesting answer. But I once heard one far more domineering: "In this world, whatever I think and do is right; whoever differs is wrong." Hehehe, domineering enough?"

Fang Yuan's eyes flashed: "Sword Immortal Bo Qing? Unfortunately, he failed that final step."

In his mind, he found one of Mo Yao's thoughts.

This was a killer move, named — Six Arm Heavenly Zombie King!

Striving to combine strength and enslavement paths, Fang Yuan had previously devised an initial strength path killer move—Four Arm Earth King.

When Mo Yao's will invaded his mind, he deliberately revealed this killer move and his ideas for refining it.

Combining his foundation with Fairy Mo Yao's attainment, Six Arm Heavenly Zombie King neared perfection.

Centered on borrow strength Gu, supplemented by six flying zombie Gu and thirty-six supporting worms, its exquisite design filled Fang Yuan with awe.

"I know the five great flying zombie Gu, but this move requires a sixth. What Gu is that?"

The killer move within the thought remained incomplete, lacking the final crucial step.

# Chapter 570: Compromise

Fang Yuan sat on a cushion, holding an east window Gu.

Since Mo Yao's will invaded his mind, Fang Yuan had gathered extensive information on wills.

Thought, will, and emotion shared the same origin; thoughts and wills belonged to wisdom path, connecting widely with other paths.

The more he learned, the clearer it became: his current wisdom path foundation could not purge Mo Yao's will.

Pondering on his cushion, Fang Yuan's gaze turned cold as he reached a decision.

Focusing inward, he summoned Mo Yao's will, whose alluring figure emerged from the pitch-black void of his mind.

"I accept your suggestion and will return Water Pavilion to Spirit Affinity House," Fang Yuan transmitted.

She had not expected him to compromise so quickly.

"A wise man yields to circumstances, and a great man shows resilience... Sadly, most people overrate themselves and refuse to bow out of pride. Throughout history, countless experts knew to compromise, but how many could actually take that step back?" Mo Yao's will sighed with deep emotion.

"Water Pavilion is fine, but useless to me. Given Hu Immortal blessed land, Immortal Crane Sect has claimed me as their disciple. Both Spirit Affinity House and Immortal Crane Sect are among Central Continent's ten great ancient sects; returning Water Pavilion will not be simple," Fang Yuan said.

Mo Yao's will chuckled: "You are my inheritor and calamity beckoning Gu is yours. Returning an Immortal Gu House carries great risks, which I recognize. To accomplish this mission, you need to be a Gu Immortal at least. I will do my best to help you become a Gu Immortal, and I will also assist you in obtaining Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.
