Mo Yao waved her hand, sending a thought into Fang Yuan's mind.

It contained the final crucial component of Six Arm Heavenly Zombie King.

Fang Yuan frowned: "Earth chief zombie? Is this truly the sixth flying zombie Gu?"

Though a formidable rank five Gu like asura zombie, heavenly demon zombie, blood wight, nightmare zombie, and plague zombie, it could not fly.

Mo Yao laughed proudly: "An ordinary earth chief zombie Gu cannot, but I modified the recipe long ago to refine a new version. When a Gu Master uses it and becomes an earth chief zombie, even without wings, they can make use of the natural magnetic field to soar into the air, and fly as they wish."

Mo Yao's modified recipe prominently featured original magnetic essence as the core addition.

Mo Yao laughed smugly: "This killer move was deduced from your concepts; you should test it on others first."

Fang Yuan nodded.

Six Arm Heavenly Zombie King boasted immense power, roughly ten times that of Four Arm Earth King or Four Arm Wind King.

With such tremendous power, any failure would produce an equally severe backlash.

"The third layer has formed!" Cheers echoed across the sacred palace.

Looking at Eighty-Eight True Yang Building atop the palace, Jiang Dong snorted and told Ma Hong Yun: "You Huang Jin Gu Masters are so lucky—any reward from inside brings immense wealth and success!"

Ma Hong Yun laughed sheepishly: "Leader is right. Sadly, my thin bloodline bars me from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, or I'd go widen my horizons."

The others looked at Ma Hong Yun warmly, one patting his shoulder: "You can still earn a fortune hunting earth chief beasts with us!"

Having saved Ma Ying Jie by chance, he had taken the surname Ma Hong Yun following Hei tribe's takeover of Ma tribe, finally gaining permission to cultivate.

His response to Jiang Dong was coached by Zhao Lian Yun before setting off.

# Chapter 571: Deserves death without pity

The earth rumbled as wolves charged relentlessly like an endless flood.

Hundred, thousand, and myriad wolf kings led packs of mutated wolves, forming a conspicuous vanguard.

Astride an azure myriad wolf king, Fang Yuan remained resolute against the buffeting winds.

Having recalled and recruited wolves across the blessed land, Fang Yuan had amassed five hundred thousand surging like a tidal sea below.

Having ranked among the five beast kings during the contest, he was now Northern Plains' undisputed top enslavement master.

Yet at this moment, a voice in his mind discouraged him.

"Hehehe, combining strength and enslavement is a tall order, young man. I advise giving it up soon."

Mo Yao's will continued: "Strength and enslavement are distinct; combining them has been an age-old conundrum. Strength is not reliant on the number of paths we walk, but the depth of our attainment."

Fang Yuan scoffed arrogantly: "Problems exist to be solved. Enslavement-strength dual cultivation remained unsolved only because I had not yet been born. My name will go down in history, alongside Star Constellation, Red Lotus, and Paradise Earth."

Across the pitted, blood-soaked battlefield strewn with limbs and corpses, five to six Gu Masters fiercely battled an earth chief beast king.

These earth chief beasts possessed humanoid torsos, snake tails, bat-like faces, and black flesh-armored bodies with whipping chest tentacles.

Trouble struck: though the hundred-beast group seemed manageable, its leader was actually an aged thousand beast king rather than a hundred beast king.

Cracking the air, the beast king's snake tail sent a Gu Master flying; he crashed down with a crushed chest and shattered bones, dying instantly.

"We're down a man and I'm low on essence!" Jiang Dong's eyes darted as he plotted an escape.

Enraged, the old earth chief beast king singled Jiang Dong out for pursuit.

"Lord Jiang Dong, please run!"

Jiang Dong spotted Ma Hong Yun, a newly joined rank one support Gu Master dispatched for scouting.

"What a fool!" Overjoyed, Jiang Dong veered directly toward Ma Hong Yun.

Ma Hong Yun watched wide-eyed as Jiang Dong lured the pursuing beast king straight toward him.

Ma Hong Yun fled, but Jiang Dong caught up in a few breaths.

Jiang Dong laughed: "Lad, your death saves my life today—it won't be in vain!"

He knocked Ma Hong Yun unconscious with a Gu worm and hurled him backward.

Yet the old beast king ignored the free meal, relentlessly pursuing Jiang Dong.

As the beast closed in, the ground shook to a thunderous roar.

A wolf tide poured from above, its aura surging like a world-engulfing deluge.

The old thousand beast king froze in terror, then turned to flee.

"The Wolf King's hunt! Hahaha, my life is spared, I'm saved!"

Yet the wolf tide crashed forward unhindered, instantly tearing him to shreds.

Astride the azure wolf, Mo Yao's will sighed mournfully: "Fang Yuan, your wolves slaughter everything in their path, friend and foe alike. Your killing intent is too strong. Are you not afraid of going against nature or defying public opinion?"

"Hmph, I gave advance warning. Blinded by greed, these ants deserve no pity when blocking my path," Fang Yuan replied coldly.

# Chapter 572: Successfully refining the Earth Chief Zombie Gu

As a righteous fairy from Spirit Affinity House, she naturally frowned upon Fang Yuan's wanton slaughter.

"Disguising himself and infiltrating Imperial Court blessed land under Northern Plains Immortals' watch proves how bold and cunning he is. Unaware of Spring Autumn Cicada, she could not fathom his greatest secret: being a transmigrator.

Fang Yuan had distinct reasons for unleashing this massacre.

In his mind, Mo Yao gasped softly, astonished by his enslavement path mastery.

# Chapter 573: Human Experimentation

In a pavilion, Fang Yuan was fiddling with earth chief zombie Gu.

Resembling a bright yellow earthworm, the Gu twined around his fingers like a wriggling snake.

Naturally cautious, Fang Yuan hesitated to use it since it came from a modified recipe.

'Double master attainment... To think this kid is a master in both enslavement and refinement paths. Such talent at his age is rare even in my memory. No wonder he has such grand ambitions of wanting to rise to the realm of venerable, equal to Thieving Heaven, Paradise Earth, Giant Sun....'

Just then, a servant reported from outside, "Lord Wolf King, the leaders of Ge tribe and Chang tribe request an audience."

Collecting his thoughts, Fang Yuan recalled summoning them and said indifferently, "Let them in."

Sheltered by the Wolf King and well-resourced, Ge Guang and Chang Ji You had both attained rank four.

Without letting them rise, Fang Yuan asked, "Have you completed what I told you a few days ago?"

"Following your orders, Lord Wolf King, the battlefield has been cleared. Altogether—" Ge Guang began reporting their gains, but Fang Yuan interrupted.

Indifferent to the spoils, Fang Yuan asked, "How many Gu Masters did you arrest?"

Chang Ji You replied reverently, "Despite Lord Father's public announcement, many Gu Masters still sneaked onto the battlefield to steal corpses and wild Gu. Over these few days, I and tribe leader Ge Guang combined our strength and were able to arrest over one hundred and eighty Gu Masters who are locked up in the prison now. As long as father commands, I will definitely spare no efforts to lock up all these escapees!"

Fang Yuan smiled: "Capturing so many is already an excellent achievement. As for the others, it is their skill that they were able to escape, there is no need to chase after them. You can leave now, and bring those detained captives here."

Soon, the two escorted nearly two hundred captives to Fang Yuan.

"Guard the entrance outside—let no one within a hundred paces," Fang Yuan commanded, dismissing them.

With the door locked and no lanterns lit, the hall plunged into darkness.

With a soft pop, the young Gu Master's head burst like a watermelon, spraying white brain matter.

"Noisy," Fang Yuan muttered softly, yet his voice echoed through the hall.

He casually waved his hand, killing the captive begging most mournfully from across the room.

"I will kill anyone else who makes noise," Fang Yuan said indifferently, his quiet voice lingering in the captives' ears.

Terrified, the entire hall fell so deathly silent that even a dropping pin could be heard.

Satisfied, Fang Yuan asked Mo Yao's will in his mind, "Now how should I experiment?"

Mo Yao chuckled, "Simple. Little brother just needs to arrange the Gu worms according to my instructions."

With each instruction from Mo Yao, Fang Yuan deployed a Gu worm.

These Gu formed the six arm heavenly zombie king killer move. He placed them around the hall per her guidance.

Once the Gu were positioned, Fang Yuan began infusing primeval essence into them per Mo Yao's guidance.

He carefully infused primeval essence into the main and supporting Gu worms in sequence.

Once activated, their light linked together to form a pale yellow house of light enclosing the hall and all the captives.

"This is?!" Fang Yuan's thoughts shook and his pupils widened.

Mo Yao's will smiled softly, explaining, "This is a Gu house."

Fang Yuan blurted out, "Is the essence of six arm heavenly zombie king a Gu house?"

Mo Yao chuckled, "The true nature of a Gu house is a killer move. Since both share the same essence, they can naturally be interchanged."

Catching her implication, Fang Yuan's eyes flashed as he asked, "From your words, couldn't all killer moves turn into Gu houses?"

"Of course." Mo Yao unhesitatingly replied, "Man is the spirit of all living beings while Gu is the essence of the world, carrier of the Great Dao. A Gu worm has one ability. What is a killer move? It is an assembly of Gu worms stacking their abilities, greatly raising a single power or producing diverse abilities for different aspects."

"Right! A Gu house is simply a solidified killer move. Compare Eighty-Eight True Yang Building with Water Pavilion: the former covers the Imperial Court, influences northern plains, plunders resources, and holds inheritances. The latter can be concealed and provides defense and storage. Such functions come not from a single Gu worm, but from Gu Masters combining multiple Gu."

"From another perspective, a Gu house is just one manifestation of a killer move. Since six arm heavenly zombie king normally affects only me, why couldn't it form a Gu house and affect many people simultaneously?"

At this thought, Fang Yuan looked ahead.

Inside the Gu house, the captive Gu Masters' bodies began to show changes.

"Wha—what is happening to me?!" Terrified cries erupted as golden scales rapidly sprouted across their skin.

"Why is an arm growing from my back!" panicked shrieks erupted, rattling the roof.

Deformed arms sprouted one after another—some dark green, some dark purple, some yellow, varying in thickness and appearing grotesque.

Fang Yuan narrowed his eyes at their dangerous auras, feeling both pleased and apprehensive.

"Mo Yao's grasp of killer moves is extraordinarily profound. Is it because most Gu Masters and Gu Immortals lack the ability to casually convert killer moves into Gu houses? Refinement path grandmaster... truly a terrifying realm!"

# Chapter 574: Mo Yao’s weakness

In the deeply secluded hall, only Fang Yuan was standing.

The pale yellow light merged into a Gu house, enclosing a floor strewn with corpses.

Almost two hundred Gu Masters died a terrible death.

With a grim expression, Fang Yuan questioned Mo Yao in his mind, "This is the killer move you devised?"

Mo Yao replied unperturbed, "Their deaths were inevitable. Six arm heavenly zombie king demands immense physical strength that their bodies could not endure."

Fang Yuan scoffed, "Do you think I can't tell? This killer move is riddled with flaws. There are at least seventeen flaws! Do not forget that we have an agreement."

Mo Yao chuckled, "Don't be rash. It is only a rough draft; as we refine it, it will meet our expectations."

She thought secretly, *"To spot seventeen flaws, his strength path attainment must also near master level."*

"I only saw seven flaws and added ten to probe her; evidently, this killer move has more than seventeen flaws," Fang Yuan assessed in his mind.

"Logically, with Mo Yao's refinement grandmaster attainment, even a rough killer move shouldn't possess so many flaws. But though she was a grandmaster, this is merely a remnant will she left behind..."

"Wisdom path is divided into thought, will, and emotion. Thinking produces thoughts; thoughts gather into wills; wills intertwine into emotions. When deep, they will be like the sea, having great control and power over oneself."

When a will contemplates a problem, it expends its own thoughts to fuse and produce new thoughts, deriving answers.

"Mo Yao's will inherited her grandmaster attainment; the flaws in six arm heavenly zombie king arose not from lack of ability, but because she dared not think too deeply out of concern for her own survival."

Lacking a power source, Mo Yao's will was destined only to weaken over time.

"My greatest advantage is that I am alive. If I drag this out, I will definitely win."

With Mo Yao's will dwelling in his mind, thinking too long generated thoughts; though space thought Gu could conceal them, Mo Yao might still find a way around it.

In the grand hall, Fang Yuan's sigh could be heard.

Misunderstanding his sigh, Mo Yao consoled, "Why sigh? I've revised the move: swap out six Gu worms and add three more."

"Oh?" Fang Yuan's brows rose, he said expressionlessly: "I am listening."

Possessing Hu Immortal blessed land, Fang Yuan easily connected to treasure yellow heaven to purchase the mortal Gu.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan instructed Ge Guang and Chang Ji You to secretly bring captured Gu Masters into the hall.

Three days later, another round of human experimentation begun.

Fang Yuan complied patiently through multiple rounds, using test subjects to spare the strain on Mo Yao's thoughts.

After half a month, during the fifteenth experiment.

Fang Yuan retrieved the dozens of Gu worms used for six arm heavenly zombie king, nodding with satisfaction.

"Six arm heavenly zombie king uses borrow strength Gu as its core, six flying zombie Gu as its foundation, and eighteen supplementary Gu, gathering zombie energy to turn the user into a flying zombie. This boosts the body over tenfold to bear immense strength," Fang Yuan noted.

"Yet because of this dense zombie energy, even with three lifeforce Gu, the transformation can only last seven minutes. Isn't that right?"

Mo Yao laughed, "Spot on, little brother. Borrow strength Gu draws upon natural phenomena in heaven and earth, which even a rank five strength path expert cannot wield casually. Thus, I chose a zombie body—its power surpasses living flesh, boasts great regeneration, and complements borrow strength Gu perfectly."

"However, maintain it too long and zombie energy will devour your lifeforce, turning you permanently into a zombie. That is the backlash."

"Lifeforce and death energy are total opposites, like archenemies. Fusing life and death is an age-old question beyond my ability; incorporating three lifeforce-boosting Gu was my absolute limit. If we put more of these Gu, it will disrupt the zombie energy and the killer move's power will fall, or even completely collapse. If we use too few of them, the time you can use this transformation will shrink, and it will turn into an impractical move."

"Mo Yao is an inkman variant human; belonging to another race, her standpoint is naturally different. Her lover was the great Sword Immortal Bo Qing—perhaps within her affection, she was simply attracted to the strong?"

"In this world, one must rely on oneself; only you are truly dependable." Sneering inwardly without showing it, Fang Yuan asked Mo Yao, "So, has the killer move six arm heavenly zombie king been completed?"

Mo Yao shook her head, "Not yet. We only tested low-rank Gu Masters; we still need high-rank subjects, preferably a rank five strength path Gu Master."

"Rank five strength path?" Fang Yuan frowned; aside from himself, he knew no one who met the criteria.

Shaking his head, Fang Yuan set the matter aside: "No rush. I've gathered the materials for ink transformation—time to explore Eighty-Eight True Yang Building again!"

# Chapter 575: Entering True Yang Building again

Fang Yuan entered the central control room once again.

At the center of the secret room, the white jade round table bore an exquisite sand-table model of Imperial Court blessed land.

Soon, his gaze froze and he gasped in surprise.

He distinctly remembered that the sand table had been covered in sticky black liquid, swirling into a whirlpool that slowly entered a hole in the table.

That hole marked the location of the Di Qiu inheritance.

Now, no trace of black liquid remained, and the Di Qiu inheritance location was fully restored.

Startled, Fang Yuan began to wonder, but Mo Yao's will chuckled, anticipating his thoughts: "Where there are gains, there are losses. Eighty-Eight True Yang Building was bound to fix that flaw; the Di Qiu cave is gone and a tower reinstated."

"Without the loophole, how do I upgrade the glass owner token?" Fang Yuan asked.

"Just create one," Mo Yao smiled. "Why else did I impart ink transformation? The black liquid was caused by that very killer move."

"A loophole cannot be created carelessly, or Giant Sun's will might awaken. Fortunately, time has created blemishes in the building. Back then, Di Qiu had the largest blemish."

"Explore the sand table per my instructions and I will help you find them."

Following Mo Yao's directions, Fang Yuan found fifty-four blemishes; thirteen were larger flaws comparable to the earlier Di Qiu location.

"Now use ink transformation to refine these flaws."

Fang Yuan obeyed, shifting his thoughts as over eight hundred Gu flew from his aperture.

Though all were mortal Gu, ten-odd among them dated back to the Medieval or even Remote Antiquity Era. Extremely rare, they were extinct across the five regions, preserved only in certain Gu Immortals' collections.

Fang Yuan had spent a considerable amount on them—at least one and a half immortal essence stones.

Concentrating fully on arranging the Gu worms, Fang Yuan shouted softly when the moment was right: "Ink transformation!"

The Gu worms formed a dark cloud that rained down, pattering onto the sand table as droplets of inky liquid.

Focusing on a specific flaw, Fang Yuan urged the inky liquid toward it.

Expending vast primeval essence, the inky liquid broke through the obstruction to form a whirlpool pouring into the flaw.

Seeing this, Mo Yao said: "Throw in your glass owner token."

Fang Yuan threw in the glass owner token as instructed.

The glass owner token vanished into the whirlpool. After four hours, the inky liquid vanished completely, and a brand-new owner token flew from the hole.

Fang Yuan grabbed the transformed token; a sharp horn-like protrusion now emerged from its edge.

"One-edge owner token, sure enough fits its name." Fang Yuan mumbled.

"In Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, when a descendant of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable clears a floor, the owner token advances to one edge, granting control over that floor. At the same time, they can enter the treasure room and take a treasure without needing an exchange. If they clear ten floors, it becomes a ten-edge owner token, allowing them to retrieve a Giant Sun inheritance from the treasure room," Mo Yao explained.

"Giant Sun inheritance?" Fang Yuan's heart thumped in excitement.

Mo Yao continued: "Giant Sun Immortal Venerable left eighty-eight inheritances in the building for his descendants. Yet historically, very few Imperial Court winners cleared ten floors. In my lifetime, fifty-three of the eighty-eight inheritances remained; I know not how many are left now."

"We found thirteen flaws in total, and each refined flaw advances the token by one edge. Refine them all, and you can easily claim a Giant Sun inheritance!"

Hearing this, Fang Yuan felt doused in cold water and laughed bitterly: "Use them all? Truth be told, I only have two immortal essence stones left—enough for just one more ink transformation."

"Oh, it was like that?" Mo Yao's gaze flashed.

"So this kid only has two immortal essence stones? Is he lying?... It must be true. No normal person can resist the temptation of Giant Sun's inheritance. Crucially, since I reside in his mind, it is impossible for him to refine them in secret."

Mo Yao smiled, suggesting: "Owner tokens can annex one another. If you take Hei Lou Lan's token, you might easily reach ten edges."

Fang Yuan's gaze sharpened: "You want me to oppose Hei Lou Lan? Hei tribe is backed by multiple Gu Immortals!"

"You are audacious enough to infiltrate Imperial Court in disguise, yet you fear mere Hei Lou Lan? Besides, I never said to kill him—merely take the owner token from his hands."

Fang Yuan frowned: "He surely guards that token with his life. How should I proceed?"

Not wanting to bother with his dilemma, Mo Yao spread her hands in his mind: "How you take the owner token from him is your problem."

# Chapter 576: Killer Move Reward

# Chapter 577: Young Master, save me...

A figure flashed like lightning, six cannon-like arms crushing a massive helmet crab to death.

Meanwhile, Chang Biao was also testing the killer move.

"Its only flaw is its hideous, sinister appearance..." Chang Biao gazed darkly into the mirror.

The Chang Biao in the mirror had greenish-gray skin, protruding fangs, yellow eyes, and messy greenish-red hair. Most horrifying were the six monstrous arms of varying shapes and sizes on his back, looking utterly ruthless and chilling.

"Hideous as it is, this is my only recourse against Chang Shan Yin!" Thinking of Fang Yuan, Chang Biao steeled his resolve.

"In truth, this move resembles his strength path killer move. His sprouts four arms on his back for six in total, whereas mine grants six extra arms, giving me eight. Beyond appearance, it proves my killer move is a tier stronger than his."

Right then, a servant arrived to report Pan Ping's visit.

'What a waste of good tea,' Chang Biao sneered inwardly before cupping his fists: "Brother Pan, you look delighted today. Made progress testing the killer move?"

"Hahaha, precisely, Brother Chang! This killer move is simply outstanding." Pan Ping laughed, then changed the topic: "However, there are flaws. After testing it three times, I felt intense abdominal pain each time the transformation ended. The pain worsens with each use. Is this a backlash from the killer move?"

"Oh?" Chang Biao's eyes narrowed. "My symptoms differ—while you suffer stomach pain, I experience dizziness, along with temporary deafness and blindness. I was just about to consult you regarding this."

Pan Ping suggested: "Three others cleared the round with us. Why not invite them to discuss this? By building rapport, we can invite them to join the Wolf Killing Alliance!"

Seeing Pan Ping bent on recruitment, Chang Biao smiled vaguely: "I already have a plan that will take effect in a few days."

Imperial Court blessed land, a thousand li from the sacred palace.

A group of Gu Masters advanced cautiously through the lush green forest.

Suddenly, shouting echoed through the trees as cultivators fled toward them. "Save us!" A group of Gu Masters rushed frantically toward them.

"Leader, judging by their attire, they're Chang tribesmen," Ma Hong Yun said hesitantly.

Seeing the Chang tribesmen deliberately rushing toward them, the leader gritted his teeth and stomped: "Split up and run!"

Everyone scattered. Snapping out of his daze, Ma Hong Yun picked a direction and fled for his life.

"Lord, that's Ma Hong Yun, Ma Ying Jie's confidant." Though appearing disheveled, the fleeing Chang tribe Gu Masters remained calm and fearless.

Their leader, Chang Biao's confidant, stared at Ma Hong Yun in disbelief: "Is he a fool? Why isn't he using his movement Gu?"

The leader quickly ordered: "You three, catch up and protect Ma Hong Yun. Also, tell Lady Chang Li to get ready ahead!"

Though elite, the Chang tribesmen faced an ordeal: Ma Hong Yun's erratic fleeing constantly created hazards. Having to divert the birds, protect him, and stay undetected, they ended up losing several elites in what should have been a flawless plan!

"S-save me..." Chang Li lay weakly on the ground, looking utterly defenseless. Her torn clothes revealed an alluring shoulder, while her disheveled hair and pitiful demeanor resembled a frightened rabbit.

Fixated solely on running for his life, Ma Hong Yun failed to notice Chang Li at all!

Stunned, Chang Li reacted at the last moment, sticking out her leg just as he passed.

Plop!

Ma Hong Yun fell flat, turning around in shock.

"Young master, please save me." Her sweet voice made Ma Hong Yun's heart flutter.

"Oh, right!" Ma Hong Yun stammered, awkwardly hoisting Chang Li before fleeing.

# Chapter 578: Connection by Marriage

"Your tribesman saved my daughter; I, Chang Biao, am profoundly grateful. This first toast is to Ma tribe leader!" Chang Biao raised his cup.

Ma Ying Jie raised his cup and replied modestly: "It was mere coincidence. Never did we expect her to be Lord Chang Biao's beloved daughter—this is Hong Yun's honor."

Seated beside him, Ma Hong Yun had become the focal point of the banquet, drawing dozens of gazes.

Having planned in advance, Pan Ping caught the cue and turned to Ma Hong Yun: "Virtuous junior, aren't you quite the hero saving the maiden?"

The man immediately stepped forward and cupped his fists: "Elder Chang Biao and esteemed lords, I was present and witnessed the entire incident. Lord Ma Hong Yun is too modest to claim credit, but I cannot let such heroism be forgotten. Emboldened by wine, I must recount what happened!"

Chang Biao smiled warmly at Ma Hong Yun before speaking again. Chang Biao paused, then continued: "Since antiquity, beauties belong with heroes. Truth be told, ever since my daughter was saved, she has been lost in thought. I inquired her of the reason and only then learned her heart was somewhere else, worrying about the young hero who had saved her during the time of danger. I held this banquet to express my gratitude and also because of this."

Before everyone, Chang Biao produced two red steel relic Gu: "The new replaces the old; a young northern plains hero like Virtuous junior cannot go unrewarded. Please accept these two red steel relic Gu as a token of my gratitude."

Ma Ying Jie nodded, smiling: "We dare not refuse Senior's generosity. Hong Yun, why haven't you kowtowed in gratitude?"

Ma Hong Yun stepped forward, kowtowing: "Many thanks for Lord Chang Biao's gift."

Under everyone's gaze, he amiably patted Ma Hong Yun's hand: "How does virtuous junior feel about my daughter?"

"Eh?" Flushing, Ma Hong Yun looked up at a loss for words, before finally stammering, "Miss Chang Li is beautiful, very beautiful."

"Hahaha!" Chang Biao laughed heartily. "Good, good. Virtuous junior, please return to your seat."

The next day, Chang Biao invited Ma Ying Jie and Ma Hong Yun to another banquet, a smaller gathering with few guests.

Placing the invitation card on the table, he ordered his servant: "Go, summon Ma Hong Yun to see me."

The servant obeyed. Reaching Ma Hong Yun's residence, he found Zhao Lian Yun lecturing him: "You fool, what kind of bullshit luck do you have? This is too good to feel real. Tribe leader Ma Ying Jie will definitely summon you about this. Explain everything in full detail—don't hide the slightest thing!"

"Also," Zhao Lian Yun's large eyes rolled, "didn't Chang Biao reward you with two red steel relic Gu? When you meet the tribe leader, offer them to him."

"What?" Ma Hong Yun's eyes widened. "I risked my life to get those! Lord Chang Biao gave them to me, and using them will advance me straight to rank two upper stage. They're precious!"

Zhao Lian Yun rolled her eyes and snapped: "What do you know? Even if you reach rank two upper stage, what good is it with your skill? What is the basis for our standing? Offering the red steel relic Gu shows loyalty. Do you think he'll keep them? He can't use them, so he'll definitely accept them and return them to you."

"Idiot!" Zhao Lian Yun rolled her eyes again. "Ma tribe has declined—few tribesmen remain, yet much needs doing. The entire tribe has only one rank three elder, Ma You Liang, and he is now crippled. Offering the Gu worms shows your loyalty. He'll gladly accept them because he recognizes that loyalty."

"Ma Ying Jie isn't petty; accepting your Gu is just a gesture, and he'll definitely return them. Why? Because he wants to set an example for tribesmen to emulate your loyalty. He'll surely return your red steel relic Gu and add more rewards. You lack ability, but you have loyalty. This is called *buying horse bones with a thousand gold.*"

They had just agreed when Ma Ying Jie's servant arrived to summon Ma Hong Yun.

Following Zhao Lian Yun's advice, Ma Hong Yun offered the two red steel relic Gu. Contrary to her expectation, Ma Ying Jie accepted them without returning them.

"Could my estimate have been wrong?" Zhao Lian Yun felt doubtful.

# Chapter 579: Deputy Elder

That evening, Ma Ying Jie brought Ma Hong Yun to Chang tribe's banquet.

After the banquet, Chang Biao invited Ma Ying Jie to talk in the study while Chang Li entertained Ma Hong Yun.

"What insights does Tribe Leader Ma have regarding six arm heavenly zombie king?" After some discussion, Chang Biao turned to the killer move.

Having not tested it, Ma Ying Jie spoke frankly: "I am an enslavement path master with no tie to strength path. Disappointed with the eighty-ninth round's reward, I plan to sell it, so I haven't tested it. What happened?"

"To speak truthfully, Brother Pan Ping and I have been testing this killer move—its might is overwhelming." Chang Biao paused, hesitating as he weighed his words.

Looking sincerely at Ma Ying Jie, he said: "I request Tribe Leader Ma to keep this killer move secret. Spreading it means others will claim the round's reward."

"So that's it! Chang Biao was once tribe leader, but is now merely a great elder; his adopted son Chang Ji You holds the title, while Wolf King Chang Shan Yin makes the true decisions. Chang Biao wants to keep this killer move secret, as any Gu Master would. But if Chang Shan Yin learns of it and demands it, Chang Biao must hand it over."

Ma Ying Jie's expression turned solemn: "Lord Chang Biao is too modest. Cooperating with experts for mutual benefit is my fortune. I agree to your proposal."

Near midnight, the three parted after finalizing Ma Hong Yun and Chang Li's engagement.

"An excellent plan, Brother Chang! This marriage ties Ma Ying Jie to you, forcing him to help when we deal with the Wolf King later." Closing the door, Pan Ping laughed heartily.

Chang Biao shook his head slightly: "Ma Ying Jie isn't easily fooled. He knows when to yield, and in dangerous times he will make swift decisions. It's not time to recruit him yet, but maintaining good relations publicly and investing resources to support Ma Hong Yun will increase our control over Ma tribe. When we declare war on Chang Shan Yin later, once he views Ma tribe as an enemy, Ma Ying Jie will have to join our boat to protect his tribe!"

Inside a carriage, Ma Ying Jie and Ma Hong Yun sat opposite each other.

"Hong Yun, you're truly lucky to catch Miss Chang Li's interest. Lord Chang Biao and I decided the first of next month will be your wedding day," Ma Ying Jie said smilingly.

"I have seen your loyalty; this is your reward." Ma Ying Jie patted his shoulder with emotion and retrieved three red steel relic Gu from his aperture.

"You are marrying Lady Chang Li. Without power and status, wouldn't that weaken Ma tribe's prestige? These three red steel relic Gu can advance you to rank two peak stage; with your aptitude, reaching rank three won't be a problem. I now appoint you deputy elder to oversee the tribe's miscellaneous affairs," Ma Ying Jie declared.

His mind a mess, Ma Hong Yun instinctively knelt: "Thank you for the promotion, Lord!"

"Yes, work well." Ma Ying Jie encouraged with a few sentences, his thoughts, however were on a different matter, "Six arm heavenly zombie king, this killer move seems to be really powerful. Since it is regarded with such importance by Pan and Chang, and also does not need too much attainment in strength path cultivation, how about I give it a try as well?"

Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, central control room.

"Ink transformation!" With sharp eyes, Fang Yuan shouted softly and pressed his hands down.

All kinds of Gu worms rained down from the air, mixing rapidly as they fell.

The inky liquid covered the sand table again, soon found a flaw, and swirled into a whirlpool.

In his mind, Mo Yao's will commented with satisfaction: "Good, you've mastered the shower refinement technique. It quickens Gu refinement by thirty percent and raises quality by twenty percent. Exceeding the limit causes dizziness and refinement failure in minor cases, and soul injury, memory loss, or dementia in severe cases."

Methodically, Fang Yuan threw the owner token into the ink whirlpool.

The ink liquid vanished instantly, and the owner token floated up into Fang Yuan's palm.

Fang Yuan examined the owner token, which now had five edges.

The reward for this eighty-ninth round was five immortal essence stones!

Controlling this floor via the owner token, Fang Yuan secretly claimed the five immortal essence stones when Chang Biao, Pan Ping, and Ma Ying Jie passed the round, substituting a downgraded six arm heavenly zombie king into their apertures instead.

The genuine killer move used borrow strength Gu as its core, six flying zombie Gu as backbone, and numerous supplementary Gu. Modified by Fang Yuan and Mo Yao's will, the downgraded move used overlord Gu as its core, greatly reducing its power.

While other flying zombie Gu remained unchanged, old earth chief zombie Gu was used instead of Mo Yao's modified Gu.

Crucially, the supporting Gu were modified and intention Gu added to secretly gather data on Chang Biao and Pan Ping's use of the killer move.

This prevented suspicion of tampering while making them test the killer move in Fang Yuan's place to reveal any flaws.

"Half a month has passed since distributing the killer move. It is time to haul in the net. What do you think?" Fang Yuan asked Mo Yao's will.

Mo Yao murmured: "The timing is appropriate. We can harvest two sets first to see the results."

Grasping the five-edge owner token, Fang Yuan's thoughts located two familiar figures in the seventh floor's ninetieth round.

They were none other than Chang Biao and Pan Ping.

Running with robes fluttering, Chang Biao nodded: "We can neither fly nor burrow here, only follow these walled passageways. The passages branch everywhere, yet we haven't met a single beast. Clearly, this round tests a Gu Master's scouting and movement—it must be an enormous maze."

But with Fang Yuan controlling the seventh floor and discovering them, everything was about to change.

# Chapter 580: Perfecting the Killer Move

Wolf howls echoed as a large pack of turtleback wolves appeared ahead.

Soon, more wolf species emerged—vermillion wolves, water wolves, wind wolves, and even mutated frenzy wolves and white-eyes wolves.

Numerous thousand wolf kings and myriad wolf kings joined the battle, making Pan Ping and Chang Biao's expressions turn unsightly.

Before long, the two could barely keep fighting.

"Eh?" Pan Ping's laughter abruptly stopped, replaced by shock and fear.

Attempting to exit the round with their guest tokens, they froze in horror. "What's happening? We can't leave?" Beside him, Chang Biao discovered this serious problem.

Having entered via guest tokens, they could normally leave with a thought and had done so many times.

But this floor was under Fang Yuan's control, and the five-edge owner token far surpassed guest tokens. They were trapped like caged birds.

"Damn it, what should we do? I only have thirty percent primeval essence remaining!" Pan Ping shouted in panic.

Chang Biao's expression was grim as he shouted: "Calm down!"

Chang Biao still had fifty percent primeval essence, but even full essence would eventually be exhausted against these endless wolf packs.

Pan and Chang forced themselves calm, trying to break through the wolf encirclement.

In control of this round, Fang Yuan knew every corner of the maze.

He directed the wolves seamlessly, constantly encircling and cutting off Pan and Chang's escape route.

"I cannot die here! Damned beasts, take my killer move!" Desperate, Pan Ping used almost all his primeval essence to activate six arm heavenly zombie king.

Turning into an eight-armed zombie, his strength soared explosively, crushing the wolves with irresistible force.

Chang Biao rushed to his aid: "In danger, we must work as one to survive. Rest and recover your primeval essence with primeval stones; I will protect you!"

Chang Biao also activated six arm heavenly zombie king, firmly shielding Pan Ping.

After seven or eight days, their primeval essence was completely exhausted and they could fight no longer.

In their despair, they suddenly spotted a large pile of primeval stones in a corner ahead.

"Primeval stones!"

Finding a lifeline, they fought forward in elation, stabilizing their situation as they recovered primeval essence with the stones.

Using six arm heavenly zombie king more frequently, permanent zombie speckles began growing on their bodies.

They never realized this pile of primeval stones was placed by Fang Yuan to make them use the killer move more and continue his experiment.

Gradually growing dependent on the killer move, they used it constantly and rarely relied on their own methods in subsequent battles.

When their zombie speckles became denser and seriously affected them, they came to their senses.

But it was already too late.

"I don't accept dying here! Wolf King, I won't let you go even as a ghost!"

Pan Ping was the first to die.

Days later, Chang Biao also died of exhaustion in battle.

Dying with grievance, he mumbled near death: "Exit... where the hell is the exit?"

"Activated two thousand three hundred and eleven times. Though he died exhausted, the fatal cause was accumulated zombie energy." Fang Yuan appeared beside Chang Biao's corpse.

Smiling slightly, his experiment had succeeded, but he discovered a problem—

Even if each activation stayed within the time limit, repeated use accumulated zombie energy until it led to the Gu Master's death.

Fang Yuan retrieved the Gu worms from their corpses and stowed them in his pouch.

Under his control, this round made it impossible for Pan and Chang to detonate their Gu worms.

Several days later.

In the study, Fang Yuan pondered with closed eyes while holding an east window Gu.

"Hostile intent Gu can condense hostile intent. The hostile intent is strong and fiercely encroaching as fire, but it somewhat lacks flexibility and does not have the power to persist for long."

"Sharp intent Gu can condense sharp intent. The sharp intent is very sharp like swords and spears, however it can be subdued through soft tactics and is very difficult to restore."

Purchased from treasure yellow heaven with all his modest immortal essence stone savings, this east window Gu recorded a fairly intact wisdom path inheritance.

"Then what is Mo Yao's will—hostile intent, sharp intent, or reckless intent?"

Fang Yuan researched these wills to guard against the enormous hidden danger in his mind.

"Hostile intent is fierce like fire, sharp intent is sharp like a spear, and reckless intent is wild and hard to control, but Mo Yao's will is sea-deep and elusive. Clashing with her feels like punching cotton."

Analyzing carefully, Fang Yuan perceived Mo Yao's will was none of these.

"As the proverb says, know yourself and your enemy and you will emerge unscathed from a hundred battles. I must endure for now, wearing her down through continuous thought while using her to explore True Yang Building."

Just as he thought this, Mo Yao's indistinct figure appeared in his mind.

"It is done. Six arm heavenly zombie king is truly perfected, with no unsuitable factors left," Mo Yao said weakly and exhaustedly.

"Looks like she had been worn down a lot from all the thinking over these days." Fang Yuan was inwardly happy, and as he looked at the modified killer move, this hidden happiness gradually turned into exultation!

# Chapter 581: Advance to six-edge, difficulty finding a Gu tester

Vigilant by nature, Fang Yuan felt everyone else was unreliable and only he was dependable. Thus, he had researched six arm heavenly zombie king immediately upon obtaining it.

Mo Yao had reduced many original supplementary Gu while keeping the core and six zombie Gu unchanged, adding only a few new supplementary Gu.

In his mind, Mo Yao's will explained: "Thanks to the intention Gu on Pan and Chang, their experience and insight let me refine this move to near perfection. As long as each activation stays under thirty minutes, repeated use will not accumulate zombie energy or sprout zombie speckles."

Backlash remained: exceeding thirty minutes caused severe damage from zombie energy, and prolonged use could turn the Gu Master into a zombie.

"With its power doubled and duration extended to thirty minutes, it is sufficient to handle anything in the mortal realm. What are you dissatisfied with? This strength path killer move ranks among the top five in my memory. Don't be too greedy," Mo Yao lectured.

He immediately said: "Preparedness ensures success, while unpreparedness spells failure. If some peculiar situation forces me to overuse the killer move and become a zombie, what happens? I know six arm heavenly zombie king cannot be improved further, but my goal now is to resolve this weakness."

Mo Yao finally understood Fang Yuan's intention and fell silent.

Mo Yao soon replied: "Resolving this backlash is troublesome. Six arm heavenly zombie king's zombie energy is so thick that transformed Gu Masters cannot even use Yin-Yang rotation Gu!"

Mo Yao calmly said: "I need a rank five Gu Master to fully transform into this form so I can experiment on them. I need this test subject to cooperate with me fully, and I need to have full control over their condition, in terms of body, mind, and personal experience... These are all important information that I need to consider."

Fang Yuan frowned: "Rank five Gu Master? And a fully cooperative one?"

"Yes, ideally a willing subject. Controlling them with slavery Gu affects emotions, distorting their feelings and experience during the zombie transformation."

Where was Fang Yuan going to find such a person?!

Three days later.

Central control room.

From the ink whirlpool, the owner token rose and flew into Fang Yuan's hands.

Activating the refinement path killer move ink transformation again, his five-edge owner token became six-edged.

Fang Yuan was both happy and worried.

With a six-edge token, once Hei Lou Lan's became four-edge, he could snatch it to form a ten-edge owner token.

With a ten-edge owner token, he could obtain one of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's true inheritances!

Depleted of resources by the six transformations, he had repeatedly sold Immortal Gu remnant recipes to raise funds.

He had also sold massive groups of rockmen, foxes, wolves, Gu worms, precious hairy men, and air bubble fish.

"Hu Immortal blessed land is nearly drained and needs recovery. But with the six-edge token, I can control six floors of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and claim all their rewards. These valuable rewards would grow my wealth by at least sixty times my current foundation!"

But currently, he could not touch these rewards.

Hei Lou Lan had gathered experts for the fifth floor's final round.

"I will take the rewards when Imperial Court blessed land closes and expels everyone. By then, nobody will know a thing."

The bear paw slammed down, quaking the earth and blasting rocks like shrapnel.

A desolate beast flying bear phantom guarded the fifth floor's hundredth round.

Mountainous in size with snowy white fur, it was equipped with a full set of elite Gu worms. It attacked fiercely and darted with lightning agility despite its massive bulk. After just thirty minutes of battle, the Gu Masters had already suffered heavy losses.

Sun Shi Han advised Hei Lou Lan: "Lord tribe leader, we should retreat. We came to probe it, and having identified most of the flying bear's Gu worms, our goal is achieved."

Hei Lou Lan assessed the situation before snorting: "Retreat."

# Chapter 582: Fighting flying bear, Wolf King gets fifty percent

Retreating from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, Hei Lou Lan gave orders to recruit experts that night.

Experts answered the call: Wolf King Chang Shan Yin, Water Demon Hao Ji Liu, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Ye Lui Sang, and many others.

Beside Hei Lou Lan sat Wolf King Chang Shan Yin rather than Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

After speaking with Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Hei Lou Lan turned to Fang Yuan: "Brother Shan Yin, we count on you for this battle! If we get through, you will earn half the rewards."

Rank five — wind tiger cloud dragon Gu!

Thousands of wind tigers and cloud dragons charged forward, facing the foxes and eagles head on.

While the foxes held on, Hei Qi Sheng's eagle group was decimated and thrown into disorder.

# Chapter 583: Killing flying bear, Accident at the final moment

Rank five — five element bear skin Gu.

In an instant, the flying bear and Hao Ji Liu both vanished!

# Chapter 584: Demise of Water Demon, Fang Yuan’s enlightening words

Looking grim and uncertain, Sun Shi Han hesitated before asking: "Is it the battle space Gu?"

Hei Lou Lan's eyes flashed: "This is indeed space path. If it is battle space Gu, Elder Hao Ji Liu is in trouble."

# Chapter 585: Finally getting through, Fang Yuan requests for an Immortal Gu

This time, the battle space lasted half a day before dispersing, revealing the hill-sized flying bear phantom once more.

Uninjured, with a dazzling halo flowing across its snow-white fur and bright eyes full of soaring battle intent, it had fully recovered.

"Hei Lou Lan thought: 'If it pulls me inside, my strength path killer move could kill it.' In the battle space, I can use my strength path killer move and kill the flying bear!"

# Chapter 586: Using flying bear, Mo Yao speaks of phantom path

# Chapter 587: The vast difference between immortal and mortal

"Tribe leader is wise," Hei Shu agreed. "Chang Ji You only leads Chang tribe because Wolf King arbitrarily appointed his son. He is too young and cannot appease the tribesmen. The whole of Chang tribe's affairs actually lie with Chang Ji You's godfather Chang Biao."

# Chapter 588: Each with their schemes

# Chapter 589: The bond between father and son, real and fake affection

Fang Yuan wiped Chang Ji You's tears, speaking gently like a spring breeze: "Why are you crying? I am Wolf King and you are my son—you must shed blood, not tears."

Hearing the word 'son', Chang Ji You felt as though struck by lightning.

Fang Yuan patted his shoulder and asked warmly: "Do you know what your greatest deficiency is?"

Fang Yuan continued decisively: "Your greatest deficiency is that you are not strong enough."

"This yellow gold relic Gu is enough for you to reach rank four peak stage, and this purple crystal relic Gu will advance you rapidly in rank five." Fang Yuan handed the two relic Gu to Chang Ji You.

"Hehe, Mo Yao, no need to worry; I understand human nature. "Hmph, humans are truly sinister and crafty. We inkmen would never refine an evil thing like blood skull Gu to harm our own kin," Mo Yao sneered.

Fang Yuan smiled unfazed: "Aren't you Spirit Affinity House's fairy, representing the righteous path? Why didn't you stop me?"

"Only if I had the power to. Besides, why should I stop humans fighting among themselves? I'd rather your entire race died off so we variant humans could have room to survive." Mo Yao rolled her eyes.

'Do you really lack the ability to stop me?...' Fang Yuan suppressed this doubt.

Three days later, Chang Ji You finished using all the relic Gu and advanced to rank five upper stage.

Immediately after, he began practicing the killer move six arm heavenly zombie king.

Just as Fang Yuan expected, he became addicted to the killer move's immense power and gradually overlooked its flaws.

Under Fang Yuan's intentional manipulation, he fought an intense, prolonged battle.

Only when the battle ended did he make the terrifying discovery: he had completely transformed into a heavenly zombie.

Two days later, Fang Yuan appeared before him again.

"Father, save me!" The monstrous Chang Ji You knelt, begging in terror.

"Son, how did you become like this?!" Fang Yuan asked in apparent fury. "I warned you never to exceed the time limit!"

"Father, I was muddled and lost track of time! By the time I realized, it was too late!" Kneeling in deep shame, Chang Ji You looked at Fang Yuan with tear-filled eyes.

"Even yin-yang rotation Gu cannot treat this. The killer move's after-effects are too severe—even father has no way." Fang Yuan sighed in feigned grief.

Fang Yuan lamented repeatedly: "This move's origin is extraordinary. Father braved fatal danger alone in a Gu Immortal's inheritance before finally obtaining this immortal killer move."

"No, it is this, I needed you to transform into this." Fang Yuan was laughing inwardly while on the surface, he supported Chang Ji You.

"My son, don't cry! You must not cry! Though you made a mistake, the fault also lies with me. I was absorbed in exploring this maze round and failed to watch over you. There is always a way out—we will research together and find a way to turn you back into a human! Believe in father and in yourself!" Fang Yuan said emotionally, tears welling in his eyes.

"Son, stay here and let father devise a way to restore you. I will personally manage Chang tribe, so worry not. With father and son working together, what is there to fear from a mere zombie transformation?"

"Yes, son will listen to father!"

# Chapter 590: Endurance, Shatter, Death

Agonizing pain racked Chang Ji You, his muscles bulging as the six arms on his back flailed wildly.

Yet Fang Yuan held him firmly aloft with just one hand.

Eyes flashing like lightning, Fang Yuan manipulated his Gu worms and shouted: "Endure it, son! Now is the time!"

Pushed to his limit, just as he was about to faint, the intense pain receded like an ebbing tide.

"Su... success?!" Panting heavily, Chang Ji You opened his eyes to see the skin on his arm restored to living flesh.

"Oh no!" Suddenly, Fang Yuan spoke, his tone extremely solemn.

Instantly, his arm reverted to the heavenly zombie state like rotting wood.

Seeing the intense fatigue Fang Yuan feigned on his face, Chang Ji You could not utter a word.

"Even this method failed!" Inwardly gritting his teeth, Fang Yuan demanded: "Mo Yao, what other ideas do you have?"

The current experimental method was all Mo Yao's idea.

He was experimenting on Chang Ji You to find a cure while forcing Mo Yao's will to deplete her limited energy through thought.

After a brief silence, Mo Yao said: "There is another way, but it is extremely dangerous. The Gu tester will endure triple the pain and likely die from agony alone!"

Mo Yao urged: "This killer move has unrivaled power, so its flaws are naturally hard to remove. Having experimented so often, you must understand the difficulty."

"This is my final method, and I cannot guarantee success. It is extremely dangerous, with barely a chance of working! Decide for yourself. Your 'son' has fully become a heavenly zombie and possesses good battle strength. He obeys you completely, so it is a waste to sacrifice him like this. I suggest keeping him by your side as a helper."

Fang Yuan smiled faintly: "Son, I have thought of a method. It is fraught with mortal danger, but has a very high success rate, so father cannot decide..."

Hearing this, Chang Ji You hesitated briefly before his eyes lit up: "Lord father, please use this method! Living in my current form is worse than death!"

Fang Yuan sighed deeply: "Alright. I cannot bear to see you in agony. Rest while I prepare, and we will make the final attempt!"

A few days later.

This was the three hundred and seventh time he had fainted from pain.

"Completely useless!" His face dark as water, Fang Yuan snorted and stopped the Gu worms.

Fang Yuan had to stop and use soul path Gu worms to nourish and heal his soul.

"As I said before, this method has little hope; it is better to preserve his life," Mo Yao said sadly in his mind.

Fang Yuan snorted coldly, light flashing in his narrowed eyes: "One more try—we will test it one last time!"

He drove more Gu worms into Chang Ji You's face, skin, and bloodstream toward his heart.

"Stop, his soul cannot take this." In his mind, Mo Yao urged.

"What can we achieve without taking risks?" Fang Yuan sneered, adding more Gu worms to the limit.

His eyes gleamed: "Three more Gu worms to test the effect."

"Now the final one—success or failure hinges on this... eh!"

Fang Yuan froze as the surrounding Gu worms disintegrated like scattering fireworks.

Chang Ji You no longer struggled, hovering motionlessly in the air.

He was dead.

His soul had shattered and dissipated from the pain.

"You've killed him." In Fang Yuan's mind, Mo Yao's will spoke coldly.

"Yes, I killed him." Fang Yuan raised his brows, chuckling lightly: "He did not die in vain—at least I learned how stubborn this flaw truly is."

Mo Yao fell silent, unwilling to respond to his ruthless nature, and vanished from his mind.

He was progressively realizing what a grave threat Mo Yao's will posed in his mind.

If Mo Yao's will disrupted his thoughts during battle, he would be unable to stop the killer move.

"What Gu created Mo Yao's will? None of the wisdom path Gu I purchased can conceal a will so thoroughly."

"True Yang Building already has sixty floors, and Hei Lou Lan is attacking the thirty-ninth floor for wooden chicken Gu."

"I have to work faster, I cannot wait anymore!"

# Chapter 591: Sacrifice (Double Chapter)

Though Fang Yuan had entered Eighty-Eight True Yang Building numerous times, he never forgot his primary purpose in northern plains.

That was to save Dang Hun mountain.

He needed landscape as before Gu to save Dang Hun mountain.

Obtaining this Gu posed many difficulties, chiefly because it belonged to Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Even when killed, the blood beasts absorbed blood and resurrected moments later, endlessly replenishing.

With his six-edge owner token, Fang Yuan instantly assumed complete control over the floor.

With a shift of thought, Fang Yuan vanished and reappeared on the great hall's main beam.

Focusing slightly, the battle scene of Tai Bai Yun Sheng and his group appeared in Fang Yuan's mind.

Blood beasts multiplied closer to the hall; Tai Bai Yun Sheng's group was whittled below fifty.

Rank five Gu Master experts Zhu Zai and Gao Yang took turns as the group's vanguard.

Meanwhile, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Northern Plains' number one healing Gu Master of this generation, was shielded at the center. He continually activated Man As Before Gu, beaming light to resurrect fallen Gu Masters or restore the living's primeval essence.

"This round's difficulty is extreme without blood path Gu Masters," Fang Yuan observed, watching Tai Bai Yun Sheng's desperate struggle with ease.

Assessing the situation, Fang Yuan knew Tai Bai Yun Sheng's chances of success were miniscule.

Leaning back, Fang Yuan opened The Legends of Ren Zu, passing time while monitoring the battle.

Scheming for Landscape As Before Gu, Fang Yuan could not let Tai Bai Yun Sheng die yet.

"Man As Before!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng shouted, raising his palm as white light enveloped the injured Gu Master.

Fang Yuan opened The Legends of Ren Zu to chapter three, section fourteen.

Northern Dark Ice Soul awakened his elder sister Desolate Ancient Moon, and both sought Cognition Gu's advice on saving their father.

Cognition Gu said: "Cheng Bai Mountain has vanished. I know no way to revive your father, but ask Wisdom Gu. Wisdom is the crystallization of cognition."

Under cognition Gu's directions, Northern Dark Ice Soul and Desolate Ancient Moon found wisdom Gu.

Wisdom Gu reluctantly said: "I can guide you, but one of you must surrender your middle age as payment."

"I will give you my middle age," Desolate Ancient Moon replied without hesitation.

Wisdom Gu directed her: "In the western golden desert lies a motionless blue sea. That is the source of all living beings. Infiltrate its depths, capture a human-shaped life Gu, and bring it ashore. It can bestow your father new life. But spend no more than fifteen minutes, or the sea will assimilate you."

Wisdom Gu added: "Only one who comprehends the truth of life can find it. Do not blame my method if you fail."

Demonic expert Zhu Zai sustained three deep wounds, bones exposed.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng quickly activated Man As Before to heal him.

Zhu Zai's injuries vanished and his depleted primeval essence fully restored.

"Man As Before is marvelous, but unfortunately cannot be used on oneself," Fang Yuan sighed, returning his gaze to the book.

After an arduous journey through the golden desert, Desolate Ancient Moon and Northern Dark Ice Soul reached the blue sea at its center.

Diving into the sea depths, the siblings indeed found large numbers of life Gu packed together.

They saw life Gu resembling flowers, beasts, and variant humans—everything except a human form.

Helpless, the siblings could only return to the shore.

Upon leaving the blue sea, the deer-shaped life Gu Northern Dark Ice Soul held glowed softly, leapt onto the sand, and transformed into a fawn.

As the fawn hopped away, Desolate Ancient Moon realized: "I understand the truth of life."

Northern Dark Ice Soul thought for a moment and replied: "Like that fawn, it would become a living being, right?"

Desolate Ancient Moon smiled: "We are life forms formed from life Gu—we ourselves are human-shaped blue gems!"

"I know a method to obtain a human-shaped life Gu quickly," Desolate Ancient Moon said suddenly.

"What method?" Northern Dark Ice Soul had a bad feeling.

Desolate Ancient Moon smiled: "I will sink to the seabed, reverting into a life Gu."

"No, you can't sacrifice yourself like this, elder sister." Northern Dark Ice Soul immediately dissuaded.

"I must do it; my life's purpose is to revive father," Desolate Ancient Moon replied calmly.

"Humans are gems of the world. Every effort and choice we make polishes our respective gems."

"And humans can only obtain life by sacrificing life."

Desolate Ancient Moon leisurely spoke before sinking into the blue sea.

After fifteen minutes, Desolate Ancient Moon was assimilated, turning into a human-shaped blue gem.

Yet this blue gem was incomplete, damaged to less than half a proper form.

In the process of understanding life, humans often used up half their lives.

Northern Dark Ice Soul tearfully held the blue gem and left the golden desert.

"Fifty steps left!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng shouted with all his strength.

Companions fell one by one, leaving only five survivors in the bitter battle.

Thirty steps!

Two more fell, leaving only Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Zhu, and Gao.

Ten steps!

Zhu Zai and Gao Yang lost numerous Gu worms, their primeval essence virtually exhausted.

"I owe you both and will reward you heavily!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng swore with earnest sincerity.

"Old sir, you saved us back then—without you, we wouldn't be alive today!"

Five steps!

"Save me!" Zhu Zai yelled, throwing himself at the blocking blood beasts to perish together.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng extended his palm, but no white light emerged.

He shouted involuntarily: "Not good, my primeval essence is spent!"

"Once inside the hall, I can recover primeval essence and save Zhu Zai!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng shouted.

The next moment, a giant python-like blood beast struck from behind and swallowed Gao Yang whole!

Two steps!

Battered with injuries, Tai Bai Yun Sheng staggered through a narrow gap toward the great hall's door.

"Humans obtain life only by sacrificing life. I will remember your sacrifices!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng pushed open the door.

He fell inside the great hall as the blood beasts roared and clawed behind him, not daring to enter.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng lay powerless on the floor, pain throbbing across his body.

"This round has three great halls and sixty-nine side halls! Clearing it within the time limit yields a high-grade evaluation, while passing two great halls and forty-six side halls earns a middle-grade evaluation. I passed only one great hall with a low evaluation, yet I obtained the lifespan Gu!"

"A fifteen-year lifespan Gu increases my lifespan by fifteen years. A whole fifteen years..."

Overwhelmed with deep emotion, Tai Bai Yun Sheng's vision blacked out, and he fainted.

# Chapter 592: Deep Dark Shadow

Fang Yuan lowered his head, observing the unconscious Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Bathed in blood, Tai Bai Yun Sheng lay with eyes shut tightly in sunken sockets.

Just steps away outside the hall doors, a sea of blood beasts growled in a clamorous roar.

Fang Yuan looked up at them and said coolly: "Shut up."

Aside from rotting corpses, only Fang Yuan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng remained in the hall.

Closing the hall door, Fang Yuan half-squatted and gripped Tai Bai Yun Sheng's skull with his right palm.

The whites of his eyes glowed faintly as countless images flashed through Fang Yuan's mind.

Fang Yuan extracted Tai Bai Yun Sheng's memories, tracing backward from old age.

A massive torrent of Tai Bai Yun Sheng's memories battered Fang Yuan's mind with intense pain.

After reviewing the old man's life, Fang Yuan halted his Gu worms to rest.

"I didn't find it!" he sighed with regret.

"What couldn't you find?" Mo Yao's will asked inquisitively in his mind.

Fang Yuan did not answer. Tied to his grand schemes, Landscape As Before could never be revealed to Mo Yao.

Landscape As Before was an Immortal Gu Tai Bai Yun Sheng obtained only after ascending to immortality.

Rumors claimed the Gu condensed spontaneously through the resonance of heaven and earth when Tai Bai Yun Sheng became an immortal.

Yet another possibility existed: Tai Bai Yun Sheng had possessed the Immortal Gu recipe for Landscape As Before all along.

With the recipe, Fang Yuan could have Lang Ya land spirit refine the Immortal Gu directly, avoiding immense risk.

Yet this soul search yielded a disappointing result.

Failing to find a recipe confirmed that Landscape As Before condensed purely from heaven and earth's resonance during ascension.

To obtain it, Fang Yuan would have to forcibly snatch it from an already-ascended Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Having invested so much effort, Fang Yuan had no choice but to prepare for the dangerous gamble.

When Tai Bai Yun Sheng opened his eyes, he found himself bedridden and weak.

"Lord elder, your injuries are treated, though your advanced age has taken a toll. You must recuperate carefully over the next few months; your body is weak and needs slow recovery," the head healing Gu Master gently urged.

To assemble a raid team, Tai Bai Yun Sheng had agreed to become a Hei tribe external elder.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's gaze was unfocused, but hearing this brought him back to his senses. "Where is this place?" he asked.

"This is Lord Hei Lou Lan's residence. When you returned half-dead, the tribe leader personally brought you here for treatment. The servants have reported your awakening, and the tribe leader will be here shortly," the Gu Master leader replied.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng threw his head back in bitter laughter: "Haha, I failed after all! All that sacrifice for nothing!"

"Gao Yang, Zhu Zai, they gave their lives for me!" Tears streamed from his eyes in agony.

At the critical juncture, Tai Bai Yun Sheng withheld his primeval essence to activate defensive Gu instead of saving his comrades.

For his own selfish desires, he had ignored his comrades' sacrifices.

He had deliberately sacrificed his comrades solely to claim the lifespan Gu and extend his life.

The decision alienated him from himself, filling him with profound shame and self-loathing.

The room knelt as a smiling Hei Lou Lan approached Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Noticing his pained look, Hei Lou Lan smoothed his expression: "Elder Tai Bai, I am glad you awoke. I have heard what happened. You, Gao Yang, and Zhu Zai displayed true Northern Plains bravery; though you failed, it was an admirable attempt! Learn from this, and I am certain you will conquer this round in the future."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng kept his eyes closed, remaining silent with a pained expression.

His memories flashed in his mind one by one once more.

From youth, he had always believed in the power of love.

When Tai Bai tribe annexed other tribes, he married a captive childhood friend to spare her and her people from slavery.

On their wedding night, she betrayed him; the captives colluded with enemies, slaughtering his parents.

His ensuing life as a slave was wretched, plagued by intense guilt and regret.

Years later, he gave an old beggar water; in return, the beggar offered three immortal inheritances.

The first allowed him to tread fire and bathe in flames, transcending mortality.

The second allowed him to control wind and fly, roaming the world freely.

The third allowed him to surpass life and death, gaining the ability to help the world's people.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng chose the third inheritance.

From then on, his heart found light in the darkness, and he was completely reborn without regret.

Surpassing life and death to help people had become his life's goal.

And indeed, he truly achieved this in his later life.

He failed not from losing the lifespan Gu, but because he betrayed his lifelong principles.

Most ironically, all this had been done by his own subconscious.

He spent a lifetime building his ideals, only to destroy them in a single selfish moment.

He had seen the other side of himself, his own selfish nature.

The shadow was extremely dark...

# Chapter 593: Appearance of the strength path Immortal Gu

Hei Lou Lan's brows furrowed as he walked out of Tai Bai Yun Sheng's room.

"Without Tai Bai Yun Sheng healthy, clearing rounds will be vastly harder." Hei Lou Lan looked upward.

Eighty-Eight True Yang Building was currently condensing its sixty-eighth floor.

Within the sixty-eighth floor lay a strength path Immortal Gu!

With his owner token, Hei Lou Lan perceived the strength path Immortal Gu inside immediately.

This was a rank six strength path Immortal Gu called flying bear strength Gu.

"I must obtain this Immortal Gu—only with it does my revenge have hope!" Hei Lou Lan muttered.

His trusted aide Hei Shu hurried forward and knelt before him.

Hei Shu reported: "Lord Chang Shan Yin is still stuck at the ninetieth round of the seventh floor. Lord Ye Lui Sang passed round eighty-one of the forty-ninth floor, but lost thirty percent of his forces...."

"The sixty-eighth floor is our main focus, specially assigned by supreme elders. Every bit of strength in the palace must be preserved. Announce Eighty-Eight True Yang Building closed until we breach the sixty-eighth floor," Hei Lou Lan instructed with authority.

"Tai Bai Yun Sheng can be mobilized after half a month's rest by using his desperate need for lifespan Gu."

"Chang Shan Yin owes me heavily for the flying bear phantom Immortal Gu, so I can mobilize him easily as well."

"Ye Lui Sang can be enticed with heavy bait. But the true key is utilizing the three Gu Immortals—Xue Song Zi, Hei Cheng, and Hei Bai."

Hei Bai was thrilled by the letter: "Wooden chicken Gu has finally appeared on the sixty-eighth floor!"

Hei Cheng smiled: "Virtuous brother, hard work pays off. Did the letter mention a strength path Immortal Gu?"

Hei Bai flushed: "I forgot my nephew's Great Strength True Martial Physique requires a strength path Immortal Gu to advance. He mentioned it, but unfortunately no strength path Immortal Gu has appeared yet."

"Still no strength path Immortal Gu?" Hei Cheng frowned.

Hei Cheng sighed: "Immortal Gu Dark Limit cannot conceal his physique much longer; this is almost his final chance at life."

Hei Bai urged: "Brother, time waits for no man. Let us quickly assist Hei Lou Lan!"

"Indeed. Where did the letter specify?" Hei Cheng stood up slowly.

Hei Bai stood up as well: "Near Demon Blood Hill."

Soon, they arrived in the sky above Demon Blood Hill.

# Chapter 594: Plan activated!

Strong winds blew and snow wreaked havoc.

Hei Bai and Hei Cheng stood atop Demon Blood Hill.

In the blizzard, flying snow hands condensed into giant icy paws.

Fully condensed, the massive flying snow hands grabbed at Hei Bai and Hei Cheng.

"Haha, we've been waiting!" Hei Bai laughed, flicking out numerous rank five Gu worms.

The flying snow hands seized the Gu worms, crumbling and sweeping them into the blessed land.

Once all the rank five Gu worms were taken, Hei Bai and Hei Cheng flew away satisfied.

"Support has arrived!" Receiving the response, Hei Lou Lan gazed fervently up at Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

The sixty-eighth floor was still condensing, its embryonic aurora holding the numerous Gu worms captured from outside the blessed land.

Hei Lou Lan sensed it carefully and frowned: "Hei tribe's duo made their move, but Xue Song Zi is still biding his time, hmph!"

Displeased, Hei Lou Lan immediately sent a letter via Gu worm.

Xue Song Zi complained of pressure from Hei tribe's Gu Immortals and business losses. Having already provided rank five Gu for wooden chicken Gu, further aid was beyond his power.

"I must obtain wooden chicken Gu first to secure his help!" Hei Lou Lan ordered everyone to convene.

Wooden chicken Gu was on Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's thirty-ninth floor.

Aided by Xue Song Zi, Hei Lou Lan had already reached the thirty-ninth floor's final round.

That evening, he breached the hundredth round, claiming rank six Immortal Gu Wooden Chicken.

With Immortal Gu Wooden Chicken in hand, Hei Lou Lan enticed Xue Song Zi into assisting.

Seven days later, the sixty-eighth floor had completely taken form.

Hei Lou Lan impatiently led everyone into the floor.

The refinement Gu Masters formed a circle around Hei Lou Lan.

Sitting cross-legged, he took out the two-edge owner token.

As the two-edge owner token floated into the air, Hei Lou Lan's body emitted a grey light.

Needle-sharp rays formed a grey radiance that pierced directly into the floating two-edge owner token.

Like melting snow, the surrounding world turned transparent and dissipated completely.

As if a veil lifted, the entire group instantly arrived at the second round.

"This is?!"

"We actually passed the round without even making a move?"

An elder replied proudly: "This is the super tribes' refinement path killer move—Grey Meltdown, allowing rapid round passage."

"Tsk tsk, this trick is quite interesting..." Inside Fang Yuan's mind, Mo Yao manifested.

Mo Yao analyzed: "This exploits Giant Sun's hibernating will through coordinated efforts inside and outside. Gu outside are absorbed into the building, but with Giant Sun's will hibernating, refinement slows. At best, they could only be considered half-refined."

"Grey Meltdown connects with these half-refined Gu, directly refining the core so the round collapses."

"Timing is crucial. The half-refined state does not last long; given enough time, even a hibernating Giant Sun's will will completely refine these Gu worms. Once they are fully refined, challengers cannot induce any reaction, completely losing the chance to forcibly refine them."

"You truly are a refinement grandmaster, analyzing it at a glance," Fang Yuan chuckled inwardly.

In his previous life, Central Continent's Gu Immortals had displayed this method in widely disseminated images after breaching Imperial Court blessed land.

What Central Continent's Gu Immortals truly relied upon was the glass owner token.

This secondary owner token, created through immense Central Continent resources, was now in Fang Yuan's hands at six edges.

While everyone focused on the second round, Fang Yuan secretly took out the six-edge owner token.

Stroking the six edges, he muttered inwardly: "Pairing flying bear strength Gu with my flying bear phantom Gu—perfect."

With a single thought, he instantly took control of the floor!

# Chapter 595: Green vines blocking the round, Fang Yuan’s backstab

Hei Lou Lan watched the troops making slow progress through the dense jungle.

This second round was a vast, ancient rainforest with hot, damp weather.

To pass this round, Gu Masters had to cross the jungle to reach a stone palace on the opposite side.

Though devoid of beasts, the jungle was filled with green vines.

The most common were green snake vines, covered in snake scales. Whenever Gu Masters drew close, they would lash out and constrict them to death.

Fast and powerful, the vines were made even deadlier by the wood path Gu worms inhabiting them, which had already inflicted heavy casualties on the group.

After advancing for a time, a scout returned to report to Hei Lou Lan: "Reporting, a green snake vine king was discovered ahead. Lord Ye Lui Sang is currently battling it."

However, as a rank five peak stage fire path expert aided by his support Immortal Gu, Ye Lui Sang easily subdued the wood path vine king.

Soon, news of victory arrived from the vanguard: "Lord Ye Lui Sang has slain the green snake vine king and rotated back. Lord Chang Shan Yin has taken over, leading the wolf pack to clear the path."

Chang Shan Yin deployed defensive turtleback wolves alongside vermillion fire wolves, using their fire path Gu worms to efficiently incinerate the vines and blaze a trail.

'Wolf King possesses unmatched battle strength. With the flying bear phantom Immortal Gu, a mere minor round cannot stop him,' Hei Lou Lan mused as he walked.

"'Flying bear phantom Gu paired with flying bear strength Gu would be perfect. Hmph, I will first make Chang Shan Yin pour in his utmost effort for me and when the time is ripe, I must make him hand over that flying bear phantom Gu! As long as I become a Gu Immortal, wouldn't a mere Wolf King be mine to toy with?"

"This second round seemingly tests stamina in prolonged battle, but it truly tests scouting ability. This jungle contains not only green snake vines, but also green dragon vines. There are only one or two territories of green dragon vines in this path, and presumably there will be one or two tough battles, and that will be the greatest difficulty of this round."

Hei Lou Lan felt proud: "We are getting closer to the finish line, at this speed, we will cross this round in an hour!"

Just as he thought this, a sudden change occurred.

The surrounding green snake vines whipped through the air at terrifying speeds, creating sonic booms!

But now, the green vines within a hundred li, no, a thousand li, were engaging in the battle, surging out crazily like a tsunami as they pounced towards the Gu Masters.

Caught unprepared, the Gu Masters suffered disastrous losses, with countless killed in moments.

"All troops attack! Hold them off at any cost, or we die!" Hei Lou Lan shouted, rising into the air to stabilize the situation.

Over a hundred green dragon vines quickly shot into the air, lunging toward him.

With a furious roar, Hei Lou Lan unleashed dark path methods, instantly destroying dozens of green dragon vines before descending to the ground.

Yet the ground was no safer, as countless snake and dragon vines erupted from the soil, trapping the entire army.

"How can this be? Our scouting was thorough—how could there be a green dragon vine group here?" Hei Lou Lan's eyes nearly tore in disbelief.

Even severed segments continued attacking, while green dragon vines tore free from their roots to lash out suicidally.

'How is this possible? What is happening?!' Hei Lou Lan was bewildered. By severing their own roots, these green dragon vines were committing suicide!

The army shattered into isolated pockets, retreating step by step as numerous Gu Masters lost their lives.

"Could this second round be a massive trap? How can the difficulty be this high so early?!" Hei Lou Lan was dumbfounded as doubts surged within him.

This was indeed a huge trap.

Yet the one who laid it was not Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, but the floor's secret controller—Fang Yuan.

He had ordered the vines to converge here, using his vanguard shift to deliberately stall for time.

Once the green vines had massed, Fang Yuan launched the ambush without hesitation.

Commanding the mindless vines as an enslavement master, Fang Yuan coordinated their suicidal assaults to unleash tenfold power.

He paid special attention to experts like Hei Lou Lan, Ye Lui Sang, and Tai Bai Yun Sheng, mobilizing mutated beast-level green dragon vines to obstruct them.

Hei Lou Lan gnashed his teeth, his expression warring fiercely before he forced out: "Retreat!"

The suicidal onslaught threw the formation into chaos, preventing the experts from fighting freely amid their own men.

With such heavy casualties in the second round, how could Hei Lou Lan seize the Immortal Gu in the final round?

Retreat was wise, but depended on whether Fang Yuan allowed it.

Controlling this floor, sealing the entrance and exit was trivial for him.

Soon, everyone made a terrifying discovery - they could not leave!

Sensing disaster, Hei Lou Lan stood up and roared: "Persevere, all of you! I will use the killer move grey meltdown to forcibly clear this round. If we hold on, we will win and survive!"

Everyone rallied, fighting to clear a path and form a tight formation.

Heavily protected by the troops, Hei Lou Lan led refinement path Gu Masters in a circular formation, activating the killer move grey meltdown.

"Lord, forcibly activating it will likely cost thirty percent of our men," an old refinement path Gu Master in the know warned palely.

Hei Lou Lan was forced to skip the second round, connecting grey meltdown directly to the third round's reward.

Passing the third round would collapse the foundationless second round, as Eighty-Eight True Yang Building condensed each floor in reverse order—from the hundredth round down to the first.

"Tens of refinement path Gu Masters dying is better than the whole army dying!" Hei Lou Lan gritted his teeth with cold cruelty, forced to choose the lesser evil.

The old Gu Master said no more, retreating into the formation.

# Chapter 596: Preparations from long ago, Mo Yao’s shock and suspicion

With solemn expressions, the refinement path Gu Masters moved into formation as blossoming grey rays merged into one.

Under everyone's expectant gaze, Hei Lou Lan tossed the two-edge owner token into the air.

As the owner token hovered in midair, the circular formation's condensed grey radiance surged toward it.

"Haha, now is the time." Watching from outside, Fang Yuan sent out a thought.

The two-edge owner token vanished instantly, appearing in his hand.

Controlling this floor, teleporting a small owner token was effortless for him.

Without the owner token, grey meltdown collapsed; the refinement path Gu Masters shrieked and spat blood, nearly all dying instantly from the backlash.

At the center, Hei Lou Lan likewise spat a mouthful of blood, staggering back several large steps from the heavy impact.

"My owner token!" he roared in shock, fury, and disbelief, losing all composure.
