Mo Yao's will raged in his mind: "Brat, what did you do? His owner token only has two edges! Why not wait until it reached four?!"

"You know nothing." Fang Yuan sneered, calmly stowing the two-edge owner token under his large sleeve.

"What happened?!" Ye Lui Sang rushed anxiously to Hei Lou Lan. "Where is the owner token?"

"How would I know?!" Hei Lou Lan's eyes blazed with fury, his voice pitching high in rage: "What the fuck happened?!"

"Damn it, how do we proceed without the owner token?" Fang Yuan hurried over, his brow furrowed in seemingly genuine anxiety that drew everyone's sympathy.

The green vines' ferocious offensive surged like a flash flood, leaving no time for respite.

Morale plunged into the abyss as people fled in disorder.

"Will I die here? Is this the end?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng laughed bitterly, emaciated and frail from recent pangs of conscience.

Suddenly, someone cried in joy: "We can leave! Someone left! We can leave!"

Unwilling to wipe everyone out at once, Fang Yuan left a lifeline, allowing the Gu Masters to freely exit.

Annihilating Hei tribe would incur the full vengeance of their Gu Immortals.

Therefore the collapsed and despairing army started retreating.

Hei Lou Lan glanced ashen-faced at the plaza and left without a word.

Yet that very night, Fang Yuan quietly entered Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

"You were too impatient—you only have eight edges now. What can you do?" Mo Yao sneered.

Fang Yuan walked slowly along the secret treasury corridor, lightly brushing the crystal wall as countless treasures swept past.

With a faint smile, he replied calmly: "As a refinement path grandmaster and fairy of Spirit Affinity House, speak plainly if you have questions—why probe so superficially?"

Mo Yao chuckled coquettishly: "Young man, it seems you already have a plan..."

"Naturally." Pausing, Fang Yuan lightly stroked the right crystal wall and withdrew a stored treasure.

Having refined the guest halt stele, he could retrieve any treasures within this range.

Continuing on, he extracted dozens of Gu recipes, inheritance records, and over a hundred Gu worms.

Mo Yao watched quietly, growing increasingly curious. The Gu worms Fang Yuan left out did not coordinate, leaving her unable to discern his intentions.

Fang Yuan recalled the previous life footage of Central Continent's immortals invading the blessed land.

Centuries ago, Central Continent's Gu Immortals had sent elite disciples to clear rounds and stash these items inside the treasure room.

Passing the guest halt stele, Fang Yuan walked over three hundred paces into the crystal corridor and stopped.

"It is here." After checking around, he began embedding the retrieved Gu worms into the surrounding crystal walls in a precise pattern.

"Could this be..." Mo Yao was bewildered, having gradually pieced together clues using her refinement path grandmaster attainment.

Across tens of steps, Fang Yuan's adjustments had ingeniously linked the embedded Gu worms into a formation.

"Indeed, this is the refinement path killer move grey meltdown—or rather, a far more powerful derivative of it," Fang Yuan chuckled.

"What are you trying to do?" Mo Yao asked.

Fang Yuan smiled with eerie confidence: "Just watch."

He released several Gu worms into the air.

The swelling grey fog soon engulfed Fang Yuan completely.

Standing in the fog with eyes closed and his right hand gripping the six-edge owner token, Fang Yuan concentrated on sensing.

Snapping his eyes open, he shouted: "Come back, Fixed Immortal Travel!"

Rumble!

The crystal corridor shook violently as Eighty-Eight True Yang Building shuddered.

The twenty-first floor, with seventeen rounds remaining, disintegrated into nothingness.

The seventeen rounds' rewards pierced through space and appeared before Fang Yuan.

Among them, a Gu radiated a rank six aura, gleaming like a green gem and fluttering like a jade butterfly.

Its imposing aura shoved the other Gu worms aside.

What else could it be but Fixed Immortal Travel?

"Immortal Gu! Fixed Immortal Travel?!" Mo Yao blurted out.

Fang Yuan stored the other rewards, leaving the Immortal Gu Fixed Immortal Travel perched on his shoulder.

As an Immortal Gu, it could not enter his mortal aperture.

"There is one more." Fang Yuan licked his lips in excitement.

Another explosive sound rang out.

Eighty-Eight True Yang Building shook violently as the thirty-fourth floor's twelve remaining rounds were instantly cleared!

The rewards appeared out of thin air, among them an unassuming Immortal Gu resembling a lump of earth—

"Immortal Gu Gruel Mud!" Mo Yao's will blurted.

Fang Yuan laughed, stowing the other rewards and placing Gruel Mud into his pouch.

He had buried Fixed Immortal Travel and Gruel Mud deep underground precisely for this moment.

When Eighty-Eight True Yang Building condensed, its venerated power swept across Northern Plains, plundering all unresisting Gu.

Placed as the final rewards for the twenty-first and thirty-fourth floors, both Immortal Gu remained half-refined due to Giant Sun's slumbering will, exactly as Fang Yuan anticipated.

"Brat, who are you? To mobilize two Immortal Gu is no small feat. Which region and force do you belong to?" Overwhelmed by shock, Mo Yao fired off question after question.

# Chapter 597: True Inheritance Secluded Domain, Unexpected Event

The emergence of two Immortal Gu left Mo Yao deeply shaken.

Fang Yuan merely smiled at Mo Yao's suspicions without answering.

Once Fang Yuan claimed the two Immortal Gu, both floors cleared automatically.

He retrieved the two owner tokens; as an imitation, the glass owner token remained at six edges.

Meanwhile, the owner token seized from Hei Lou Lan had advanced to four edges.

Combining the two, they were — ten-edges!

Ten edges met the minimum requirement to claim an Immortal Venerable inheritance.

"Immortal Venerable inheritance..." Fang Yuan chuckled, fusing the two owner tokens into a ten-edge owner token as demonstrated in the footage.

The next moment, he vanished on the spot.

The scenery shifted drastically, leaving Fang Yuan floating in an endless void.

Surrounded by pitch darkness with neither heaven nor earth, he drifted silently in the void.

Traces of green and red starlight glimmered in the distance.

"This is Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's True Inheritance Secluded Domain. To think I would return here after so many years!" Mo Yao's will murmured dejectedly.

"Eh? You've been here before?" Fang Yuan's heart jumped.

"Back then... hmph, no matter. Entering here is your greatest fortune! Though ten edges only grants the lowest ordinary true inheritance, you will still broaden your horizons. What you behold today will be unforgettable!" Mo Yao's will quickly regained her composure.

Fang Yuan chuckled, unbothered by her arrogance as he nodded: "I cannot yet compare to Giant Sun Immortal Venerable! Today will indeed broaden my horizons."

With that, he paddled his arms as if swimming, drifting slowly forward.

He drew closer, following a blood-red starlight.

The starlight brightened until Fang Yuan stopped before an orb of light.

The bowl-sized lump of red starlight floated silently.

"This is an ordinary true inheritance; send your consciousness inside to inspect its contents," Mo Yao advised.

Probing carefully with his consciousness, images flashed before Fang Yuan.

Ancient and tall trees, beasts at the size of mountains!

"Hahaha!" A broad-shouldered, narrow-waisted figure threw his head back, laughing uproariously.

Though his visage was blurred, rainbow skin carved with ancient totems radiated dominating majesty.

Treading on grey clouds and gale winds, purple hair billowing, flames burned within his double-pupiled eyes.

Heart pounding and breath catching, Fang Yuan recognized him instantly: "This is Reckless Savage Demon Venerable from the Olden Antiquity Era, confronting the immemorial desolate beast Primordial Ash Owl! Why is a Demon Venerable's legacy inside Giant Sun's inheritance?"

"What is strange about that? As the supreme, invincible ruler of his era, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable scoured the world, collected an item from Reckless Savage Demon Venerable, and left it here for his descendants. It is only natural," Mo Yao remarked.

Immemorial desolate beasts were primordial overlords possessing rank eight Gu Immortal battle strength.

The primordial ash owl possessed a dragon horn, four golden pupils, and thick rainbow plumage radiating overwhelming ferocity.

Reckless Savage Demon Venerable praised: "Good beast!"

Possessing human-like intelligence, the enraged primordial ash owl unleashed heavenly lightning from its beak; a blue thunderbolt pierced ten thousand li, instantly reaching Reckless Savage Demon Venerable.

Reckless Savage Demon Venerable stood completely still, letting the frenzied lightning strike him directly.

Amid the electricity, his bronze, muscular body remained unscathed, glowing brightly as beast totems prowled across his skin like living creatures.

Basking in the exploding plasma with relish, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable laughed heartily and thrust his right fist forward.

With a single punch, apocalyptic gales scattered the clouds, stripping the heavens bare as radiant sunlight banished all darkness!

The immemorial beast's bones shattered instantly; rainbow feathers drifted as it collapsed, golden pupils filled with terror.

Fang Yuan was deeply shaken; this was his first time witnessing a venerable's strike.

At rank nine, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable was truly invincible throughout heaven and earth!

"Nine thousand nine hundred ninety-ninth ash owl," Reckless Savage Demon Venerable said plainly, clutching the air.

"Transform." Shuddering, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable expanded with the wind, instantly ballooning into a giant!

Tall as heaven and earth, he seemed capable of grasping the sun, uncontained by the universe.

The giant slowly opened his mouth; despite its frantic struggles, the primordial ash owl was drawn helplessly inside.

He chewed several times, producing sounds like collapsing mountains and striking thunderbolts before swallowing it whole.

After consuming the rank eight beast, the giant patted his stomach with a thunderous thud, looking unsatisfied.

A new totem of the primordial ash owl appeared on his belly, inconspicuous among the innumerable totems covering his body.

Sensing something, the giant suddenly turned around and stared straight at Fang Yuan!

Urgh!

Fang Yuan collapsed as if struck by a massive blow, vomiting a mouthful of blood.

His soul trembled violently amid severe dizziness.

Thankfully, Gu worms were not restricted here, allowing him to easily heal his injuries.

"This is the inheritance's test?" Fang Yuan asked while healing himself.

"Hehehe, what sort of test is this?" Mo Yao gloated arrogantly in his mind. "This inheritance contains Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's will—only Gu Immortals could withstand it. However, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable modified it so mortals could endure it. You owe your survival to his mercy."

Fang Yuan snorted coldly: "His mercy was for his bloodline descendants, not me. Regardless, Giant Sun true inheritances carry immense danger."

"Naturally. But having survived this test, and since it is merely an ordinary true inheritance, your ten-edge owner token grants you the authority to claim it," Mo Yao said.

As expected, when Fang Yuan sent his mind inside, the red light opened up without Reckless Savage's figure reappearing.

"Primordial ash owl transformation..." Fang Yuan realized this transformation path killer move allowed a Gu Immortal to become a primordial ash owl, gaining immense strength.

Reckless Savage Demon Venerable was the progenitor of strength path and creator of transformation path.

Without hesitation, Fang Yuan released the red light lump and let it fly away.

Though precious, this true inheritance did not suit him currently.

Moving his arms, he swam toward another area in the dark, silent void.

# Chapter 598: Three Olds, Three True Inheritances, Using Will

Fang Yuan worked hard to swim towards a jade light.

It flew slowly, twisting and turning, until Fang Yuan chased it down and grabbed it.

Also bowl-sized, Fang Yuan cautiously sent his consciousness into it.

An indescribable vibrating force spread from the jade light into Fang Yuan's body.

"Careful, this belongs to Old Immortal Kong Jue!" Mo Yao's will warned in his mind.

"Don't worry, it can't escape!" Fang Yuan said confidently, clutching the light lump tightly.

"Idiot, I didn't mean that. Let go quickly!" Mo Yao warned, but it was already too late.

The mystical vibrations traveled from the jade light straight into Fang Yuan's aperture.

Violent waves battered his aperture, cracking the rank five peak stage crystal walls under the pressure.

This peculiar inheritance test was difficult to defend against, directly targeting the Gu Master's aperture.

"Sever your arms with Gu worms quickly! You must make a sacrifice to survive!" Mo Yao shouted in his mind.

"Cut off my arms?" Fang Yuan's face sank, sweat beading on his forehead.

He tried to release it, but the jade light exerted a powerful suction, pinning his hands tightly.

Unable to break free, the vibrations in Fang Yuan's aperture grew ever stronger.

Inspiration striking, Fang Yuan channeled primeval essence from his second aperture into his first.

Sharing the burden between both apertures greatly alleviated the crisis in his first aperture.

As the jade light dimmed and the vibrations ceased, Fang Yuan successfully passed the test.

"What is going on, you have two apertures?" Mo Yao said.

"Lad, you hid this deeply—to think you truly have two apertures! You actually confirmed those rumors," Mo Yao said with deep emotion.

Unwilling to discuss it, Fang Yuan deflected: "You mentioned Old Immortal Kong Jue—is he the refinement path supreme grandmaster from the olden antiquity era?"

"Indeed. History records only three refinement path supreme grandmasters, known as the 'Three Olds': Old Eccentric Tian Nan, Old Immortal Kong Jue, and Long Hair Ancestor."

Mo Yao continued: "Old Eccentric Tian Nan had an eccentric personality, dying from an attempt to refine the sky. Old Immortal Kong Jue researched apertures, authoring Immortal Aperture Strategy and enabling ten extreme physiques to achieve immortal ascension. Long Hair Ancestor lived the longest and refined the most Immortal Gu, including Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. Rumors even claimed he could refine lifespan Gu, prompting Giant Sun to attack Lang Ya blessed land, though fruitlessly."

"Kong Jue's inheritance tests one's aperture. Thanks to having two apertures, you got through safely. This inheritance is excellent and would help you immensely," Mo Yao continued.

Fang Yuan's consciousness went in again.

Titled 'immortal ascension vital information', it recorded Kong Jue's insights, countermeasures, and crucial points for immortal ascension across all paths.

Fang Yuan assessed inwardly: "Though neither a Gu recipe nor an Immortal Gu, its theoretical guidance holds immense value. It can aid one's own ascension and illuminate other paths—truly a priceless treasure."

"This immortal ascension vital information dates back to long ago and may not apply to modern paths, which have diversified greatly since the simpler olden antiquity era. However, the true essence of this inheritance is not the text itself, but Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's reading notes. His incisive notes summarize the core points directly, truly worth more than a thousand pieces of gold," Mo Yao revealed.

But Fang Yuan did not choose it.

Fang Yuan released the jade lump, watching it shoot into the darkness even faster than the red light.

"You are really giving it up? Don't regret this in the future," Mo Yao sighed in his mind.

"Regret? Hehe, that word doesn't exist in my vocabulary." Fang Yuan chuckled, resuming his search.

He swam in the darkness for a while, discovering the third light lump.

Shining with grey light, this lump flew like a shooting star—faster than the previous two—trailing a frost-colored tail behind it.

As Fang Yuan approached it, Mo Yao said: "You don't need to take such risks every time. Having collected many wisdom path Gu worms, why not display their true value?"

"Oh? What do you mean?" Fang Yuan asked without slowing down.

"Lad, you should thank me. The method I'll teach you bypasses the inheritance tests, letting you inspect their contents directly."

Mo Yao suggested using wisdom path Gu worms to create a will, sending it into the true inheritance to investigate before recalling it.

"Wisdom path encompasses thought, will, and emotion. Thoughts are easily produced like water droplets, but fragile. Wills are superior to thoughts—like solid ice, harder to form but far sturdier. They can act independently, withstand backlash, and be recalled when needed," Mo Yao explained.

"Why hesitate? You bought all those wisdom path Gu worms—special will, deliberate will, play will—use them now," Mo Yao urged.

Pausing briefly, she urged: "You should know by now: though my will resides in your mind, the wills you produce with these Gu will be completely pure and uncorrupted by me. Haven't you been wary of me? This method has a huge advantage, you can use it to avoid those true inheritance tests and check the secrets of the unparalleled inheritances. Unparalleled inheritance, they have much greater value than ordinary inheritances."

In truth, Mo Yao's suggestion was practical, and Fang Yuan was persuaded to try it.

Fang Yuan brought out his purchased wisdom path Gu worms.

He selected special will Gu and injected primeval essence to form a will.

The will resembled Fang Yuan as a youth with dark, eerie eyes, though its features appeared more masculine and resolute than his actual body.

"Wills can only reside in souls; to send it out, you'll need a small soul worm," Mo Yao reminded him.

It was the rank two big soul worm.

Patting it lightly, Fang Yuan infused his special will into the big soul worm and directed it toward the nearest green-white inheritance light lump.

The big soul worm moved far faster than he could alone.

It quickly entered the true inheritance light lump and returned moments later, battered and wavering.

Fang Yuan retrieved his will and looked.

Though also an ordinary true inheritance, to certain Gu Masters or even Gu Immortals, its value far exceeded the first two!

# Chapter 599: Longevity, Hard, Hard, Hard

The third inheritance held immense value because it concerned methods for extending lifespan.

It was a lifespan extension method for Gu Immortals, created by none other than Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

He named this immortal art — Possession.

Its core was the rank six possession Immortal Gu, supported by roughly three thousand rank five mortal Gu.

"To think possession Immortal Gu originated here." In his previous life's chaotic five regions war, possession Immortal Gu had allowed numerous Gu Immortals to extend their lives.

But soon, Fang Yuan calmed down.

The special will transmitted further information.

The inheritance was merely an empty shell; someone had already taken possession Immortal Gu and the three thousand mortal Gu.

"Eh? This is..." Communicating with the special will, Fang Yuan's eyes widened suddenly.

"Using a soul to seize a body is merely a dying struggle; death remains inevitable. Lifespan Gu is the only true method for longevity. A Gu Immortal's path is fraught with calamities. The body falters, the soul struggles to endure alone, and pursuing longevity defies heaven... it is hard, hard, hard!"

At the end, the author had signed his name—Spectral Soul Demon Venerable!

"Did Spectral Soul Demon Venerable take possession Immortal Gu? Unlikely. As the creator of soul path, he had no need for it. Judging by his message, Spectral Soul had no interest in possession whatsoever. Seeing a predecessor's search for longevity moved him to leave these words," Fang Yuan deduced.

"Even invincible Immortal and Demon Venerables cannot escape death. The wheel of fortune turns; they rule for eras, yet inevitably fall from their prime, while the downtrodden rise. Can anything truly be eternal in this world?" Mo Yao sighed heavily in his mind.

But this was not what Fang Yuan thought.

With an eerie gaze, he pondered: "The Great Dao of heaven and earth balances all beings through mutual restraint. Yet Gu Masters gather resources across the world for self-advancement, inherently defying the way of heaven. Perhaps that is why calamities and tribulations occur. But precisely so, eternal life that surpasses longevity is the goal that is worth my pursuit!"

At this thought, the flame in his heart burned ever brighter and hotter!

Venerables could only achieve long life, but his goal was true eternal life.

As a phrase from his past life went: 'Struggling against heaven, earth, and humans brings endless joy!'

Since this true inheritance was empty, it was not worth wasting time on.

Fang Yuan continued searching.

One was 'false emotion fake will Gu', and the other was "loving affection Gu."

"Didn't you say there were unparalleled inheritances here alongside ordinary ones? Why haven't I found any after so long?" Fang Yuan asked Mo Yao, puzzled.

She appeared and replied flatly: "Hmph, impatient already? In my time, I searched for three full months. The secluded domain is extremely huge, and all the inheritances are moving around, there are only a few unparalleled true inheritances, it is normal that you have not found one. Have some patience, lad."

Fang Yuan asked again: "Since you visited before, what good inheritances did you find? Tell me."

"I saw many, of course, but inheritances fly completely at random here. Telling you is useless; you must rely on luck. Heh, beware of the time—the more inheritances you contact or the longer you stay, the faster they fly and the more dangerous it becomes. Back then, I nearly died here after three months."

As Mo Yao said this, her tone was filled with lingering fear.

"Even you almost died here?" Fang Yuan caught the key point.

"Lad, as a mortal, you're too weak. You can only check around eight inheritances and stay at most a month. Having already seen five, you must be careful!" Mo Yao warned.

"What could threaten a grand Gu Immortal like you?" Fang Yuan asked.

Mo Yao merely smiled tenderly, saying, "If fated, you'll know when you experience it," before concealing herself.

Thirteen days later, Fang Yuan found the seventh true inheritance.

This washbasin-sized light lump shone with brilliant white radiance, exuding an aura far stronger than ordinary inheritances.

"This will broaden your horizons, lad—an unparalleled true inheritance!" Mo Yao said in his mind.

# Chapter 600: Supreme True Inheritance!

"Unparalleled true inheritance!" Fang Yuan's eyes brightened as he looked at the blazing white light ahead.

Quickly retrieving special will Gu and a big soul worm, he infused his will into the worm and sent it flying toward the light lump.

As the big soul worm drew nearer to the inheritance light, Fang Yuan sensed his connection to it weakening.

Before the worm was even three hundred steps away from the light lump, his connection with it snapped completely.

"What's happening?" Fang Yuan approached the big soul worm cautiously and retrieved it for examination.

The big soul worm showed no signs of injury, but the will inside it had vanished completely.

"Ah, I remember! So it was this," Mo Yao spoke up as Fang Yuan hesitated.

She chuckled coquettishly: "Kid, is this good luck or bad? While unparalleled true inheritances are few, you've encountered the most special one of all."

"Please advise me." Fang Yuan's expression turned calm.

"Inside is a rank seven Immortal Gu Giant Sun Immortal Venerable personally refined: human qi Gu. Its ability is mysterious, even bizarre; even I spent a great deal to investigate it clearly." Mo Yao sighed.

"Human qi Gu..." Fang Yuan pondered over this crucial name.

Realizing something, he asked, "Does it relate to the three elements of immortal ascension?"

"You guessed right," Mo Yao sighed. "In Gu Immortal ascension, the three qi of heaven, earth, and human are crucial. When ascending, you must completely shatter your aperture and absorb heaven and earth qi. The more heaven and earth qi you take in, the higher your chance of success. But they cannot be accumulated limitlessly; they must balance equally with human qi."

"Human qi is the sum of a Gu Master's own accumulation. A Gu Master's battle strength, soul depth, understanding, talent, and experiences all transform into human qi during immortal ascension."

"The deeper the accumulation, the more human qi they possess. The more human qi, the more heaven and earth qi they can absorb, raising the chance of ascending to Gu Immortal. And human qi Gu absorbs and purifies others' human qi to supplement one's own during ascension, greatly increasing the breakthrough chance."

However, human qi Immortal Gu was rank seven, currently higher than Spring Autumn Cicada.

With a mortal body, Fang Yuan could not endure its might.

His will had been devoured before even approaching, purified into a negligible trace of human qi and stored.

Without Mo Yao's information, Fang Yuan would still be in the dark about what happened.

"Human qi Gu is wonderful, but it doesn't suit me." Fang Yuan took one last regretful glance at the burning white light lump, shook his head, and turned away without lingering.

"The most crucial point is that I cannot use human qi Immortal Gu. I need to breakthrough from mortal to advance to Gu Immortal, before that I simply cannot handle human qi Gu. And if I become a Gu Immortal, what would I need human qi Gu for?" Helping others?""

He slowly flew around in the true inheritance secluded domain.

Comprehending something, Fang Yuan said after a brief silence, "Mo Yao, I understand the danger you mentioned."

Mo Yao laughed, unsurprised. "The longer a Gu Master stays in the true inheritance secluded domain, and every time they touch an inheritance, the faster these true inheritances move. This urges Gu Masters to choose quickly. In the end, the true inheritances move as fast as meteors, impossible to catch, and Gu Masters can lose their lives at any minute."

Mo Yao continued, "You saw that unparalleled true inheritance—your will was refined into human qi before even getting close. If it crashes into you at meteor speed and you have no time to dodge, what will happen?"

"As a mortal, even ordinary tests are difficult for you. Above unparalleled inheritances lies an even higher level—Supreme True Inheritance," Mo Yao revealed.

"Supreme true inheritance?!"

"In this entire secluded domain, there are only three supreme true inheritances," Mo Yao sighed with deep emotion, lost in memory. "It is impossible for a mortal to obtain them. This is why Eighty-Eight True Yang Building has stood for so long, with over half of its eighty-eight true inheritances still remaining."

"The true inheritances are speeding up; you have only one chance left. Pick one quickly and leave... eh?! Not good, run!" Mo Yao's voice suddenly shifted into a startled cry.

Fang Yuan glanced back and saw a man-sized true inheritance glowing with mysterious colors whizzing toward him, trailing a long, dazzling tail of blazing light through the dark secluded domain.

Of the only three supreme true inheritances in the secluded domain, one was now hurtling toward Fang Yuan!

# Chapter 601: Profiting from the situation

"Supreme true inheritance!" Fang Yuan's pupils dilated, his gaze burning bright.

Even a thousand steps away, Fang Yuan felt the light lump's surging aura.

"Lad, wake up! I know how intoxicating it is, but if you don't want to die, don't lose yourself! Look at yourself!" Mo Yao shouted.

The voice snapped Fang Yuan awake; looking at himself, he blanched in horror!

In mere moments, his body grew weak, wrinkles creased his forehead, and his arms withered.

"This Gu is...?" Fang Yuan realized the shocking answer, activating his movement Gu to retreat frantically.

Putting distance between them, Fang Yuan watched in fearful awe as the supreme true inheritance cleaved through the dark space into the distance.

"Just the aura of a supreme true inheritance nearly killed me. How terrifying must its test be?" Fang Yuan gasped in shock.

"Could this supreme true inheritance's Immortal Gu be... that legendary Gu?" Fang Yuan was nearly eighty percent certain, yet the conclusion was still staggering to believe.

Mo Yao chuckled. "Lad, you guessed right. I couldn't believe it either back then, but the truth is before your eyes! Indeed, this supreme true inheritance contains the legendary rank nine wisdom Gu!"

But the price to use it was extremely high.

The Legends of Ren Zu recorded that Ren Zu and Desolate Ancient Moon had to sacrifice their middle age to obtain its help.

In other words, using wisdom Gu meant using up lifespan!

Without even drawing close, Fang Yuan's lifespan had been drained rapidly, aging his body and wrinkling his skin in mere moments.

"There are three supreme true inheritances here. What are the other two like? I really want to experience them." Fang Yuan's eyes shone with an indescribable brilliance.

Mo Yao urged, "Don't be foolish—with a ten-edge owner token, you can only take an ordinary true inheritance. Even if you pass the test of an unparalleled true inheritance, you cannot take them. Don't even mention supreme true inheritances, your weak body that can be blown away by the wind cannot even endure their aura!"

Fang Yuan laughed loudly. "That makes me even more interested! Such an opportunity is exceedingly rare; I might never get another chance if I miss this."

Mo Yao's will grew more frantic: "You lunatic! What are you thinking? Letting so many true inheritances slip by just to broaden your horizons? If you die, what about me? What about Water Pavilion?"

Driven frantic by worry, Mo Yao relented, "Fine, I surrender—you are truly stubborn! Stop looking, I'll tell you about the other two supreme true inheritances."

"The first is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's luck path inheritance, which made him invincible in the world. The second is the control rights of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. Refined by Giant Sun and Long Hair Ancestor, this tower can plunder a region's Gu worms, providing endless cultivation resources to whoever obtains it!"

Fang Yuan chuckled and continued wandering as if he hadn't heard.

Several days later, the inheritances flew as fast as birds. Evading one or two was easy, but the secluded domain seemed to shrink, forcing true inheritances of all sizes into the narrowing space. Their trailing lights wove a web that Fang Yuan had to maneuver through to survive.

Fang Yuan focused with utmost concentration, not daring to relax for a moment since the slightest slip meant instant death.

"Leave now. You can't even take ordinary inheritances anymore, and staying only increases the danger every second. To go mad at such a crucial moment!" Mo Yao sighed dispiritedly.

With burning eyes, Fang Yuan suddenly asked, "Could I reap benefits if two true inheritances collide?"

She screeched, "You idiot! Would Giant Sun Immortal Venerable make such an obvious mistake? You are a victim of your own cleverness! How could there be such an obvious loophole? You are thinking far too wishfully!"

Rumble...

Just then, a sudden explosion echoed from afar.

Looking toward the noise, Fang Yuan saw two true inheritances collide and ricochet in different directions.

Mo Yao was also dumbstruck.

"How is this possible?!" Her voice shrieked shrilly, devoid of any refinement grandmaster demeanor. "Why didn't I encounter something so good when I explored this place?!"

Then realization dawned: "So that's how it is! That is the luck path inheritance! Back then I cracked it to obtain Fortune Rivalling Heaven, but it flew away. I could only use the other inheritances I obtained to settle for the second best option, refining calamity beckoning Gu!"

Mo Yao's crack had disrupted the supreme true inheritance's balance, causing the inheritances to collide with one another.

Fang Yuan's eyes widened—the collision seemed to have knocked a Gu out of the luck path supreme true inheritance!

Fang Yuan was stumped: "What is that?"

Stupefied, Mo Yao shouted, "That's a luck path Gu worm! Why are you just standing there? Grab it!"

Fang Yuan hesitated, "If I take it, won't I trigger the luck path inheritance's test?"

"The collision widened the crack and it's breaking apart! Grab it and leave quickly!" Mo Yao shouted.

Fang Yuan chuckled and dodged forward, reaching the Gu worm with great difficulty to pick it up.

This was a rank five mortal Gu, not an Immortal Gu.

"You're still not leaving?!" Mo Yao was practically howling.

"Haha, what's the rush?" Fang Yuan laughed heartily, remaining in the secluded domain to observe his surroundings.

"Judging by the chaos and time, it's almost ready," he muttered.

"Lad, what did you say?"

Fang Yuan released multiple Gu worms that activated together to form a whirlpool.

The whirlpool exerted powerful suction, absorbing the true inheritance lights.

Breaths later, the whirlpool slowed and collapsed loudly, revealing a doorway.

"All according to plan!" Fang Yuan plunged in without hesitation.

He saw the land spirit!

# Chapter 602: Frost Jade Peacock

Before him stood a grand, elegant hall of white jade.

Upon the platform stood a green copper divine bird statue. The divine bird had spread wings, but countless tree-thick black chains coiled around its body, piercing through feathers into its flesh.

"This, this, this!" Shocked by the sudden development, Mo Yao stuttered.

She gulped and pointed, shouting, "This is the Frost Jade Peacock, Imperial Court blessed land's land spirit!"

"What's so surprising?" Fang Yuan smiled. "Imperial Court blessed land naturally had a land spirit, or it never would have recognized Giant Sun Immortal Venerable as master. If the blessed land is destroyed, the land spirit will die too. Currently Imperial Court blessed land is still in good shape, it means the land spirit is still alive."

Yet this setup contained an enormous flaw that any Gu Immortal could see.

Namely, the existence of Imperial Court blessed land's land spirit!

This flaw did not exist while Giant Sun Immortal Venerable lived, since the land spirit obeyed his every command as master.

After his death, the blessed land became ownerless, meaning anyone who fulfilled the land spirit's expectations could become its new owner.

And because Eighty-Eight True Yang Building sat within Imperial Court blessed land, controlling the blessed land meant claiming the building as well.

"To think the land spirit was hidden here! Only when the inheritances reach extreme speed does this gateway open!" Mo Yao understood.

Ascending the stairs, Fang Yuan arrived at the feet of the green copper bird statue.

Mo Yao noted, "The green paste is formed by rank seven Earth Prison, and the chains come from rank seven Earth Net... Eh!"

Mid-sentence, a sudden thought stopped her in her tracks.

She suddenly remembered: Fang Yuan had recently summoned two Immortal Gu, one being Gruel Mud!

Earth Prison and Earth Net were rank seven Immortal Gu, a rank higher than Gruel Mud.

Yet they were expendable Gu that vanished after a single use.

The two rank seven Gu had sealed the land spirit, but hundreds of thousands of years had weakened them.

And Gruel Mud was a direct counter to this strength!

"Hahaha, seems you figured it out; you're not entirely stupid." Fang Yuan laughed, taking out Gruel Mud Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan squeezed lightly and it shattered.

Guided by Fang Yuan's will, the light flew up and fused into the statue.

The statue began trembling violently. Cracks spread across the green paste as the chains clashed against one another with harsh, metallic clatter.

Fang Yuan chuckled, "Mo Yao, look at the bird's head."

Mo Yao gasped: "The green paste on its head is melting! Of course—that is Gruel Mud's real effect!"

Melting into gruel-like mud, the greenish-black slime dripped onto the floor, contrasting sharply with the white jade tiles.

The Frost Jade Peacock's head was freed, but the melting slowed dramatically at its neck.

Evidently, Earth Prison and Earth Net's residual power reacted to resist Gruel Mud, sharply reducing its efficiency.

"Just like the video from my previous life," Fang Yuan chuckled, looking at Frost Jade Peacock. "Imperial Court land spirit, look at your feet—I am the one freeing you. How does it feel to breathe again after hundreds of thousands of years? As long as you recognise me as your master, I will help you to regain freedom!"

Frost Jade Peacock sneered arrogantly, "I am one with the blessed land; everything that transpired here is clear to me. If you want to be my new owner, you will need to fulfill one condition."

"What condition?"

# Chapter 603: Sleepless Night

"No, don't abandon me..."

"Save me, save me, benefactor!"

Voices echoing in his ears, Tai Bai Yun Sheng suddenly opened his eyes and sat up in bed.

Ever since failing the round, he had been mired in deep guilt, blaming his greed for sacrificing Gao Yang and Zhu Zai.

Almost every night, he had the same nightmare.

In the nightmare, hideous blood beasts encircled him as Gao Yang and Zhu Zai pleaded for salvation.

Yet every time, paralyzed, Tai Bai Yun Sheng could only watch the blood beasts devour them down to bone.

"I believe in Lord Tai Bai, he is so kind and righteous, he will definitely never abandon us!"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng felt agonizing sadness, helplessness, and regret!

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was not the only one spending a sleepless night.

"Damn it! The owner token went missing!" Hei Lou Lan gritted his teeth, his eyes shining ruthlessly.

"So what if I lack the owner token? Nothing will stop me from obtaining the strength path Immortal Gu!"

Fang Yuan was slowly walking in the sacred palace's garden.

His expression was grim and unsightly.

Fresh out of the white jade hall, Fang Yuan felt vexed over subduing the Imperial Court land spirit.

Mo Yao chuckled: "To think the ownership condition is this. Finding mutual true love won't be easy for you, lad."

Earlier, Fang Yuan had faced the Imperial Court land spirit, Frost Jade Peacock, and learned the condition for ownership: true love!

For the Frost Jade Peacock to submit, it required a Gu Master couple deeply in love.

Setting aside everything else, requiring Fang Yuan to truly love a woman was nearly impossible.

"In my previous life, I could have fulfilled it. But now..." Fang Yuan stopped at a stone bridge, leaning on the railing and gazing at the jade lake below with a cold laugh.

"Life is like a dream, morning dew, a fleeting flower, a phantom bubble..." Fang Yuan muttered dazedly.

A light breeze rippled the lake's surface.

Amidst the ripples, a blurry silhouette of a woman seemed to appear before his absent-minded gaze.

She was the woman buried deep in his memories.

In his previous life, wandering destitute, he had met her at his lowest point.

"Speaking of true love... why am I thinking of her?" Fang Yuan's grip on the railing tightened unconsciously.

Frowning, his gaze turned icy cold; the woman's figure vanished, leaving only the lake surface before him.

Fang Yuan fell into deep thought.

The current situation was not looking good!

Without subduing the land spirit, Fang Yuan's plan to seize Eighty-Eight True Yang Building would completely fail, halting his progress here.

"No wonder the Central Continent Gu Immortals destroyed this place—experiencing true love is far harder for Gu Immortals than mortals."

"The seal is weakening. Imprisoned for eras and craving freedom, the land spirit will surely attempt to break free. Though Giant Sun's will still slumbers, once the seal melts sufficiently or the land spirit continues resisting, it will definitely awaken!"

As the culprit who unsealed the land spirit, Fang Yuan would face certain doom if targeted by Giant Sun's will!

Fang Yuan's original plan was like this.

First, enter Northern Plains and infiltrate Imperial Court blessed land.

He achieved this flawlessly: using past-life memories, he killed the dying Wolf King Chang Shan Yin, usurped his identity, became a Hei tribe higher-up, and entered Imperial Court blessed land with the alliance army.

Second, enter Eighty-Eight True Yang Building for maximum gain. Guided by the Central Continent Gu Immortals' video, he would subdue the land spirit and claim ownership of Imperial Court blessed land without alerting the Venerable's will.

Third, after gaining ownership, he would not rush to dismantle Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, but hide in the background and develop in secret.

He would order the land spirit to remain in the white jade hall, cooperating with Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's operations.

First, he could use the blessed land's power against the Gu Immortal Tai Bai Yun Sheng, ensuring high success and guaranteeing he would not lose. Even if he failed to seize Landscape as Before Immortal Gu, the land spirit's protection would keep him safe from mortal peril.

Second, he could use Fixed Immortal Travel to shuttle freely between Hu Immortal and Imperial Court blessed lands. Coveted by Immortal Crane Sect and plagued by recurring earthly calamities, Hu Immortal blessed land was a turbulent vortex unsuitable for peaceful cultivation.

As Imperial Court's master, he could use Hu Immortal blessed land as cover and Imperial Court as his true base. He could cultivate while scheming against Immortal Crane Sect; if things went awry, he could abandon Hu Immortal blessed land and retreat here.

Protected by an Immortal Venerable's arrangements, Imperial Court blessed land resisted wisdom path deductions. Once Fang Yuan patched its loopholes over time, it would be far safer than Hu Immortal blessed land.

Third, owning this treasure trove would allow him to safely harvest vast resources, including Immortal Gu, whenever True Yang Building opened. In time, he could replicate his past life by subduing a blood path Gu worm to become a blood path Gu Immortal—a slow, steady, and secure progression.

But though the plan was perfect, reality was not.

Despite his best efforts, Fang Yuan was stuck at the second step.

Unable to claim ownership, he could not borrow the land spirit's power, leaving him helpless as a mortal.

Giant Sun's will would inevitably awaken. While Fang Yuan could flee using hole earth Gu, he could not take the Immortal Gu!

"For now, I can only try everything to persuade the land spirit. Aligning with it would let us face Giant Sun's will together and borrow some power. Sigh... I truly hope to avoid that last resort."

Fang Yuan pondered for a while, but found no better alternative.

# Chapter 604: Luck Inspection Gu

Half a month later.

Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

Densely packed wind scythe birds blotted out the sky as they swarmed toward the alliance army.

"Kill, kill, kill!" Hei Lou Lan roared. Rolling black smoke erupted from his body into tentacles, seizing and devouring the surrounding wind scythe birds one by one.

This was the twenty-fifth round of the sixty-eighth floor of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

Past experience indicated an easier method existed, but Hei Lou Lan had charged in directly, unleashing full force to overwhelm the flock.

Soon, Fang Yuan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, and the other rank five experts unleashed their killer moves, shifting the tide in the alliance army's favor.

Eventually, they succeeded, getting into the twenty-sixth round.

Before Hei Lou Lan could finish probing the round, his attendant Hei Shu reported: "Lord Tribe Leader, thirteen tribe leaders have submitted a joint petition requesting a temporary halt. Fearing heavy casualties, they ask to rest and recover."

Hei Lou Lan scowled: "Whining cowards! Reject their request. Anyone who deserts will have their entire tribe executed without mercy!"

"Advance, charge!" Hei Lou Lan bellowed, waving his hand to command the army.

Lately, Eighty-Eight True Yang Building had been trembling strangely every few days.

Combined with the missing owner token, Hei Lou Lan sensed foul play; his instincts warned him that an unthinkable crisis was looming.

To preempt disaster, he needed the strength path Immortal Gu immediately. Only by ascending to a Gu Immortal would he possess the power to control the volatile situation.

The assault pushed through to the twenty-eighth round before mounting exhaustion and severe casualties forced Hei Lou Lan to retreat and regroup.

Back in his room, Tai Bai Yun Sheng smiled bitterly, holding several east window Gu.

These east window Gu contained past Gu Masters' cultivation insights, predominantly concerning time path attainment!

These were all round rewards from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

"Could this be destiny's arrangement for me to become a Gu Immortal?"

As a rank five peak stage time path master, his temporal sensitivity had warned him years ago that his lifespan was dwindling.

His core inheritance comprised three Gu: River as Before, Mountain as Before, and Man as Before.

The inheritance theorized that upon immortal ascension, the supreme resonance of heaven and earth could elevate Man as Before into an Immortal Gu.

"With Man as Before Immortal Gu, I could extend my own lifespan. Alas, unlike Spring Autumn Cicada, it cannot save Gao Yang and Zhu Zai. Sigh..."

At this thought, heavy sorrow, regret, and guilt overwhelmed Tai Bai Yun Sheng once more.

Fang Yuan stood atop a tall tower, observing Hei tribe.

With Luck Inspection Gu activated, a distinct field of vision unfolded before him.

This rank five mortal Gu was his sole unexpected gain from the true inheritance secluded domain.

Countless smoke-like luck strands drifted above Hei tribe's quarters, but two stood out like cranes among chickens, unshielded even by palace walls.

One belonged to Hei Lou Lan, an immense, thick azure pillar of luck. The other stemmed from Tai Bai Yun Sheng, glowing like a fiery sunset—blazing red and bright atop his roof in dazzling flames.

"Both possess tremendous luck, yet of differing natures. Hei Lou Lan's carries enduring vitality, while Tai Bai Yun Sheng's resembles old firewood burning in a final blaze. Lately, I manipulated the round rewards to feed Tai Bai Yun Sheng time path insights. Each time he receives one, his fiery red luck brightens, subtly increasing his chances of immortal ascension."

He used the luck inspection Gu on himself.

Fang Yuan's body was cloaked in ink-black luck that formed a massive coffin, enveloping him with dense death energy and severe misfortune.

"My luck is ominous. Meanwhile, negotiations with the land spirit remain deadlocked; the arrogant creature only cares about breaking its seal. True Yang Building has already shuddered thirty-eight times—Giant Sun's will is bound to awaken eventually."

"Eh?" Fang Yuan gasped as he spotted a group of Gu Masters, all cloaked in black coffin luck, heading toward Hei tribe.

A moment later, they all entered Tai Bai Yun Sheng's residence.

"A fine opportunity to unravel the meaning of this black coffin luck." With a somber gaze, Fang Yuan peered deeply toward Tai Bai Yun Sheng's residence.

# Chapter 605: Pitiful Person (Double chapter)

"We implore you to help us, old sir Tai Bai!"

Inside the room, several Gu Masters knelt, weeping as they desperately begged Tai Bai Yun Sheng for assistance.

These Gu Masters held notable status: all were leaders of their respective tribes.

Lou tribe, Lu tribe, Xi tribe... as small and mid-sized forces, they had borne the brunt of casualties in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. Continued losses threatened their total extinction.

As Northern Plains' foremost healing master, Tai Bai Yun Sheng enjoyed peerless renown for kindness and benevolence. Moreover, as Hei tribe's external elder, he possessed Hei Lou Lan's deep trust.

"Sigh..." Tai Bai Yun Sheng sighed deeply, having long disapproved of Hei Lou Lan's ruthless conduct.

Turning to console the leaders, he said: "This old man will intercede with Tribe Leader Hei Lou Lan, though I can only promise to do my best."

Pocketing their petition, Tai Bai Yun Sheng bid the tribe leaders farewell and headed to the grand hall to find Hei Lou Lan.

Hei Lou Lan initially refused flatly, but as Tai Bai Yun Sheng reasoned and pleaded gently, he relented: "Very well, I will grant them temporary respite, provided they lend out all their Gu worms. The army must advance without losing combat strength! Each lent Gu worm grants one exemption: a rank two Gu spares a rank two Gu Master. A rank three Gu spares a rank three Gu Master, and so on."

The tribe leaders exchanged glances, weighed their options, and ultimately accepted the condition.

The following day, Hei Lou Lan dispatched the Black Banner Elite to collect the Gu worms promptly, sending Tai Bai Yun Sheng to oversee the process and manage logistics.

When Tai Bai Yun Sheng reported back, Hei Lou Lan invited him to a banquet.

At the banquet, Hei Lou Lan raised his cup: "Old sir, drink! It is our tribe's blessing to have you; your healing has saved countless lives and minimized our casualties. You have achieved tremendous merit."

"I am unworthy of such praise. Success lies with fate; with Longevity Heaven watching over us, we can only do our utmost."

"With Longevity Heaven watching, we can only do our best..." Hei Lou Lan drained his cup, muttering with a sigh: "Old sir speaks with profound truth. Longevity Heaven watches as we tread an uncertain future; mortals can only strive our hardest. Elder Tai Bai has done his utmost, and I, Hei Lou Lan, must do no less!"

Sensing a deeper implication behind the words, Tai Bai Yun Sheng asked: "Lord Tribe Leader, what do you mean?"

Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily and was about to answer when Hei Shu entered with a report.

Covered in blood, he cautiously approached Hei Lou Lan with a respectful expression: "Reporting to lord tribe leader, the black banner army has met your expectations and settled it appropriately."

Sensing the killing aura with growing dread, Tai Bai Yun Sheng quickly asked: "What do you mean by settled appropriately? Hei Shu! What did you settle?"

"Hahaha, Elder Tai Bai! Just as you said — we can only do our best! You are doing yours, and I am doing mine! Who would be left to challenge the rounds with me?" Hei Lou Lan said resolutely, his eyes glinting ruthlessly.

"Hei Lou Lan, you!" Tai Bai Yun Sheng stood up in a flash.

"Elder Tai Bai, remember your current status." Putting away his ruthlessness, Hei Lou Lan indifferently poured another cup of wine.

Unmoved, Hei Lou Lan pointed at the dishes and laughed: "Elder Tai Bai, this banquet celebrates your success. Without your support, why would they trust us enough to lend their Gu? Without their Gu worms, my black banner army easily swooped in and obliterated them. I have you to thank for this."

"Hei Lou Lan, you are really an unscrupulous scoundrel!"

"Unscrupulous? To think you would say something so naive. Elder Tai Bai, you were once a young tribe leader—after living so many years, have you not seen the reality of this world? Politics has always been dirty."

Snorting coldly, he turned and walked out of the hall without looking back once.

Hei Lou Lan raised his wine cup calmly. Glancing at Tai Bai Yun Sheng's retreating figure, he sneered: "Tai Bai Yun Sheng is merely a healing Gu Master, what is there to fear? His reputation? Hehe, after this, who will dare believe in him? Good deeds go unnoticed, while bad deeds travel a thousand li..."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng hurried toward the scene.

The sacred palace was bloodstained, corpses littering the ground.

Corpses were severed of limbs or bisected in gruesome slaughter, their twisted expressions frozen in agony.

"It was all my fault. If not for my mediation... I failed to see his vile intentions! They all died because they trusted me!"

He collapsed weakly to his knees, propping himself up as blood stained his hands, knees, and pants bright red.

"Sorry, I am sorry..."

"He is a good person... though darkness lingers in his heart, there is great terror between life and death. Facing death, who wouldn't lose themselves?" From a hidden corner far away, Fang Yuan observed silently.

It turned out the black coffin luck represented a severe, life-threatening disaster, proven by these tribes' extermination.

Meanwhile, his own death energy was dozens or even a hundred times thicker than that of these tribesmen!

"Hehe, interesting. Luck, huh..." Fang Yuan curled his lips into a cold, arrogant smile, eager to see if this bad luck could halt his steps.

"In this life, no person, reason, or obstacle can shake my resolve to press forward!" His icy gaze fixed upon Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

"Who said kind people are rewarded?" A sarcastic trace entered Fang Yuan's cold expression. "Let me lend you a hand."

He secretly activated his Gu worms, sending an untraceable, illusory voice whispering into Tai Bai Yun Sheng's ears.

He heard voices that sounded just like Gao Yang and Zhu Zai.

"I believe in you! You will definitely save us, isn't that right?"

"Old sir, you are our benefactor. Grateful to you, we are willing to risk our lives to help you!"

The puddle of blood rippled as his nightmare resurfaced: Gao Yang and Zhu Zai dying in the sea of blood beasts!

Tai Bai Yun Sheng shuddered, frozen like a statue, before throwing his head back and screaming with all his might.

"Hehehe, hihihi, hahaha!"

When his screams ceased, Tai Bai Yun Sheng began laughing maniacally.

His laughter held madness, sorrow, and fury, along with mockery toward both himself and the mortal world.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan smiled faintly; as a reborn transmigrator, his rich life experience allowed him to grasp human psychology with precise mastery.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was a very good person.

But his subconscious action in the blood hall was akin to betrayal.

It sparked intense self-doubt, suspicion, and denial of his core values.

When a person denies and doubts himself, he inevitably plunges into an abyss of agony.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was clearly in agony and wracked with guilt, tormented nightly by the same nightmare.

He found it impossible to accept that he could possess such a despicable and lowly nature. His entire life was devoted to justice and benevolence. Having walked this path for so long, he yearned to return, but deep in his heart, this act formed an impassable barrier.

Trapped in an abyss of agony, he sank deeper the more he struggled.

The tribe leaders' plea had offered him a chance at salvation and redemption for his mistake.

Had he succeeded, it would have been the finest medicine to atone for his sins and find self-forgiveness.

Instead, Hei Lou Lan ordered a massacre without sparing women or children, making Tai Bai Yun Sheng the greatest accomplice to the slaughter.

His cure became a piercing poison whose potency shattered his composure, pushing his psyche to the brink of collapse.

At this juncture, Fang Yuan's gentle nudge shattered Tai Bai Yun Sheng's heart, triggering a total breakdown.

"If you deny even yourself, what is left?" Fang Yuan murmured, his gaze dark as night.

"Challenge the blood hall again? No, your mind would be haunted by Gao Yang and Zhu Zai. Seek help? Who could help you now? Hei Lou Lan? You've surely fallen out with him. Besides, even if you obtained the lifespan Gu, could you use it with peace of mind?"

"Hehe, what options do you have left? Denying yourself, wallowing in self-pity, and drowning in grief—as someone undergoing a trial of conscience, what choices remain?"

"So make your choice—don't let me down!" In the shadows, Fang Yuan's eyes shone as he watched the deranged Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Pitiful person.

Since some time ago, a mild wind had started blowing.

The wind gradually grew stronger as clouds gathered in the sky.

"You did not disappoint me after all..." Thrilled, Fang Yuan turned and vanished without a trace.

Soon, the wind and clouds went wild, as heaven and earth changed!

Thick, looming black clouds looked ready to collapse at any moment and crush the sacred palace.

"Investigate, find out who it is!" Hei Lou Lan roared furiously inside the hall.

"Lord, it's Tai Bai Yun Sheng!" Drenched in sweat, Hei Shu stumbled into the hall to report.

Breaths later, he snapped back and shouted with a twisted expression: "Retreat! Evacuate everyone from the sacred palace. Anyone wishing to die can stay!"

# Chapter 606: Awakening

A formless heavenly power slowly lifted Tai Bai Yun Sheng into the air.

He laughed maniacally, white beard fluttering in the wind, his usual warmth and benevolence replaced by a wild, distorted expression.

The first step of immortal ascension was shattering the aperture.

"I provoked Tai Bai Yun Sheng into risking advancement with a crumbling psyche. This is good; though I've read about immortal ascension, I wanted to witness it firsthand. His ascension will provide a great reference for me. Still... if he fails, so be it, but if he actually becomes a Gu Immortal, how should I treat him?"

Fang Yuan observed the scene mounted on an azure wolf king, surrounded by an azure wolf pack.

Using luck inspection Gu again, he saw Tai Bai Yun Sheng's luck burning like wildfire. What had been a rising reddish glow had now grown into a flourishing, blazing inferno!

"His luck is blazing, and having succeeded in my previous life, ascending should pose no issue now." Fang Yuan nodded inwardly.

Having shattered his aperture, Tai Bai Yun Sheng drew vast amounts of heaven and earth qi. Using Gu worms within this zone would trigger a violent qi backlash.

Forcibly activating Gu in this area would injure or even destroy Immortal Gu, not to mention mortal Gu.

For this reason, Fang Yuan never considered using Gu worms to plot against Tai Bai Yun Sheng now.

In an instant, the sky's dark clouds surged into a giant vortex.

In response, yellow-brown dust churned on the ground, forming a matching vortex like a whirlpool.

Like grinding millstones, the dark clouds showered a clear, bright aura, while the dust below released a golden glow.

And Tai Bai Yun Sheng's body released a white human qi.

This dense human qi formed a cocoon-like sphere that tightly enveloped Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Heaven, earth, and human qi converged and began fusing.

"First step: breaking the aperture. Second step: absorbing the qi," Hei Lou Lan murmured.

"Breaking the aperture is a point of no return; survival lies only in success, while failure brings doom. Absorbing qi tests the Gu Master's control and temperament. This step is crucial, like walking a tightrope between cliffs. If human qi is slightly in excess, it triggers self-detonation! If heaven qi dominates, the Gu Master dissolves into the sky! If earth qi is slightly denser, the Gu Master petrifies and suffocates! Hard, truly difficult!" Ye Lui Sang lamented, shaking his head as his heart trembled at the sight.

Heaven and earth qi struck the body as the three qi converged—a mortal blending with heaven and earth.

As the cornerstones nurturing all life, the resonance between heaven and earth qi filled the Gu Master's mind with the Great Dao's wonders.

Experiencing the Great Dao was a rare opportunity where a Gu Master could easily lose themselves, inevitably triggering an imbalance among the three qi.

The more heaven and earth qi absorbed, the greater the chances of becoming a Gu Immortal. Yet greed often tempted Gu Masters to take in too much, destabilizing the three qi and bringing demise.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng did not disappoint, steadily controlling the three qi and progressing with careful composure.

As the aurora shook, Eighty-Eight True Yang Building violently trembled. Its foundation, the sacred palace, quaked as dust rose and courtyards collapsed.

"Hmph, right on time." Fang Yuan sneered, having anticipated this.

Inside the True Yang Building, the land spirit was furious!

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's ascension consumed heaven and earth qi. But rather than the outside northern plains, this was Imperial Court blessed land, an isolated small world.

Depleting this small world's heaven and earth qi directly weakened the blessed land, draining the very source of the land spirit's strength.

Imprisoned for countless years, it had finally seen hope for freedom.

Fearing Giant Sun's will, the land spirit had planned to wait until Gruel Mud corroded its shackles before breaking free in one decisive strike.

Now that Tai Bai Yun Sheng was ascending, he was not only draining the land spirit's strength, but would inevitably awaken Giant Sun's will, dashing its hopes entirely.

With no choice left, it made a swift decision to strike while Giant Sun's will still hibernated, giving the will no time to prepare!

Inside True Yang Building, the land spirit Frost Jade Peacock cried out loudly.

Its struggle was remarkably effective—the green paste melted below its neck, and five or six black chains snapped!

"Huh?"

A faint murmur, as if rousing from a dream, echoed from the depths of True Yang Building.

"Who dares awaken me from my slumber?" From the infinite darkness, a colossal sun-like will slowly stirred.

Starting as a faint glimmer, it blazed brightly enough to pierce the underworld, sweeping across every corner of True Yang Building.

Fang Yuan's will in the guest halt stele was instantly wiped out without defense, while the glass owner token in his grip grew scalding hot!

# Chapter 607: Ambushing Giant Sun’s will

A sun-like will surged through the glass owner token, assaulting Fang Yuan's mind.

Wills were formed from condensed thoughts; if Giant Sun's will eroded his mind, Fang Yuan would likely become a demented amnesiac.

"This is bad! Throw away that damned owner token!" Mo Yao's will screamed in his mind.

"No need to worry," he sneered, unconcerned and fully prepared as he activated special will Gu.

Fueled by primeval essence, special will Gu flashed into Fang Yuan's mind, blocking Giant Sun's will.

Special will Gu unleashed strong suction, relentlessly devouring Giant Sun's will like an ant swallowing an elephant without facing resistance.

"This is..." Mo Yao's will froze before realizing, "So Giant Sun's will was a special will!"

Special will could be arranged in advance to trigger automatically under specific conditions.

Anticipating future dangers for his descendants, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had chosen special will Gu to place a will of himself inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

From his previous life's memories, he knew Giant Sun's will was a special will.

The glass owner token was part of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. Giant Sun's will attacked Fang Yuan through it, but as a passage, it was too narrow, allowing only a strand of his will through.

The strand devoured by special will Gu was negligible compared to Giant Sun's will in True Yang Building.

Falling for Fang Yuan's scheme, Giant Sun's will raged: "Swindler, you dared profane my, Giant Sun's, honor! I will crush you to pieces!"

True Yang Building shook, radiating brilliant lights across the sky as a peerless power manifested, shaking heaven and earth.

Though the deceased Giant Sun Immortal Venerable could not mobilize Eighty-Eight True Yang Building with mere will, he had left behind a vast store of rank nine yellow apricot immortal essence inside.

"There's no hurry." Though calamity loomed, Fang Yuan remained indifferent and relaxed.

Created by expending an Immortal Gu upon an owner token base, it was a key meticulously prepared by Central Continent's forces over millennia.

"Still causing trouble after death, hmph, what era are we living in now!" Fang Yuan snorted, fearlessly launching an ambush through the glass owner token.

Everything came to an abrupt stop.

Inside True Yang Building, Giant Sun's will howled in fury as countless special will Gu besieged it.

Coordinated alongside the special will Gu, other shocking methods sealed all the yellow apricot immortal essence Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had left behind.

Deprived of immortal essence, True Yang Building immediately halted. Though seething with rage, Giant Sun's will had no instant countermeasure and fell into a predicament.

True Yang Building sank into deathly stillness as Fang Yuan put his mind at rest.

In his previous life, central continent's Gu Immortals relied on this method to slay Giant Sun's will and destroy Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

With True Yang Building falling completely still, everyone's attention soon shifted back to Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Floating between sky and ground, Tai Bai Yun Sheng continually absorbed heaven and earth qi, merging them with his human qi.

The balanced three qi poured into the space where his aperture had once been.

Possessing an intact Gu Immortal inheritance, Tai Bai Yun Sheng understood the key requirements and had stabilized the process without major hindrance so far.

Unlike the vast heaven and earth qi, human qi originated solely from Tai Bai Yun Sheng himself.

Over time, heaven and earth qi accumulated and condensed across sky and ground, their vast quantity triggering a qualitative change.

"Tai Bai Yun Sheng drew in so much heaven and earth qi that the excess is condensing into calamity and tribulation!" Ye Lui Sang gasped.

Dense golden earth qi condensed into a one-horned great tiger, while green heaven qi formed countless boat-sized willow leaves.

"This is the earthly calamity lofty tiger and the heavenly tribulation willow wind!" Fang Yuan's gaze sharpened.

Imperial Court land spirit, however, laughed loudly: "The opportunity to break free from my captivity has appeared!"

# Chapter 608: Giant Sun’s retaliation

Inside True Yang Building.

The land spirit strained with all its might against its seal.

Three soft explosive sounds echoed in succession as three black chains binding it snapped.

"Little sparrow, you dare!" Giant Sun's will raged.

"Giant Sun, though dead, you still imprisoned me for hundreds of thousands of years. Today, I will definitely break out of your damn cage!" Frost Jade Peacock shrieked in fury.

Giant Sun's will roared as his sun-like will flared, surging in all directions like a majestic golden flood.

Giant Sun's special will was initially contained by the special will Gu like an unyielding dam. But within breaths, the Gu swallowed his will past their limits and began bursting one by one.

Freed from besiegement, Giant Sun's will immediately moved to control True Yang Building.

Yet the next moment, fifty thousand more special will Gu swarmed in, forming a new encirclement!

Central Continent's Gu Immortals had prepared thoroughly without underestimating Giant Sun's will. Because special will Gu was not an Immortal Gu, its numbers could be amassed without limit.

Soon, a third wave of special will Gu surrounded him, numbering over a hundred thousand!

As an Immortal Venerable's will, Giant Sun possessed intellect and could reason.

Realizing he had walked into a well-prepared trap, he regained his composure.

Deducing rapidly, he soon discovered a flaw in the encirclement!

Such vast numbers of special will Gu required immense energy. Pondering briefly, Giant Sun's will realized they were fueled not by primeval essence, but immortal essence!

This immortal essence was well-hidden; supporting Gu worms clearly coordinated with the special will Gu to form a vast, concealed Gu formation.

"As long as I sever their connection to the immortal essence, these special will Gu pose no threat," Giant Sun's will deduced.

To sever that link, however, he first had to unravel the Gu formation.

The land spirit naturally refused to sit and wait for death.

Sensing Giant Sun's will suppressed, it mustered all its strength to break its seals.

Gruel Mud proved terrifyingly effective against the seals; the green paste cracked and melted away as four more black shackles on its wings shattered in succession.

Though only three chains remained, they still tightly bound its freedom.

"Break them!" Frost Jade Peacock craned its elegant neck, its sharp brows flashing with chilling light.

But Giant Sun's will was powerless to stop the land spirit at this moment.

At this moment, outside the True Yang Building....

The world shook as the hill-sized lofty tiger leaped, slamming massive claws down toward the minuscule Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng gave a light shout and dodged quickly!

Meanwhile, willow winds fluttered down from the sky.

Bathed in blood, Tai Bai Yun Sheng watched the willow winds warily; carelessly touching three earlier had already destroyed all his defensive Gu.

Seeing them descend again, he scrambled to evade.

With the malevolent tiger pouncing from below and willow winds drifting from above, Tai Bai Yun Sheng was soon overwhelmed, battered and facing mortal danger.

Even Fang Yuan grew tense: "Is Tai Bai Yun Sheng going to fail his Gu Immortal ascension in this life?"

Disregarding potential backlash, Fang Yuan forcibly activated luck inspection Gu; Tai Bai Yun Sheng's luck still raged like boiling water, blooming fiercely.

Yet the next instant, a quarter of that flaming luck abruptly vanished!

"What's going on?" It was the first time Fang Yuan was seeing such a change in luck.

Just then, a pillar of light erupted from True Yang Building.

Pierced by the light pillar, the willow winds crumbled back into pure, warm heaven qi.

Under the light's touch, the earthly calamity lofty tiger shrank until it vanished into thin air.

Divert disaster Gu was a cornerstone of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and one of the few methods Giant Sun's will could presently deploy.

Giant Sun's will's actions did not stop at this.

Having forcibly extracted a trace of yellow apricot immortal essence, Giant Sun's will followed divert disaster Gu by activating the human qi Immortal Gu in true inheritance secluded domain.

Before Fang Yuan's eyes, Tai Bai Yun Sheng's burning luck shrank by another quarter.

The activated human qi Immortal Gu radiated a similar beam of white light.

Human qi Immortal Gu could bolster a Gu Master's human qi and raise their future potential. With its aid, Tai Bai Yun Sheng's human qi swelled tenfold!

With more human qi, he naturally required vastly more heaven and earth qi.

However, heaven qi and earth qi were drawn out of Imperial Court blessed land.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng laughed heartily, seizing the building's help to absorb vast heaven and earth qi to fuse the three elements, neutralizing danger while elevating his potential.

The land spirit Frost Jade Peacock shrieked in fury.

The massive drain of heaven and earth qi left it intensely weakened.

"Little sparrow, you are still too green," Giant Sun's will snorted, having spent his extracted immortal essence where it yielded maximum effect to defuse the crisis.

The land spirit's weakening bought Giant Sun's will ample time to analyze the surrounding Gu formation. Once he broke the encirclement and regained control, undoing the seal on his immortal essence would be effortless.

Through the glass owner token, Fang Yuan realized he had less than half the expected time left: "This is bad, I still underestimated an Immortal Venerable's will."

His heart sank: "Now, I can only put my hopes in Tai Bai Yun Sheng. Hopefully, he can quickly become a Gu Immortal and refine landscape as before Gu..."

# Chapter 609: Better to die than not be free

At the center, the three qi were fusing.

All his injuries vanished completely as his body, soul, and consciousness were refined to a higher plane.

The Great Dao's mysteries flowed through his mind, resolving long-standing cultivation bottlenecks.

He focused intently on time path, refining and deepening his comprehension.

"Such a beautiful experience, but my human qi is not sufficient..." Unable to remain immersed, Tai Bai Yun Sheng wore a regretful expression.

The qi cocoon dispersed, revealing Tai Bai Yun Sheng's silhouette once more.

The three qi merged and condensed into a ball of tri-colored primordial qi where his aperture had originally been.

Grave and solemn, Tai Bai Yun Sheng took out River as Before, Mountain as Before, and Man as Before Gu.

"Finally, the most crucial moment..." Tai Bai Yun Sheng sent his vital Gu into the mass of tri-colored primordial qi within him.

BOOM!

The circulating tri-colored qi mass ignited and detonated violently when Man As Before entered.

The mortal aperture shattered; an immortal aperture was formed!

The immortal aperture formed a world of crystal-azure skies and desolate yellow stones.

Heaven and earth qi poured madly into Tai Bai Yun Sheng, rushing non-stop into the immortal aperture.

Inside the immortal aperture, the land rapidly expanded past two thousand square kilometers.

The flow of time accelerated from one-to-one to one-to-ten, one-to-twenty...

Tai Bai Yun Sheng sent in River As Before and Mountain As Before, stabilizing the situation.

Having reached its limit as if gorged to capacity, the immortal aperture abruptly halted its growth.

Heaven and earth qi converged into the immortal aperture, filling it with green and golden clouds and mists.

The dense qi flow condensed beads of immortal essence within.

These were the green grape immortal essence of a rank six Gu Immortal, thirty-six in total.

Yet the misty heaven and earth qi within the immortal aperture had not dissipated.

They condensed around Man As Before, River As Before, Mountain As Before, and other Gu worms, forming dense qi cocoons over them.

Within the qi cocoons, mysterious changes began fermenting in each Gu worm.

"It is time." A Gu recipe flashed in Tai Bai Yun Sheng's mind.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng could not guarantee whether this theoretical Gu recipe could succeed.

But he no longer had another option.

His lifespan was nearly exhausted. After ascending to a Gu Immortal, his senses reached a new realm—especially his perception of time, now precise to a single breath.

Now, his only hope was in man as before Gu.

According to the theoretical recipe, advancing Man as Before Gu to rank six would allow it to be used on oneself.

These thoughts poured into the immortal aperture, entering the thick cocoon around Man as Before Gu.

Entering the cocoon, the thoughts immediately triggered a violent transformation.

The cocoon relentlessly swallowed the immortal aperture's remaining heaven and earth qi.

Becoming the eye of the storm, Man as Before Gu absorbed vast heaven and earth qi as refinement resources.

"This is it, this is it..." Tai Bai Yun Sheng murmured in the air, filled with gratification and anticipation.

After immense effort and peril, he was finally seeing the hope of success.

"Giant Sun Immortal Venerable forbade Gu Immortals from entering, a taboo I violated by ascending here. Why would his will help me?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng was puzzled.

Inside True Yang Building, Frost Jade Peacock shrieked as the green paste on its body convulsed and its iron chains clattered against each other.

Giant Sun's will laughed brightly: "Little sparrow, your struggle is of no use."

Through Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Giant Sun's will cleverly struck at the Imperial Court land spirit, weakening its foundation.

"I won't let you have your way even if I die!!!" Hearing 'standing tall for hundreds of thousands of years', all the feathers on Frost Jade Peacock stood on end.

Formed from obsessions and exceptionally proud, Frost Jade Peacock refused to yield in the slightest.

Yet Frost Jade Peacock ceased struggling and dispiritedly lay down, though its knife-sharp gaze remained filled with hatred.

Giant Sun's will froze before realizing something and roaring in fury: "Little sparrow, you dare to do this!"

"The tribulation clouds and calamity dust are dispersing—has Lord Tai Bai Yun Sheng succeeded in becoming a Gu Immortal?" The ignorant onlookers grew excited.

"To think Tai Bai Yun Sheng reached the third step! His immortal aperture has formed—I wonder what grade of blessed land it is?" Ye Lui Sang muttered.

"Blessed lands are graded small, medium, and large; the more heaven, earth, and human qi are fused, the higher the grade. High grade blessed lands span four and two-thirds to six thousand square kilometers, draw a large tributary of the River of Time, form over thirty immortal essence beads, and retain abundant heaven and earth qi to refine a mortal Gu into an Immortal Gu!"

'If Tai Bai Yun Sheng becomes a Gu Immortal, what stance should I take with him?' Hei Lou Lan pondered.

'Tai Bai Yun Sheng will surely obtain a high grade blessed land, but refining an Immortal Gu risks spawning calamities and tribulations in his aperture.' Fang Yuan's gaze flickered.

"Huh?" Fang Yuan suddenly looked at the sky.

Pitch-black scars appeared across the golden sky, letting specks of starlight shine through.

This was the night sky of the northern plains outside.

The tribulation clouds recondensed as massive heaven and earth qi poured relentlessly into Tai Bai Yun Sheng's aperture.

Fang Yuan's mind shook as he looked toward True Yang Building: "Draining so much heaven and earth qi damaged the blessed land's foundation, exposing northern plains!"

Frost Jade Peacock was so proud it would rather die than remain suppressed by Giant Sun's will.

# Chapter 610: The key to victory and loss

"In the past, the land spirit could never cause such trouble. But Giant Sun's will just awakened, caught off guard and forced to waste time resolving this mess. Meanwhile, Gruel Mud drastically weakened the seal, allowing the land spirit to struggle so violently."

Thinking of this, Fang Yuan directed his gaze towards Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's expression was ashen.

"Why is a heavenly tribulation still forming?! My inheritance never mentioned this!" He was shocked and furious.

Not only outside, but another tribulation and calamity were simultaneously forming inside his immortal aperture!

Sacrificing its foundation to extract heaven and earth qi, its goal was to spawn tribulations that would destroy Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Immortal Gu — Divert Disaster!

Tai Bai Yun Sheng's previously burning fiery red luck had shrunken noticeably.
