After a pause, he continued: "Beyond him, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Bian Si Xuan, and others are also suspicious. This scheme runs deep, involving forces from Central Continent! According to our information, at least three ancient sects from Central Continent have plotted against Eighty-Eight True Yang Building for the last century!"

"The priority now is not investigating, but finding a way to salvage the situation! Fierce as this wind veil of assimilation is, it might not destroy Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. We will stay and await a chance to help, while watching for contingencies."

"Lord Tong Zu is right. Our Chanyu tribe has the immortal killer move Winged Blade; activating it together will forcefully breach the wind veil of assimilation," the young Gu Immortal said with obvious pride.

"Do not underestimate the winds of assimilation; even with Winged Blade, we have only one shot. By my deductions, any wound we inflict on the wind veil will heal in just eight breaths," the elderly wisdom path Gu Immortal warned.

The leader, Chanyu Tong Zu, nodded slightly: "Right now, righteous path super tribes like Hei, Ye Lui, and Dong Fang have sent their Gu Immortals to surround the wind veil. Snowy Mountain, the top demonic faction, has also sent six Gu Immortals to profit from the chaos. They have trump cards too; when using Winged Blade, we must prevent them from taking advantage."

"The luck path true inheritance cannot fall to the otherworldly demon! All of this is mine, mine!" Giant Sun's will shouted, his voice echoing across the battlefield.

Over ten Immortal Gu were embedded across the dragon's body: two on its horns, one in each eye, and six or seven among its scales.

Prioritizing the elimination of the otherworldly demon and the vital luck path true inheritance, Giant Sun's will surrounded Ma and Zhao first.

Swarms of formless hands enveloped the luck path true inheritance, occasionally flying off as fists with captured luck path Gu.

Virtually immune to attacks and piercing through all obstacles, formless hands were invulnerable until they clenched into fists after stealing Gu, becoming susceptible to attack.

"Damn it..." Fang Yuan gritted his teeth in frustration, lacking any way to break free.

"Thankfully, Giant Sun's will targeted the otherworldly demon Zhao Lian Yun and protecting the luck path true inheritance first instead of me."

Fang Yuan knew full well that once Giant Sun's will resolved that crisis, he would not let him off.

"Giant Sun's will cannot activate so many Immortal Gu alone. Even as a Gu Immortal, I am no match for him head-on—unless I sever his connection to Giant Sun's immortal essence!"

Unfortunately, the sheer volume of formless hands demanded all his effort just to survive.

Meanwhile, Hei Lou Lan's continuous attacks posed another major problem.

As Fang Yuan dodged, he heard Tai Bai Yun Sheng cry out: "Junior brother, save me!"

Eventually, his Gu worms were all taken away.

Without the support of his Gu worms, even as a Gu Immortal, he began plummeting toward the ground.

As his only ally, Fang Yuan could not abandon Tai Bai Yun Sheng yet.

Fang Yuan immediately turned, taking the risk to save him.

Just then, Tai Bai Yun Sheng shouted anxiously: "Quick, junior brother, reclaim my Immortal Gu Man as Before!"

Fang Yuan's heart jumped as he saw a six-fingered formless fist flying away.

# Chapter 636: Shocking Change

At this instant, Fang Yuan hesitated.

As Tai Bai Yun Sheng had explained, as a mortal Gu it restored a Gu Master's past state; as an Immortal Gu, it could affect others and its user alike.

Since Tai Bai Yun Sheng was a Gu Immortal, it was easy to deduce that Man as Before worked on Gu Immortals as well!

As a Gu capable of healing Gu Immortals, Man as Before's value was immense, far surpassing ordinary Immortal Gu!

If Fang Yuan abandoned him to pursue Man as Before, Tai Bai Yun Sheng would be in grave danger.

Though immortal ascension qualitatively changed a Gu Master's life essence, falling from such a height would gravely injure Tai Bai Yun Sheng even if he survived.

"Reclaiming Man as Before will take time. Even if I succeed, what if it creates a rift between Tai Bai Yun Sheng and me?"

"Had I kept Fixed Immortal Travel it would be fine, but without it and with the contracting wind veil isolating us, I must use a stargate to connect to Hu Immortal blessed land!"

Opening the stargate required starlight firefly Gu.

The moment starlight firefly Gu appeared, formless hands would swarm like flies; even as a Gu Immortal, Fang Yuan had no confidence in protecting them.

"Now that the wind veil has cut off heaven and earth qi, no new formless hands will spawn despite their numbers. Furthermore, with Eighty-Eight True Yang Building dissolving into wild Gu worms..."

Lacking an energy source, the formless hands could not be sustained.

"Once the formless hands weaken, Giant Sun's will will be the strongest force here. After eliminating Ma and Zhao and reclaiming the luck path true inheritance, he will come after me!"

In this entire battlefield, Tai Bai Yun Sheng was the only suitable person.

Moving like lightning, Fang Yuan flew without hesitation toward the falling Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

"Junior brother, you... sigh!" Calming down, Tai Bai Yun Sheng watched with shining eyes, deeply touched yet reduced to a sigh.

Right at this moment, a figure suddenly appeared beside Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

"Old fool, you've finally fallen into my hands!" The figure solidified into Hei Lou Lan, who seized Tai Bai Yun Sheng by the collar.

Hei Lou Lan quickly activated a Gu worm, sealing Tai Bai Yun Sheng's limbs and knocking him unconscious.

Before Hei Lou Lan could raise his head and speak, Fang Yuan had already wheeled around and shot into the sky.

"Hei Lou Lan captured Tai Bai Yun Sheng obviously to extort that Gu worm from me!" Fang Yuan instantly deduced his intention.

With such an objective, Hei Lou Lan would not harm Tai Bai Yun Sheng's life, leaving him safe for now.

In that case, Fang Yuan's most important task was to retrieve the Immortal Gu Man as Before!

Dodging formless hands with intensely flapping wings, Fang Yuan alternated wind flower Gu and flash bug Gu. After fifteen minutes of arduous effort, he shattered the formless fist and reclaimed the Immortal Gu Man as Before.

"Your senior brother's life is in my hands, quickly return my Gu worm!" Hei Lou Lan finally caught up to threaten him.

With Tai Bai Yun Sheng captive, Fang Yuan's actions were heavily restricted.

Although he held the Immortal Gu Man as Before, Tai Bai Yun Sheng had not granted him permission to use it. Had he been able to, even if Hei Lou Lan killed the captive, Fang Yuan could have revived him with Man as Before.

A Gu that made Hei Lou Lan so anxious was surely extraordinary; Fang Yuan was unwilling to return it just like that.

Most importantly, Hei Lou Lan was not trustworthy!

As time passed, Giant Sun's will and the formless hands' battle intensified.

Supported by the luck path true inheritance light lump while battling formless hands, he regained control of the sole copy of the luck path true inheritance.

The true inheritance held an astonishing number of Gu; in moments, six luck path Immortal Gu were already snatched by formless hands.

Giant Sun's will shattered formless fists to retrieve three of the six Immortal Gu, but could only watch as the remaining three were carried away.

"Damn it! Too hateful!" Giant Sun's will grew increasingly furious as he fought. Hating Zhao Lian Yun to his core, he no longer cared about Ma Hong Yun's life.

Had he not been constrained by protecting the luck path true inheritance, he would have destroyed the light lump and killed Ma and Zhao.

Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan were locked in a slow, bargaining stalemate, deeply distrustful of each other.

Just then, the sound of a blade echoed from outside the wind veil.

Above them, a huge opening had been sliced through the wind veil of assimilation.

Through the slash, everyone could see the sky of Northern Plains.

Reacting even faster than the humans were the Gu worms!

Now ownerless and ruined by tribulations, Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's collapsed walls turned into countless wild Gu worms.

Guided by instinct, the Gu worms swarmed toward the opening.

"Ah! So many Gu worms from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building!" Northern Plains Gu Immortals watched with burning, shining eyes.

# Chapter 637: Huge Shocking Change

With an opening cut through the wind veil to Northern Plains, the frenzy of Gu worms rushed frantically toward the gap.

"Over twenty Gu Immortals... they must have used the immortal killer move Winged Blade."

This sudden development was unexpected, but to Fang Yuan, it offered no escape.

Having harmed Giant Sun's will and caused the collapse of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and Imperial Court blessed land, he was the main culprit! If caught outside by the furious Northern Plains Gu Immortals, even death would be a luxury.

Yet Hei Lou Lan's gaze remained undistracted, fixed firmly on Fang Yuan.

Just then, a choppy voice transmitted from above the wind veil: "Hei Lou Lan... my son... father is here... to bring you back..."

It was Hei Lou Lan's father, supreme elder of the Hei tribe—Hei Cheng!

Floating in the air and collecting Gu worms, he called out anxiously: "Don't worry... father... has found the strength path Immortal Gu for you..."

Hei Lou Lan merely snorted coldly at his father's call.

Ignoring Hei Cheng's words, his anger flared into an expression of pure hatred.

Fueled by vengeful intent, he growled at Fang Yuan: "My patience is wearing thin! Hand over my Gu worm, or I will kill your senior brother!"

Fang Yuan had to save Tai Bai Yun Sheng, his only useful ally against Giant Sun's will.

Fang Yuan shouted back: "I'll give you the Gu, but wake my senior brother first and let him retreat a thousand steps!"

Hei Lou Lan instantly refused: "Impossible! Hand over the Gu first, or I'll crush his skull!"

Fang Yuan looked up, his heart sinking: "Oh no... formless hands vanish after capturing Gu. As their numbers dwindle, Giant Sun's will will soon regain full control!"

As a special will, exterminating the otherworldly demon was Giant Sun's highest priority, even above survival.

The will dragon roared, ignoring the exit above as it coiled around the luck path true inheritance.

"Are we going to die?!" Seeing the luck path inheritance's protective light thin drastically, Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun felt hopeless.

The true inheritance lump suddenly erupted with dazzling, blinding brilliance.

With a whoosh, the inheritance lump carried Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun upward like a rainbow, charging toward the opening in the wind veil.

"Don't even think about it!" Giant Sun's will dragon roared furiously, giving chase without hesitation!

Seeing the inheritance about to escape into Northern Plains, Giant Sun's will cast aside all hesitation, determined to exterminate the otherworldly demon Zhao Lian Yun!

Infusing immortal essence into a dozen Immortal Gu, the will dragon shone brightly, its lethal attacks primed within three breaths.

Suddenly, another true inheritance lump emerged from among the Gu worms!

Sized like an adult human, this was a supreme true inheritance!

The haloed supreme true inheritance crashed fiercely into Giant Sun's will dragon.

Under the halo's influence, Giant Sun's will rapidly expanded and detonated like firecrackers.

Severed in two, the dragon's primed Immortal Gu attacks were forcibly disrupted.

"Rank nine wisdom Gu!" Fang Yuan's expression was unchanging, but his heart jumped.

Basking in its light, thoughts collided and perished rapidly amidst sparks of wisdom.

"Wisdom Gu possesses a wild will and was hiding all along. With the wind veil breached, it stayed silent until now to strike and escape!" Fang Yuan realized.

"This alone cannot defeat Giant Sun's will, unless..." Enduring the piercing light, Fang Yuan looked up with eagle-sharp eyes.

Nearly a hundred beads of immortal essence were tumbling from the sky.

These were rank nine yellow apricot immortal essence!

# Chapter 638: Unfilial Descendants

Immortal Gu required immortal essence to activate; a will alone could not power them, and Giant Sun's will was no exception.

Yet wisdom Gu's strike severed the will dragon in two, exposing the Giant Sun immortal essence it was holding.

"As expected of wisdom Gu! Such results in a single strike!" Fang Yuan's eyes shone with inward praise.

As a rank nine Immortal Gu, wisdom Gu had no fear of the eight-fingered formless hands present.

Heavily damaged, Giant Sun's will roared in fury!

Yet instead of attacking wisdom Gu, it relentlessly chased the luck path true inheritance holding Ma and Zhao.

Condensing into a giant golden hand, Giant Sun's will hurtled toward Ma and Zhao like a meteor.

Just as the luck path true inheritance was about to enter the wind veil, the giant hand blocked its path.

"None of you can escape, die!" The giant hand clamped down, ignoring the inheritance to kill Ma and Zhao.

Boom!

Powerful attacks hailed down, ruthlessly battering the giant hand of Giant Sun's will.

"You unfilial descendants!!" Giant Sun's will roared in fury as the giant hand collapsed.

Carrying Ma and Zhao, the luck path true inheritance flew through the wind veil into Northern Plains.

The greedy righteous path Gu Immortals had no idea whose will it was—and even if they knew, they would never let it destroy the Immortal Gu.

Leading them was an old Gu Immortal whose snow-white beard reached his toes.

The righteous path Gu Immortals narrowed their eyes in recognition as someone gasped: "Old Ancestor Xue Hu, you came in person!"

Old Ancestor Xue Hu was Snowy Mountain blessed land's leader, a rank eight expert and Northern Plains' number one demonic immortal!

"Imperial Court blessed land is collapsing, of course I've come to reap benefits! Strike!" Old Ancestor Xue Hu shouted, leading his group into the fray.

As righteous and demonic factions clashed, the luck path true inheritance changed hands repeatedly, leaving Ma and Zhao hovering on the brink of death.

As the gap in the wind veil closed, that Hei Lou Lan didn't seize the chance to escape the wind veil shocked Fang Yuan.

He fixed his gaze on Giant Sun's falling immortal essence.

"I can't use it, but seizing it will reduce Giant Sun's strength to twenty or thirty percent!" Fang Yuan soared upward, frantically activating movement Gu.

"You dare!!" Attacked by descendants and sensing Fang Yuan's intent, Giant Sun's will was both furious and anxious.

"Damn it, it's too late!" Recondensing into a giant hand, the will plunged down like a meteor.

"Hahaha!" Fang Yuan laughed heartily, barely a hundred steps from Giant Sun's immortal essence.

For between them stood rank nine wisdom Gu!

Wind howling past, Giant Sun's immortal essence was within reach!

# Chapter 639: Giant Sun flaunts his might, Fang Yuan receives help

Wisdom Gu descended rapidly, shrouding Fang Yuan in wisdom's light.

Entering the wisdom halo, Fang Yuan's thoughts clashed violently as he aged rapidly.

"This?!" Shocked, Fang Yuan looked up to see wisdom Gu descending straight toward him.

Knowing a detour would fail, Giant Sun's will approached wisdom Gu and knocked it toward Fang Yuan.

Enduring wisdom's light, Fang Yuan swept away all of Giant Sun's falling immortal essence!

He then activated wind flower Gu to veer aside, trying to escape wisdom Gu.

Escaping wisdom's light, Fang Yuan coughed violently, his youthful face withered into that of a middle-aged man.

Proximity to wisdom Gu and prolonged exposure to its light had cost him over ten years of lifespan.

"Little scoundrel, die!" Giant Sun's will swooped down like lightning, pouncing like an eagle.

Assaulted by mortal danger, Fang Yuan barely had time to activate six arm heavenly zombie king.

Bam!

Crashing like a meteor, he slammed into the ground, forming a huge crater.

Six of his eight arms were broken, and his mangled back exposed his spine and ribs. Dizzy and barely able to think, an invasion of special will began destroying his cognition.

He sprawled motionless on the ground, bones and mangled flesh exposed, deep green blood flowing from his wounds.

Only by purging the invading will from his mind could he regain consciousness.

Yet Giant Sun's will gave him no such chance.

It condensed into a sixteen-meter-long, six-meter-wide golden sword radiating an indomitable aura that could judge all beings.

"Is this Giant Sun's true battle strength? Terrifying..." Hei Lou Lan muttered in shock, holding the unconscious Tai Bai Yun Sheng.

Hei Lou Lan quickly calmed down: "No, the will isn't this strong. Ancestor Giant Sun simply struck at the perfect moment while he was off-guard. The scoundrel couldn't retaliate because invading will threw his thoughts into chaos. Had he been prepared with time to react, it wouldn't have ended like this!"

The sword of will hovered directly above Fang Yuan, its tip aimed at his brain.

Without hesitation, the sword of Giant Sun's will plunged silently toward Fang Yuan's head.

Though transformed into a six arm heavenly zombie king, a pierced skull would let Giant Sun's will utterly annihilate his brain and soul.

Yet an inch from Fang Yuan's forehead, a wall of water suddenly materialized.

A woman's shrill voice rang out: "With me here, don't dream of taking his life!"

"Who is that?" Hei Lou Lan gasped as the swirling water halted the descending sword.

Giant Sun's will withdrew the sword, retreating several hundred steps.

Hovering in the air, he recalled and growled: "It's you! Ten thousand years ago, you barged into Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and freed Fortune Rivalling Heaven Gu!"

Mo Yao laughed delicately: "I'm surprised you remember."

With that, the water wall transformed into liquid armor enveloping Fang Yuan.

A light blue glow enveloped Fang Yuan, rapidly mending his broken limbs, bones, and flesh.

Giant Sun's will raged: "Shameless thieves, targeting my True Yang Building for tens of thousands of years! Die!"

The rainbow struck the liquid armor, creating ripples without breaching its protection.

Fang Yuan slowly woke up.

"This is... the rank seven Immortal Gu House Water Pavilion?" Looking at the liquid armor, he realized.

"Lad, you are finally awake. My main body left limited immortal essence, and Water Pavilion consumes too much. Take over the battle quickly; I will defend your mind!" Mo Yao's will said.

# Chapter 640: Fang Yuan vs Giant Sun’s will (1/2)

"Hmph, I escaped death thanks to you, fairy!" Fang Yuan squinted, cold light flashing in his eyes.

"If you want to repay me, return Water Pavilion to Spirit Affinity House." Mo Yao's will sighed: "Quickly battle!"

The water armor contracted into a helmet to protect his head, rendering him safe from mental attacks by Giant Sun's will.

Free of worries, Fang Yuan strode forward and threw his fists at Giant Sun's will!

Avoiding a direct clash, Giant Sun's sword turned into a golden ribbon, coiled around Fang Yuan's wrist, and flashed away.

Severed at the wrist, Fang Yuan's hammer-like fist dropped to the ground.

Green blood oozed as Fang Yuan pressed his severed fist back onto the wound.

The flesh quickly mended and healed, and the bones knit together.

Refusing to grant Fang Yuan time to recover, Giant Sun's will transformed into a rainbow sword and charged again.

Fang Yuan squinted, kicking off the ground and shooting into the air.

"You're making no progress!" Seeing Fang Yuan lose ground, take a beating, and find fewer chances to retaliate, Mo Yao's will grew anxious.

"Easy for you to say!" Fang Yuan snorted, his gaze becoming more ruthless.

Hei Lou Lan laughed heartily, displaying Tai Bai Yun Sheng: "I've captured this old thief, his close senior brother. Our ability is limited, so we can only assist Old Ancestor. My suggestion stands: capture Gu worms first to increase our strength! To cooperate effectively, let's report all the Gu worms we hold! I'll start."

"I've caught you!" Fang Yuan howled, pouncing as his six arms grabbed Giant Sun's sword-shaped will.

But Giant Sun's will instantly split apart, and Fang Yuan's long-awaited counterattack destroyed only a few thoughts.

"We must fight a drawn-out battle," Mo Yao's will said. "Without an energy source, combat will accelerate Giant Sun's thought depletion."

Fang Yuan refused: "We cannot drag this out! Six arm heavenly zombie king only lasts thirty minutes before turning me into a permanent zombie. If I fully transform, both apertures will lose all lifeforce, halting my cultivation forever!"

Mo Yao retorted: "As a strength path Gu Immortal, your life essence changed qualitatively. By my estimate, you have about an hour!"

"Even so, we cannot delay; the wind veil of assimilation is thickening and shrinking our space. My methods cannot counter this special will—does Water Pavilion have any?" Fang Yuan asked.

Mo Yao sighed: "Water Pavilion specializes in concealment and movement, not attack. Most importantly, my main body left only twenty-odd beads of red date immortal essence. After sustaining the house over the years, only five remain. If you hope to turn the tables with Water Pavilion, forget it! Watch out!!"

Giant Sun's will feinted to draw Fang Yuan's focus, then swiftly wheeled behind him with a brutal strike.

Fang Yuan spat green zombie blood as his eagle wings shattered, his spine broke completely, and his chest bulged outward.

Shapeshifting freely, Giant Sun's will slashed, slammed, and pierced until Fang Yuan's eight arms were destroyed, leaving his six arm heavenly zombie king body mangled and riddled with wounds.

# Chapter 641: Fang Yuan vs Giant Sun’s will (2/2)

Fang Yuan crashed heavily, sending rocks flying as the ground trembled.

Helpless to resist, Fang Yuan was saved as Mo Yao reshaped Water Pavilion into liquid armor.

Giant Sun's will stabbed repeatedly, raising huge ripples across the liquid armor.

"Quick, quickly stand up!" Mo Yao's will shouted anxiously.

Gritting his teeth, Fang Yuan pushed up with his remaining left arm and withstood the heavy impacts.

"It's useless! All your immortal essence is in my immortal aperture!" Fang Yuan laughed wildly, trying to break Giant Sun's resolve.

"Dodge quickly, my immortal essence is depleting too fast at this rate!" Mo Yao's will warned frantically.

"No! This is a rare chance!! We have to endure it!" Fang Yuan refused, holding his ground against the barrage: "Even if your immortal essence runs out, you can lend me Water Pavilion—I still have over twenty beads of green grape immortal essence! Giant Sun's will is burning thoughts for power; the thoughts he exhausts will far exceed any damage I could inflict!"

"This..." Mo Yao's will went into deep hesitation.

Just as Hei Lou Lan and the others prepared to strike, Giant Sun's will laughed loudly: "Fang Yuan, you've fallen into my trap!"

Saying this, he retreated quickly.

"What?" Fang Yuan's pupils shrank as a formless hand grabbed toward him.

He shouted in shock: "Seven fingered formless hand!"

Giant Sun's will had feigned reckless attacks to occupy Fang Yuan's attention, secretly baiting this formless hand toward him.

"Quickly dodge it!" Mo Yao's will screamed.

"Too late!" Fang Yuan activated eagle rise Gu, but could not accelerate before the formless hand reached him.

In this crisis, Mo Yao's will sighed gloomily, sending Water Pavilion off Fang Yuan to crash into the seven-fingered formless hand.

The seven-fingered formless hand struck, seizing Water Pavilion's rank seven water harmony Gu.

Its supporting Immortal Gu were the movement Gu Worldly Wave Trace and wisdom path Delight in Water and Mountain.

With its sole core, water harmony Immortal Gu, seized by the formless hand, Water Pavilion instantly collapsed!

The formless fist carried the water harmony Gu and flew into the sky.

"Destroy it!" Mo Yao's will screamed as the remaining three thousand mortal Gu floated around Fang Yuan, carrying red date immortal essence.

Giant Sun's will morphed into a monk's spade and struck, cleaving the swirling swarm around Fang Yuan in two.

"Oh no, my red date immortal essence!" Mo Yao cried in shock; Giant Sun's will had destroyed numerous Gu and seized the immortal essence.

"Mo Yao, enter my aperture!" Fang Yuan shouted, retreating rapidly.

Mo Yao's will swept up the remaining Immortal Gu and plunged into his immortal aperture.

"Quickly lend worldly wave trace Gu to me!" Fang Yuan urged.

Without hesitation, Mo Yao's will replied: "Since I have no immortal essence left, I'll lend them to you!"

He shouted while using one bead of green grape immortal essence, activating Worldly Wave Trace.

A massive wave surged beneath his feet, carrying him away and opening distance from Giant Sun's will.

Giant Sun's will sneered: "Inside this shrinking wind veil of assimilation, run all you want—I will catch you soon enough! Stop struggling! You destroyed Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and ruined Imperial Court blessed land; dreaming of escaping is impossible—you are dead meat!"

Fang Yuan did not dare to fight it!

Without Water Pavilion to guard his brain, any flaw in combat would let Giant Sun's will invade his mind.

# Chapter 642: Thirty-Eight Sealing Arts

"Giant Sun, all your immortal essence is in my immortal aperture. Without it, how can you use Immortal Gu? You cannot breach the wind veil relying on special will alone!" Fang Yuan attempted to negotiate.

"Negotiate?" Giant Sun's will laughed with naked hatred. "Once I kill you, I'll take the immortal essence back from your aperture anyway. Why not try destroying it?"

"Giant Sun's will, I'm standing right here—do you dare come?" Fang Yuan halted, deactivating Worldly Wave Trace.

Giant Sun's will halted hundreds of paces away, not daring to advance.

Fang Yuan stood directly within the light of wisdom.

"Fang Yuan, your lifespan!!" Mo Yao's will warned.

"There's no other way—what else can I do?" Fang Yuan gritted his teeth in bitter helplessness.

Giant Sun's will barked to Hei Lou Lan's group: "Deal with this thief! Force him closer to wisdom Gu so the light burns his lifespan faster!"

Within the light of wisdom, Fang Yuan snorted coldly, maintaining his defensive Gu while unleashing long-range counterattacks.

Light barriers enveloped him, bone shields hovered nearby, and stone walls surged to block the mortals' barrage.

Armed with unlimited primeval essence, he suffered no disadvantage against the mortal Gu Masters.

Breaths later, he appeared above Hei Lou Lan's group, showering them with mortal Gu.

"Take them. I will impart a killer move to you!" Giant Sun's will split, carrying the Gu into their apertures.

"It is a trick conceived in leisure," Giant Sun's will said. "For now, we'll call it Thirty-Eight Sealing Arts."

Hei Lou Lan's group activated the move at once, exhaling rays of purple light qi.

Thirty-eight sealing arts contaminated enemy techniques, sealing all the Gu worms used for them in succession.

After Fang Yuan was struck, his defensive Gu were sealed successively.

Fang Yuan attacked the purple qi directly, sacrificing offensive Gu to preserve his defensive Gu.

If the purple qi touched his zombie king form, it could seal the core Gu and shatter the transformation.

Soon, Fang Yuan's attacks thinned as the mob of Gu Masters pushed him into a disadvantage.

# Chapter 643: Final Trump Card

"Damn it, must I use Spring Autumn Cicada again?" Fang Yuan gritted his teeth, the thought surfacing.

Pressure filled his first aperture, its walls covered in spiderweb-like cracks.

But he quickly dispelled the thought of using Spring Autumn Cicada.

With more Gu sealed and firepower dwindling, Fang Yuan was forced into passive defense.

Mo Yao's will cried out: "Fang Yuan, zombie speckles are appearing! If they spread, you will truly become a six arm heavenly zombie king!"

Though an hour had not yet passed, Fang Yuan's zombification was already beginning.

"If I dispel the move, Giant Sun's will will strike, and I can't react in time!" Fang Yuan remained resolute.

Spreading at accelerating speed, the black speckles soon engulfed Fang Yuan's chest.

Giant Sun's will laughed: "You stayed transformed too long and broke the balance of life and death! Death energy is overtaking you—you will become a true zombie, your cultivation stagnant forever!"

Mo Yao's will urged: "Fang Yuan, the price is too high! Giant Sun's will has little strength left and might not attack. With your talent and ability, you shouldn't end up like this! Stop now before it's too late! Once fully transformed into a six arm heavenly zombie king, reverting to human will be nearly impossible!"

He turned into a six arm heavenly zombie king completely!

The strength path immortal aperture turned pitch-black; white stone mountains collapsed, the sky greyed, and the ground rotted away without a shred of lifeforce.

Deathly silence gripped the first aperture as well; its purple crystal walls lost their luster, turning into dull grey stone.

Yet because of this, Spring Autumn Cicada's pressure became far less threatening.

Even with Fang Yuan's iron will, he felt a bit of desolation.

Fang Yuan did something shocking—he stopped activating all his Gu.

Having become a permanent six arm heavenly zombie king, he no longer needed Gu to sustain the form.

When the purple light qi struck him, thirty-eight sealing arts proved completely ineffective.

Everyone was stunned, even Giant Sun's will gasped lightly.

Fang Yuan backed away, relying on the zombie king's defense and regeneration to weather the onslaught.

He was forced to turn his back to the crowd, taking the brunt of their fierce assault.

But he got up every time.

Only one of his eight arms remained, his zombie blood dyed the ground, organs were exposed, and his right shoulder was reduced to bare bone.

"Why, to this extent? Why..." Mo Yao's will sobbed.

Fang Yuan was silent.

"Enough." Giant Sun's will suddenly spoke.

Not daring to disobey, the Gu Masters ceased their attacks.

"Still not giving up? Your tenacity is admirable," Giant Sun's will said. "Enough, reaching this point was no easy feat. Surrender, and acknowledge me as your master; I will give you a chance to make up for your mistakes."

"Surrender?" Fang Yuan scoffed: "Let me consider it."

Giant Sun's will continued: "You destroyed Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, but if you help rebuild it, you can redeem yourself. Once it is rebuilt, I will grant you freedom and teach you how to regain a human body."

Giant Sun's will chuckled flatly: "I won't give you time to stall. I will count down from ten, and you must answer. Ten!"

"Are you really surrendering? Once you leave the light of wisdom, you'll be at his mercy," Mo Yao's will warned anxiously.

Fang Yuan laughed in his heart: "How could I be so stupid as to believe him?"

Then he sighed: "To think I must still resort to my final trump card."

"You still have a trump card?"

"To speak the truth, I have Spring Autumn Cicada."

"What? Spring Autumn Cicada! Able to travel upstream in the River of Time and alter history?" Mo Yao's will shrieked.

"That's right!"

# Chapter 644: Not committing the same mistake again (1/2)

Fang Yuan snickered internally, asking Mo Yao's will: "You've been wanting me to use it, haven't you?"

"Hmm? Fang Yuan, what do you mean? How would I know that you have Spring Autumn Cicada!" Mo Yao's will stared blankly, before quickly denying it.

"Hehehe…" Fang Yuan laughed. "Mo Yao, I am naturally cautious, considering defeat before victory. The moment you lurked in my mind, I prepared for the worst."

"Namely, that you discovered Spring Autumn Cicada the first time I entered Water Pavilion, right?"

Mo Yao's will manifested in Fang Yuan's mind, shaking her head with apparent sincerity: "Fang Yuan, are you misunderstanding something?"

Fang Yuan continued: "You feigned guilt toward Spirit Affinity House, tasking me with returning Water Pavilion as a red herring."

"To gain my trust, you truly racked your brains. You created six arm heavenly zombie king for me, taught me ink transformation and other refinement path killer moves, helped me infiltrate True Yang Building, and advised me in battle—all to lower my guard. Meanwhile, you secretly altered my thoughts to subconsciously influence my decisions—truly insidious intentions!"

"When I first met Imperial Court blessed land's land spirit, Frost Jade Peacock, I learned its ownership conditions. Those were deeply buried memories of my previous life. It was your doing—you struck secretly, trying to peer into my past-life memories while my mind was in turmoil!"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Hahaha, of course I admit my shortcomings! Compared to you or Giant Sun, my foundation and experience are lacking. But do you know your greatest flaw?"

Ignoring her, Fang Yuan continued: "Your greatest flaw was sending Water Pavilion to charge at the seven fingered formless hand."

She sank into silence.

Fang Yuan continued: "First, concealing Water Pavilion on me proved your plan to control me at a critical moment."

"Second, if you truly intended to cooperate, why hide what kind of will you were? Clearly, exposing your type of will would make me suspicious."

"Third, you gave me the wrong timing so my body would permanently become six arm heavenly zombie king!"

"Fourth, you repeatedly manipulated my thoughts to make me consider using Spring Autumn Cicada. My will is resolute; once I decide, I execute without hesitation. How could I waver like that?"

"Hehehe…" Mo Yao's will laughed loudly. "Fang Yuan, you contradict yourself. I saved your life—without Water Pavilion, Giant Sun's will would have killed you! Now you claim I deliberately harmed you by making six arm heavenly zombie king permanent. Why would I save you only to harm you? Am I crazy?"

"Harming then saving me was all part of your plan. Putting myself in your shoes, your intentions are easily deduced."

Pausing briefly, Fang Yuan continued: "If I were a will lingering for ten thousand years, my main body dead and my lover perished in a failed tribulation, what would I think upon seeing Spring Autumn Cicada?"

"Naturally, I would use Spring Autumn Cicada to travel back in time! Spring Autumn Cicada sacrifices everything the Gu Master has, preserving only their consciousness within the Gu. At the crucial moment, I would enter Spring Autumn Cicada, destroy the Gu Master's will, replace him, and return to the past to revive, alter history, and change my fate!"

"First, as a mere will, you cannot use most Gu worms independently. Spring Autumn Cicada requires even more. It requires the Gu Master to self-detonate, sacrificing their essence, flesh, and other Gu worms as driving force to travel back in time. The stronger the fuel, the further back one can return."

"Second, Spring Autumn Cicada is my vital Gu. You cannot take it by force, especially with my wisdom path wills guarding it."

"Therefore, you had to bide your time. You needed to strengthen me and raise my foundation so my self-detonation would generate greater driving force for Spring Autumn Cicada. Simultaneously, you had to drive me into absolute despair, forcing me to risk everything and activate Spring Autumn Cicada!"

"So when the formless hand almost caught me, you rammed Water Pavilion into it, terrified that Spring Autumn Cicada would be taken or exposed."

Outside, Giant Sun's will had already counted down from ten to six.

Mo Yao broke the silence, clapping with a laugh: "Hehehehe, excellent analysis! You unraveled everything step by step with remarkable clarity. To think my long-planned scheme failed to deceive you. I am truly amazed, lad. Even for a reborn person, your talent is astounding. Had you been born in my era, we might have been friends. What a pity, what a pity."

She sighed: "Back then, my main body risked entering Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and obtained an inheritance in the true inheritance secluded domain, creating this will with it. I betrayed my sect for Bo Qing back then, never expecting you to be the one arriving ten thousand years later."

"I actually discovered your Spring Autumn Cicada when you refined calamity beckoning Gu. As a refinement path grandmaster, I tampered with the refinement so the resulting Gu already contained my will. This trap was originally meant for Spirit Affinity House pursuers, as no one can resist the chance of refining an Immortal Gu."

# Chapter 645: Not committing the same mistake again (2/2)

"Just as you said, discovering Spring Autumn Cicada thrilled me, and I immediately planned to use it for rebirth. I used calamity beckoning Gu to lure you to Water Pavilion. Allowing you to refine ten percent of Water Pavilion was engineered to lower your guard. When you left, I concealed Water Pavilion within your sweat. But how did you confirm it was on you from the start?"

Fang Yuan replied: "To ensure my safety, Water Pavilion was your strongest safeguard. Second, thinking expends thoughts and weakens a will. You exerted yourself creating killer moves without ever weakening. You even contested Giant Sun's will in my mind and helped refine True Yang Building's supreme true inheritance. Even under the light of wisdom, your will never weakened. The only explanation was Water Pavilion replenishing you. When I first inspected Water Pavilion's Gu worms, I failed to realize it. The crucial component is that wisdom path Immortal Gu, delight in water and mountain Gu, right?"

"Hehehe, you are half right," Mo Yao's will admitted. "Delight in water and mountain Gu only creates joyful will, which I converted using other Gu worms. My will can indeed manipulate your thoughts and make you act out of character. Tell me... did you purposely lose to Giant Sun's will?"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Giant Sun's will is strong, but our disparity in battle strength was not so absurdly large. When I awoke to find Water Pavilion armoring me and saving my life, I knew something was wrong. My previous vigilance had gradually vanished under your influence."

"Though suspicious, I couldn't be certain. When Giant Sun's will attacked frenziedly, I deduced his tactic. In this confined battlefield with few outside variables, how could I overlook the formless hands? So I played along, intentionally moving slowly to bait a formless hand into attacking me. In the end, I obtained proof of your ill intentions!"

"Next, even with Water Pavilion shattered, I still feared its power. So I coaxed you into my immortal aperture while borrowing your Gu worms to fight. I intentionally took hits from killer moves to seal most of your borrowed Gu worms, preventing you from using any that require no primeval essence."

"Oh, what is that?"

"Earlier, a six fingered formless hand took Fixed Immortal Travel. I know you desperately wanted to eliminate Fixed Immortal Travel because it disrupted your plans. But how were you certain it would take Fixed Immortal Travel instead of other Immortal Gu, especially Spring Autumn Cicada?"

Mo Yao's will laughed bitterly: "Lad, as a mere will left behind for ten thousand years, do you think I could control everything? In that chaotic moment when the formless hand grabbed you, I hesitated to deploy Water Pavilion lest I arouse your suspicion."

Mo Yao smiled bitterly: "Back then, I sneaked into True Yang Building to seize fortune rivalling heaven Gu but ended up releasing it. My luck has been terrible ever since. When I blocked the seven fingered formless hand, I intended to sacrifice the rank seven calamity beckoning Gu in Water Pavilion—alas, it took the core, water harmony Immortal Gu instead!"

Fang Yuan sighed: "Your plan was like tightrope walking, requiring you to balance the situation at every moment. Had you schemed against me earlier, I might have stayed fooled. Unfortunately, I made a similar mistake right before coming to Northern Plains, and my rule in life is never to repeat a mistake!"

"Wisdom Gu's halo also sharpened my thoughts enough to unravel your scheme. Truly worthy of a rank nine Immortal Gu. After all this, tell me: what type of will are you?"

Mo Yao chuckled: "It is already too late even if you discovered my motive. You will inevitably have to self-detonate with Spring Autumn Cicada! My will is called fake will. Fake and true, reality and illusion—fake will disguises as thoughts, colliding with them to alter conclusions and manipulate decisions and actions."

Fang Yuan realized: "No wonder I couldn't find you lurking in my mind—you disguised yourself as my thoughts! But you are wrong about one thing: I will not use Spring Autumn Cicada."

"Are you sure? Hehehe." Mo Yao's will laughed. "I perfected six arm heavenly zombie king with you and gave false instructions to make the transformation permanent, cutting off your cultivation progress. You have no future left. I know you well after all this time—you have exhausted your trump cards."

"Besides Giant Sun's will, Hei Lou Lan threatens you with his Great Strength True Martial Physique! Imagine the force of his rank five peak self-detonation! You endure only thanks to the light of wisdom. Hahaha, with so many strong foes, you are at your wits end!"

Fang Yuan snickered: "You prepared extensively and are confident of victory. But wills are not my forte; self-detonating would pit my weakness against your strength. How could I be so foolish?"

Mo Yao laughed: "To think you have a timid side. But you are mistaken—while I intend to use Spring Autumn Cicada, your foundation cannot send me ten thousand years into the past. I plan to find Red Lotus Demon Venerable's inheritance in the River of Time and use its power to travel ten thousand years against the current. Hehehe, don't you want to see Red Lotus Demon Venerable's inheritance?"

Outside, Giant Sun's will finally counted down from "ten" to "one".

Seeing Fang Yuan refuse to surrender, Giant Sun's will said darkly: "It seems you remain stubborn, resisting to the end!"

"The wind veil of assimilation is within a hundred steps! Ancestor Giant Sun, what do we do?" someone cried in shock.

# Chapter 646: Road of Life

The closing wind veil of assimilation was why Giant Sun's will had pressured Fang Yuan to surrender.

"Hei Lou Lan, take this strength path Immortal Gu, unseal Dark Limit, and unleash the true might of the ten extreme physiques. Your Great Strength True Martial Physique's recovery vastly surpasses the other nine extreme physiques. Even if you self-detonate, I can save you," Giant Sun's will said, passing him a strength path Immortal Gu.

Obtaining his dream Immortal Gu, Hei Lou Lan could not hide his excitement: "Thank you, Lord Ancestor!!"

Wisdom Gu abruptly stopped emitting its light, flying into the sea of Gu worms.

After fully displaying its rank nine aura, it concealed itself among the swarm and vanished.

Giant Sun's will laughed heartily: "Excellent! This wisdom Gu's wild will is newly born and immature. It formed the halo to keep others away, but fled to avoid being dragged into battle!"

"Hahaha, hahahaha!" Fang Yuan threw his head back in booming, wild laughter that drowned out all other noise.

Though one-armed and battered, his imposing aura flared, forcing everyone to step back.

Mo Yao's will added: "Lad, your bluster won't stop them. Don't you want to see Red Lotus Demon Venerable's secret inheritance? Once battle starts and Giant Sun's will muddles your mind, I cannot save you. It is a dead end—quickly use Spring Autumn Cicada!"

Fang Yuan's laughter ceased, his voice coarse: "As the saying goes, heaven always leaves a way—as long as I wish to walk, a road exists!"

Everyone started in surprise; these familiar words came from The Legends of Ren Zu.

The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter three, section three:

Luo Po Valley was a vast, intricate labyrinth. Searching for the missing Northern Dark Ice Soul, Ren Zu became lost and found no way out for days.

Having given his original heart to hope, he had only a heart of loneliness left.

He muttered: "Oh human, what is your purpose, struggling and rushing through this world?"

A voice beside him spoke: "Oh human, spirit of all beings. In your loneliness, you crave comfort, understanding, and recognition. Right now, you desire most to escape this damned place."

Ren Zu was startled: "Who is speaking to me?"

The voice chuckled: "I am a Gu named 'self'. Look inside, and you will find me."

Ren Zu inspected his heart of loneliness and indeed found a Gu worm at its core.

Ren Zu asked curiously: "You are a Gu worm, why are you inside me?"

Self Gu said: "I have been within you since you gained life, undiscovered. To find me, you had to look into your heart of loneliness."

"Is that so." Ren Zu replied indifferently, his mind entirely consumed by Northern Dark Ice Soul.

Seeing his apathy, Self Gu laughed: "Rejoice, Ren Zu! Understanding yourself is life's most vital task. You are the most reliable thing in the world—let me help you escape."

"You can help me escape? Can you lead me out of Luo Po Valley across Reverse Flow River?" Ren Zu asked, shocked and excited.

Self Gu laughed: "Ren Zu, why walk that road? The door of life and death's paths are merely traces left by fate Gu visiting fairness Gu. Walking this road places you under fate's manipulation. If you want to revive and leave this place, you must walk a brand-new road."

Ren Zu was perplexed: "Isn't there only one road? Wisdom Gu told me that, where could there be a second?"

Self Gu said: "Ren Zu, as long as you wish to walk, there will be a road beneath your feet."

After half a day of agonizing thought, a Gu finally jumped out of his mind.

This Gu was Ren Zu's old friend, cognition Gu.

"Where there is cognition, there is me," Cognition Gu said. "Human, you seem to be in trouble again; let me help you think."

Saying so, cognition Gu gave off a bright light, enlightening Ren Zu.

Cognition Gu had the ability to enlighten all beings; any creature it enlightened gained wings.

Cognition noted: "This pair of wings is called independence, Ren Zu; it will help you tread a new road. Be careful, for a new road is hard to walk. Other Gu are unreliable; you can only rely on self Gu."

Ren Zu remained confused: "How should I walk?"

"Walk ahead and carve the path of your life! This road is unique to you—only you can walk it!" Self Gu said excitedly.

Ren Zu took the first step forward.

Losing patience, the crowd shouted and charged at Fang Yuan.

At that moment, Hei Lou Lan grimaced in pain, coughing up a mouthful of blood.

"Good timing." Fang Yuan smiled, showing an eerie aura.

He raised his remaining hand as he punched directly.

With a loud explosion, fist qi burst forth and materialized into a strength path phantom.

# Chapter 647: The answer is found in one's self!

This strength path phantom bore a striking resemblance to a youthful Fang Yuan—vivid, lifelike, and of similar stature.

"Isn't this Hei Lou Lan's killer move?" Mo Yao's will exclaimed. "You seized his crucial Gu worm, but how did you reproduce the move?"

Only Hei Lou Lan looked bewildered, slowing down at the rear: "Did he use my vital Gu to create that phantom? How does it have his own appearance?!"

Though his vital Gu was seized, his injuries rapidly healed under the Great Strength True Martial Physique's formidable recovery.

At this moment, everyone had reached Fang Yuan.

On the periphery, Giant Sun's will curled into a slow-moving ball, waiting for Fang Yuan to show a weakness amidst the chaotic battle to strike fatally.

"In that case, Mo Yao, open your eyes and watch closely." Fang Yuan's grin widened into a huge smile.

He punched! With the only remaining arm!

Fist qi surged into a strength path phantom, which immediately pounced upon the incoming Gu Masters.

In the blink of an eye, a hundred strength path phantoms formed layers of protection around him.

Within moments, there were already a thousand strength path phantoms!

Where Fang Yuan had stood alone moments ago, an entire army now surrounded him!

These strength path phantoms could actually speak and displayed extraordinary intelligence.

They attacked in unison, forming a human tide that drowned the previously confident Gu Masters.

"Damn it, these strength path phantoms can coordinate and execute battle tactics!"

"What killer move is this? Mine couldn't coordinate to this extent—it's a relentless army fighting to the death!" Hei Lou Lan was shocked and uneasy.

"Your... killer move, this..." Mo Yao's will stammered in shock!

She analyzed: "Mortal Gu cannot possess such might—you used Immortal Gu! Another hidden trump card? No, you refined Immortal Gu! But how could you do so quickly?"

Fang Yuan laughed loudly: "Why do you think I strove to get near wisdom Gu by all means? It was to use its rank nine aura to refine Immortal Gu! If it were other people's Immortal Gu, it wouldn't be easily fooled, which is why I couldn't refine Man as Before and Landscape as Before. But a young wild will can hardly tell if the aura originated from me."

"You intended to transform completely with six arm heavenly zombie king all along?" Mo Yao's will grew deeply uneasy upon realizing this.

The light of wisdom devoured lifespan, but having transformed into an undead zombie, Fang Yuan could naturally linger in it far longer.

Observing further, Mo Yao found Fang Yuan's killer move retained strength path traits: most phantoms had two arms, while others possessed four or occasionally six.

The more arms the phantoms had, the stronger they were.

Two-armed phantoms matched hundred beast kings, four-armed phantoms rivaled thousand beast kings, and six-armed phantoms equaled myriad beast kings.

"This is simply the recreation of a beast group!" Mo Yao's will shivered in disbelief. "Lad, you resolved the age-old question—you merged enslavement and strength path!"

The crucial breakthrough had come during his Gu Immortal ascension.

Using that precious opportunity to advance his strength path realm and draw inspiration from heaven and earth, he cast aside all else to deduce the fusion of enslavement and strength.

Basking in the light of wisdom had drained his lifespan, but that heavy price allowed him to finally coordinate his Gu worms into this killer move.

He also had Hei Lou Lan to thank, whose vital Gu was a crucial component of the killer move. Alongside it, the newly refined Immortal Gu, six arm heavenly zombie king, and all-out effort Gu played vital roles.

"The convergence of enslavement and strength path has baffled countless geniuses through the ages. I never expected you to resolve it so completely. Lad, you have truly ventured onto a new road. Developing this further could truly unite them into an entirely new path of unprecedented might!"

"Hehehe." Fang Yuan was about to reply when Giant Sun's will suddenly appeared before him.

In that critical moment, Fang Yuan shifted his head away, taking the brunt of Giant Sun's will's attack with his shoulder.

With a deafening boom, Fang Yuan was sent rolling, plowing a trench meters long.

"There's still enough of your will left to influence my thoughts!" Fang Yuan fumed, seeing through Mo Yao's scheme.

Mo Yao cast aside all pretense and shrieked: "Kid, you refused to activate Spring Autumn Cicada! Destiny brought you before me to grant me rebirth—I will seize this opportunity!"

"Hmph! Most of your will and Gu worms are sealed in my immortal aperture, and your red date immortal essence is in my control—you cannot replenish your will. To influence my thoughts, yours must collide. Let's see how long the remnant hiding in my mind can last!"

Fang Yuan attacked Mo Yao's will while keeping his gaze locked on Giant Sun's will. Strength path phantoms quickly rallied to protect him once more.

Giant Sun's will felt troubled; while Fang Yuan had been manageable alone, he now commanded a massive army!

"An opening!" He suddenly transformed into a golden rainbow, weaving through the phantoms to strike ruthlessly at Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan grinned: "Old geezer, why the rush?"

Falling for the trap, Giant Sun's will found three strength path phantoms instantly appearing before him.

Thinking rapidly, Giant Sun's will coiled past two like a snake, but crashed directly into the third.

"Old bastard, did you think I was easy prey? I've waited long enough!" Fully prepared, Fang Yuan brought his fist down with all his strength at Giant Sun's will.

Giant Sun's will was caught unprepared and shattered!

# Chapter 648: Fierce and Ambitious

Bang, the condensed golden will was smashed into smithereens, splitting into countless parts.

It swiftly reconvened, though its volume had decreased by a fifth.

Enraged, Giant Sun's will prepared to counterattack, but Fang Yuan had already retreated behind layers of phantoms.

"Hei Lou Lan, what are you still hesitating for?" Giant Sun's will bellowed.

"How can his phantoms look identical to him?" Hei Lou Lan wondered, startled back to reality.

Possessing the Great Strength True Martial Physique, Hei Lou Lan stood up straight, glaring furiously.

An ordinary punch produced terrifying force, its frigid fist qi nearly penetrating the dense layers of phantoms.

The Immortal Gu Dark Limit's remaining power on him was a thin layer of black membrane.

Tearing the black membrane away, Hei Lou Lan transformed, unleashing the soaring aura of a ten extreme physique.

Hei Lou Lan locked her gaze onto Fang Yuan, radiating fierce killing intent like a proud tigress hunting prey.

Fang Yuan snorted coldly as fist qi surged endlessly, condensing into an army of strength path phantoms.

Confident in his killer move, he did not fear her: "A ten extreme physique's self-detonation can slaughter immortals, but so can my killer move!"

Her true appearance revealed, Hei Lou Lan fought like an unstoppable warrior goddess, unshakeable against the charging phantoms.

"Save me!" Ye Lui Sang and the others cried out nearby.

Fang Yuan multitasked: confronting Hei Lou Lan, dealing with the other Gu Masters, and guarding against Giant Sun's will.

Moving as one entity, the strength path phantoms launched a frenzied assault without regard for sacrifices. Ye Lui Sang's group could hold out no longer as their final defense broke.

Hei Lou Lan tried to assist them, but was firmly stalled by the phantoms.

"These phantoms possess human intelligence! How did he achieve this? He seized my vital Gu, but how can they share his exact appearance?!" Hei Lou Lan was astonished.

Hei Lou Lan could not reinforce them in time; Ye Lui Sang and the others were killed one after another by the phantoms.

Facing his descendants' cries for help, Giant Sun's will made the opposite choice: splitting into arrows, he sought to kill Fang Yuan amidst the chaos.

Fang Yuan mobilized the phantom guards beside him to engage Giant Sun's will in intense battle.

Seeing no success, Giant Sun's will retreated after probing. With few thoughts left, intense combat demanded rapid thinking that he could scarcely afford.

Mo Yao's will continued to create distracting thoughts, causing Fang Yuan to make mistakes when mobilizing phantoms and hindering his master-level enslavement path attainment.

However, as time passed, Fang Yuan gradually attained the upper hand.

His phantom army continued swelling, packing the narrow space with over ten thousand strength path phantoms.

Meanwhile, Mo Yao's influence over him was weakening.

Giant Sun's will ambushed repeatedly without success, his volume dwindling to less than an adult's.

Only Hei Lou Lan fought on relentlessly, wielding boundless stamina and Great Strength True Martial might that required endless phantoms to restrain.

"Child, be careful. I developed this killer move for you; though strong, its phantom reflects your subconscious self," her dying mother, Su Xian, weakly warned.

"The Legends of Ren Zu tells us that everyone has a self in their heart. Child, your phantom is that inner self. It reveals your thirst for tyrannical strength, longing to escape womanhood and live as a man. Use it sparingly, lest it warp you into someone as savage as your phantom," Su Xian murmured weakly.

"When you can create phantoms that truly match your appearance, mother will be at ease. Remember, find your 'self'. And... beware of your... father..." With those final words, Su Xian drew her last breath.

"Hei Lou Lan, what are you doing? Daydreaming at a moment like this?" Giant Sun's will's roar shattered her recollection.

Startled awake, Hei Lou Lan stared at Fang Yuan with profound turmoil—had this man already found his 'self'?! How had he achieved it?

"The wind veil of assimilation is upon us! Hei Lou Lan, self-detonate—I swear upon Giant Sun's honor that I will save you!" Giant Sun's will commanded.

Fang Yuan's gaze sharpened; though confident his phantom army could buy time to open a stargate, he refused to take the risk.

He provoked: "Hei Lou Lan, Giant Sun's will has Immortal Gu, but I hold his immortal essence—how could he save you? Join me; I can escape this wind veil!"

Fang Yuan was merely probing, harboring little expectation.

Yet upon hearing his words, Hei Lou Lan slowed, her battle intent noticeably waning.

Giant Sun's will yelled: "Don't listen to this demon's lies! Hei Lou Lan, don't hesitate; do you doubt your own ancestor? Remember, I only lent you that strength path Immortal Gu; my will inside can detonate it at a thought!"

Hei Lou Lan roared as her battle intent soared again.

"Demon with a glib tongue! What Gu did you use on me? Pay the ultimate price and hand over your life!"

Hei Lou Lan erupted like a wild dragon plunging into the sea, carving a path through the layered phantom army.

Fang Yuan laughed: "Good, let me test the power of the Great Strength True Martial Physique!"

He met Hei Lou Lan head-on, engaging in close combat.

Even backed by infinite primeval essence, the six arm heavenly zombie king could not match a ten extreme physique in raw power.

Fang Yuan's ferocity alongside the phantoms' seamless coordination exerted immense pressure, inflicting injury upon injury on her.

Giant Sun's will waited briefly before spotting a flaw in Fang Yuan's defense, launching a lightning-fast sneak attack.

Fang Yuan stepped back and pivoted, counterattacking Giant Sun's will with venomous hatred.

Giant Sun's will gritted his teeth and clashed fiercely with Fang Yuan, creating an even larger flaw. He bellowed: "Hei Lou Lan!"

"Coming!" Hei Lou Lan surged over and activated her Gu worms, striking with unprecedented power.

A dozen strength path phantoms suddenly jumped in to shield Fang Yuan.

"You!" Giant Sun's will roared in shock as Hei Lou Lan's attack struck not Fang Yuan, but him!

Giant Sun's will crumbled, revealing three Immortal Gu.

Hei Lou Lan opened her mouth, actually swallowing the three Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan laughed as the reinforcing phantoms shifted formation, surrounding Giant Sun's will before brazenly self-detonating!

Surging fist qi nearly annihilated Giant Sun's will, leaving only a few golden thoughts escaping!

# Chapter 649: Twin Demons

"Why, why?!" The golden thoughts fumed, bewildered by the betrayal.

"Old bastard, now that the strength path Immortal Gu is mine, why would I listen to you?" Hei Lou Lan sneered coldly.

"You thankless wretch, unfilial descendant, actually betraying your ancestor!" The golden thoughts shouted in hatred.

"Shut up and stop screaming. Are your thoughts so few now that you've turned demented?" Hei Lou Lan squinted. "You want me to self-detonate, but what could you possibly save me with? None of your three remaining Immortal Gu can resurrect me. Did you think you could deceive me?"

"If you were strong, I would obey the rule of the strong. But look at you now—what right do you have to order me around? Just because you're the remnant will of a dead man? Hehehe, even Giant Sun Immortal Venerable is dead, a thing of the past! In this new era, why is a dead man like you still jumping around like a clown?"

"Even with a single thought remaining, I can still destroy the Immortal Gu!" the golden thoughts cried.

Hei Lou Lan remained calm: "Try all you want."

"You're suppressing four Immortal Gu?! Without an immortal's will, how can you achieve this?" The golden thoughts shrieked in disbelief, unable to detonate them.

"There is still much you do not know." Hei Lou Lan seemed shrouded in mystery.

"Hei Lou Lan, colluding with an outsider against your ancestor! When did you team up?!" the golden thoughts raged.

"Your pathetic performance shames Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's name," Fang Yuan mocked, grinning disdainfully.

"I refuse to accept this! My main body's arrangements will activate once Eighty-Eight True Yang Building collapses. You will be hunted to the ends of the world! In the end, I only lost to luck!" The golden thoughts roared hysterically.

In the next moment, it self-detonated, destroying itself!

Thus, the strongest existence and ruler of Imperial Court blessed land dispersed like smoke, leaving not a trace behind.

Hei Lou Lan exhaled turbid air and looked at Fang Yuan calmly, speaking solemnly: "Now let's talk. I believe we have a foundation for cooperation."

Fang Yuan nodded, sneering: "Before speaking of anything else, the Immortal Gu Fixed Immortal Travel you seized is mine."

"I know, and that is my condition. I am suppressing it, but I need you to lend me Fixed Immortal Travel!"

Fang Yuan asked calmly, "Why should I lend it to you?"

"Hmph, the Gu is with me, and without Fixed Immortal Travel, how will you escape? Only through sincere cooperation do we have a chance to escape," Hei Lou Lan said.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Who said I don't have other methods to leave?"

Hei Lou Lan stared at him: "The wind veil isolates everything. If you have another escape method, it clearly has flaws!"

Without Mo Yao's will interfering, Fang Yuan returned to his true nature. Calculating the gains, he asked the crucial question: "Then, what can I obtain?"

"Immortal Gu Dark Limit," Hei Lou Lan replied calmly, though inwardly breathing a sigh of relief.

"Oh, I would like to hear the details."

"Gu Immortal Jiang Yu holds it. It conceals aura, hides heavenly secrets, and was used to seal my Great Strength True Martial Physique. Northern Plains' Gu Immortals will hunt you down, but Dark Limit will ensure your location is never discovered."

"Interesting, what else?" Fang Yuan rubbed his chin.

Hei Lou Lan smiled: "We are both smart people, so I'll speak frankly. Bearing deep hatred, I cannot self-detonate to take you down with me. But you wouldn't want to force me into dragging you along either, right?"

"Hmph, you're unlikely to kill me, but it would indeed be troublesome!" Fang Yuan snorted coldly.

Hei Lou Lan continued: "I will help you get Dark Limit, return Fixed Immortal Travel, and give you my strength path killer move. Moreover, Tai Bai Yun Sheng still lives."

Fang Yuan glanced at the unconscious Tai Bai Yun Sheng, whose body was covered by a defensive barrier—clearly Hei Lou Lan's work.

"Then your condition is?" Fang Yuan asked.

"Protect me during my Gu Immortal ascension and help me kill my father personally!" Hei Lou Lan said, eyes filled with extreme hatred.

"Interesting! Well, cooperating for now does no harm," Fang Yuan agreed with praise.

Fang Yuan then stated his conditions, reaching a basic consensus with Hei Lou Lan.

The shrinking wind veil of assimilation had almost reached its limit.

"Time is short today; we will talk more later." After reaching a rough agreement, Hei Lou Lan activated Fixed Immortal Travel, dark green light covering her body.

Before leaving, she glanced deeply at Fang Yuan and asked casually, "Your killer move, what is its name?"

"Myriad Self." Fang Yuan replied.

Hei Lou Lan nodded, knowing this killer move would soon shake the five regions.

The next moment, Fixed Immortal Travel activated and Hei Lou Lan disappeared.

The moment she left, Fang Yuan destroyed the surroundings to prevent her from using Fixed Immortal Travel to return.

The wind veil of assimilation pressed close, leaving Fang Yuan only a cabin-sized space to move.

Fang Yuan released starlight firefly Gu and opened the stargate.

But he did not leave immediately, instead deeply gazing at these flying Gu worms.

He had no certainty, but still wanted to try.

A few breaths later, a Gu worm flew towards him of its own accord.

Rank nine wisdom Gu!

"Hahaha..." In the narrow space, Fang Yuan's laughter echoed endlessly.
